58/// Literal argv rendering only, not admission authority. The driver retains its
59/// private authenticated slot proof and checks the complete derived graph.
60pub fn admitted_pin_command(tag: &str, floor: Option<&str>) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
61    let (base, flag) = match tag {
62        "pre.reverie_pin" | "pre.reverie_pin_on_host" => (PIN_GATE_COMMAND, "--base-ref"),
63        "check.lint_checks" => (LINT_CHECKS_COMMAND, "--reverie-pin-base-ref"),
64        other if other.starts_with("pre.reverie_pin") => {
65            return Err(format!("unknown pin node {other}"));
66        }
67        _ => return Ok(None),
68    };
69    match floor {
70        Some(sha) if crate::ledger::admission_hex(sha, 40) => {
71            Ok(Some(format!("{base} {flag} '{sha}'")))
72        }
73        Some(_) => Err("pin command requires one literal full lowercase SHA".into()),
74        None => Ok(Some(base.into())),
75    }
76}

88/// The pinned-root workspace producer is two nodes. The compile node runs the
89/// Cargo half of `build.workspace` and needs no rust-script tool, so it starts
90/// beside `build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root` instead of after it. The prepare
91/// node keeps the producer's tag, so every consumer still names it, and runs

124const PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_DESC: &str = "Build every workspace target, the backend plugins and the one Hermit binary in the validate profile, beside the rust-script build";
125const PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_DESCRIPTION: &str = "The Cargo half of the pinned-root workspace build and the one Cargo compilation of Hermit in the full and portable validations, in the [profile.validate] profile: release optimisation with debug assertions and overflow checks on, so cells run an optimised Hermit with detcore's debug_assert invariants and the determinism-log hash lines --verify compares. It first builds exactly the nextest preparation's guest build, `-p hermetic_infra_hermit_tests --bins`, in the same profile, so that build finds every unit it links already fresh. The workspace build cannot serve it: it resolves 14 shared dependencies with wider features (parking_lot gains send_guard, bytes serde, syn fold), which gives every reverie and hermit-detcore unit a new hash, and building hermit-install alone instead (def08d743) made the guest build compile them inside build.workspace_in_pinned_root, 46 s, so it was reverted. Until 2026-10-18 this first build was `-p detcore-dbt`, a superset of the guest build's units plus reverie-dbt's DynamoRIO build script (25.8 s) and detcore-dbt itself (24.4 s), both rebuilt by the workspace build anyway, which also builds reverie-dbt before hermit-install's build script reads its DynamoRIO cache (the cache publishes by atomic rename, so concurrent builders are safe). In the 32-job timings of 601df499 the first build took 55.9 s and the guest build's own units end at about 47 s; the workspace build's critical chain (163.4 s replayed) does not move when the DynamoRIO build script joins it, since it finishes before detcore-dbt can start, then builds the whole workspace, all targets, with the union of the features every prepared Nextest selection names. Nothing in it runs a rust-script (run-with-reverie-dbt-budget.sh compiles its pin checks with rustc, and no build script calls one), so it does not wait for build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root and the two compile side by side in the same pinned root, writing different target directories; it keeps the rust-script environment, with HERMIT_PREBUILT_RUST_SCRIPTS_REQUIRED=1, so a rust-script added here later fails at once instead of compiling or running unprepared. Its completion consumer is build.workspace_in_pinned_root, which lists the executables this build produced; it also publishes the hermit-bin artifact signal for the early E2E publisher once Cargo links that binary and its staged LiteInst inputs. Until 2026-10-06 the two halves were one node that waited for the rust-script tools, about 183 seconds, before this 175-to-182-second Cargo phase began. preferred_inner_jobs=32 is kept from the cold measurement at hermit@846baeca. CPU RE-DERIVATION 2026-11-01: across 265 retained full-run step profiles (ci-hub history node-cpu-budgets, kill samples excluded) this node's worst valid CPU was 7336.6 seconds (p99 7316.1), and a composite rerun was killed at the former 7200-second cap at about 7330 CPU-seconds while the same node at the same commit passed at about 6090; the shared workspace CPU budget is now 11100, the next 300-second bucket above 1.5 times that worst (11004.8).";
126const PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_DESC: &str = "List every prepared Nextest executable from the one validate-profile build and record each selection's subset";
127const PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_DESCRIPTION: &str = "The preparation half of the pinned-root workspace build. Once build.workspace_compile_in_pinned_root has built every workspace target and build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root has published the prebuilt rust-script tools, `nextest-binaries.rs prepare full` runs in the same pinned root, target directory and Cargo home: one `cargo nextest list` over the unified validate-profile build, the hermit_modes guests and record workloads from that build, and a dev-profile build of the nextest-cpu-wrapper. It hashes every listed executable and publishes all selections in one record, so no selection recompiles anything or relinks target/validate/hermit. After the final preparation Cargo invocation, `target/validate/stage-detcore-liteinst --source-copy target` builds the ordinary preload in the existing liteinst-runtime profile, applies the unchanged source/constructor proof and atomically stages its receipt and bytes. Every completion consumer of the workspace build names this node, so none starts before both preparation and finalization complete; it finally verifies the early-published E2E artifact still matches this node's final binary and staged resources. COLD ORDINARY FINALIZATION 2026-10-17: at Hermit 9b0e652d, eight admitted CPUs, with only target/liteinst-runtime removed before the run, the complete preparation plus ordinary finalizer took 294.965 wall seconds and 1383.852 CPU-seconds (1327.116 user, 56.736 system), with a 4.9-GiB peak and no OOM. This includes preparation rebuilding the stamped CLI and install staging; it is not just a warm artifact check. The former 1200-CPU-second cap interrupted the added dedicated-profile build. 2100 CPU-seconds is the next 300-second bucket above 1.5 times the complete measured cost (2075.778); the 600-second wall and 8-GiB memory bounds remain. CPU RE-DERIVATION 2026-11-01: across 274 retained full-run step profiles (ci-hub history node-cpu-budgets, kill samples excluded) the preparation's worst valid CPU was 3618.0 seconds (p99 3562.4), so the cap is now 5700, the next 300-second bucket above 1.5 times that worst (5427.0). The constructor/source proof and every prepared selection are unchanged. The budget is measured: in eight full validations on 2026-10-06 the unsplit node took 235 to 241 seconds, of which Cargo reported 45 to 46 for detcore-dbt and 130 to 136 for the workspace, leaving 58 to 60 seconds for container start and preparation. The CPU-wrapper build is the largest part, 27 to 28 seconds at 32 workers in those runs; a cold 16-worker build of it outside the root took 28 seconds, 135 CPU-seconds and a 2.4 GB memory peak. The 32-worker preference is the width preparation ran at inside the unsplit node.";

143/// The group of every tool self-test node: `selftest.<name>`.

145const TOOL_SELF_TEST_GROUP_PREFIX: &str = "selftest.";

147/// One repository tool's self-test, run by `test-harness selftest <name>`.
148pub struct ToolSelfTest {
149    /// The `selftest` argument and the job of its `selftest.<name>` node.
150    pub name: &'static str,
151    /// The program, relative to the repository root.
152    pub program: &'static str,
153    pub args: &'static [&'static str],
154    /// `None` runs the self-test in every validation. `Some(triggers)` runs
155    /// it on main and whenever a path changed since the merge base with
156    /// `origin/main` is under one of the triggers (a trigger ending in `/` is
157    /// a directory; any other trigger is one tracked path, a file or a
158    /// submodule); otherwise the node prints a NOT RUN line
159    /// (`self_test_selection`) and passes.
160    pub run_when_changed: Option<&'static [&'static str]>,
161    /// `test-harness selftest` passes the `hermit-manifest-plan` binary that
162    /// its own build wrote beside it through `HERMIT_MANIFEST_PLAN_BIN`, so the
163    /// program runs that binary instead of building one with Cargo inside the
164    /// node's CPU cap. Only the scorecard reads it.
165    pub manifest_plan_helper: bool,
166}
167

188/// The tool self-tests the validation DAG runs as `selftest.<name>` leaf nodes.
189/// They test the repository's own tooling, not a precondition of any product
190/// node, so no node depends on them; each still turns the validation red when
191/// it fails. `assert_tool_self_test_nodes` requires exactly one node per entry
192/// in every profile that runs `gate.manifest`'s local audits.
193pub const TOOL_SELF_TESTS: &[ToolSelfTest] = &[
194    ToolSelfTest {
195        name: "scorecard",
196        program: "ci/compat-envelope/scorecard.rs",
197        args: &["self-test-and-check"],
198        run_when_changed: None,
199        manifest_plan_helper: true,
200    },
201    // The scorecard's commands tier runs its commands against a scratch
202    // clone, ledger and reverie repository, and costs minutes; the regression
203    // tier above runs in seconds. It runs when one of its known inputs
204    // changes, and always on main, which also catches a change elsewhere that
205    // it reads: the scorecard's own directory; the manifest-plan crate it
206    // builds and runs, with that crate's path dependencies (detcore-model/,
207    // and agent-utils, a gitlink that `git diff` lists without a trailing
208    // slash, and .gitmodules, which says where it comes from) and Cargo.lock;
209    // the rust-script prelude it includes and the
210    // prepared rust-script launchers; the script that pins its ledger corpus;
211    // and the E2E manifests its cells and its `system-utils/record-getpid`
212    // command fixture come from.
213    ToolSelfTest {
214        name: "scorecard_commands",
215        program: "ci/compat-envelope/scorecard.rs",
216        args: &["self-test-commands"],
217        run_when_changed: Some(SCORECARD_INPUTS),
218        manifest_plan_helper: false,
219    },
220    ToolSelfTest {
221        name: "pressure_test",
222        program: "ci/compat-envelope/pressure-test.rs",
223        args: &["self-test"],
224        run_when_changed: None,
225        manifest_plan_helper: false,
226    },
227    // The removed shell front door accumulated plan/scheduler/receipt guards
228    // that now belong to the Rust validate driver. Exercise those brackets
229    // without executing the validation DAG.
230    ToolSelfTest {
231        name: "validate_rs",
232        program: "scripts/validate.rs",
233        args: &["--self-test"],
234        run_when_changed: None,
235        manifest_plan_helper: false,
236    },
237    ToolSelfTest {
238        name: "manifest_cli",
239        program: "tests/manifest-cli.rs",
240        args: &["self-test"],
241        run_when_changed: None,
242        manifest_plan_helper: false,
243    },
244    // The core build wrapper checks the actual local source pin and the
245    // runner-admitted width before entering its command. Keep the end-to-end
246    // command sentinel, refusal, status and timing controls; no SDK calibration
247    // is selected by this first-party self-test.
248    ToolSelfTest {
249        name: "core_build",
250        program: "ci/run-with-core-build-test.sh",
251        args: &[],
252        run_when_changed: None,
253        manifest_plan_helper: false,
254    },
255];

258pub(crate) const HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX: &str = "_on_host";
259/// Hermit backends the GitHub-hosted portable profile omits.
260///
261/// GitHub-hosted runners expose `/dev/kvm` through nested virtualization but
262/// provide no PMU, so every KVM guest fails when its clock opens the retired
263/// branch counter (`perf_event_open` returns ENOENT). They also lack CPUID
264/// faulting, which the in-guest LiteInst runtime of the `liteinst` and
265/// `in-guest-trap` backends needs before the guest's first instruction
266/// (`detcore-liteinst: initialization failed: CPUID faulting is unavailable`,
267/// the same refusal that keeps the in-guest `test.cli` cases off these runners;
268/// see [`HOSTED_PORTABLE_CPUID_FAULTING_CLI_TESTS`]). The local `full` and
269/// `portable` profiles still select every cell of these backends. The hosted E2E commands,
270/// their result ownership, the hosted expected population, and the hosted
271/// scorecard verification all omit the same backends, so an omitted cell is
272/// never reported as a pass. `.github/workflows/ci-portable.yml`,
273/// `ci/check-shard-coverage.sh`, and `ci/hermetic/run-split-validate.sh`
274/// apply the same filter to `ci/expected-e2e-plan.json`; a test below keeps
275/// them in agreement with this list.
276pub const HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS: &[&str] = &["kvm", "liteinst", "in-guest-trap"];
277
278/// `test.cli` cases the GitHub-hosted portable profile excludes by exact name.
279///
280/// These cases need actual CPUID faulting, a host capability like the PMU.
281/// The ptrace first-image-instruction sentinel requires its literal entry
282/// CPUID to reach Detcore and return the fixed table; a capability refusal
283/// fails it. The other cases start the in-guest LiteInst runtime, which needs
284/// the same facility. GitHub-hosted runners have none: in portable
285/// run 37383177918 the first 25 refused with `detcore-liteinst:

470/// The exact-name filterset that keeps `names` out of a hosted twin.
471fn hosted_exclusion_filterset(names: &[&str]) -> String {
472    let exclusions = names
473        .iter()
474        .map(|name| format!("test(={name})"))
475        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
476        .join(" | ");
477    format!(" -E 'not ({exclusions})'")
478}

482
483fn hosted_portable_excludes(cell: &DagManifest) -> bool {
484    cell.backend
485        .as_deref()
486        .is_some_and(|backend| HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS.contains(&backend))
487}
488
489/// Every backend set the hosted-portable exclusion has named, oldest first.
490/// Plans constructed while only KVM was excluded carry `--exclude-backend kvm`
491/// alone and omit only KVM's cells; retained receipts of that shape must keep
492/// reading. The generator writes only the last entry,
493/// [`HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS`].
494const HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUSION_GENERATIONS: &[&[&str]] =
495    &[&["kvm"], HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS];
496
497/// Whether constructed `step` omits `backend`'s cells under the hosted-portable
498/// exclusion. Only a hosted-portable step whose harness selector carries the
499/// exact exclusion flags of one generation omits that generation's backends; a
500/// plan retained before any exclusion has neither the flags nor the omission,
501/// and keeps reading as before. The flags follow the bucket's whole selector,
502/// as the generator writes them: `--prebuilt` for most buckets, and
503/// `--diagnostic-results` for the compat bucket, whose selector ends there.
504pub(crate) fn hosted_step_omits_backend(step: &Step, backend: &str) -> bool {
505    let anchor = step.manifest.as_ref().map_or("--prebuilt", |manifest| {
506        manifest_selector_flags(&manifest.category)
507    });
508    step.labels == [HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL]
509        && HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUSION_GENERATIONS
510            .iter()
511            .any(|excluded| {
512                excluded.contains(&backend)
513                    && carries_exclusion_once(&step.cmd, excluded, anchor, " ")
514            })
515}
516
517/// Whether constructed `step` omits `backend`'s cells: under the
518/// hosted-portable exclusion ([`hosted_step_omits_backend`]), or as the
519/// portable-strict-compat-only compat step that carries exactly the
520/// [`PORTABLE_FOCUSED_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS`] flags after its selector. A plan
521/// retained before that step carried the flags owns every compat cell of its
522/// own expected plan and keeps reading as before.
523pub(crate) fn step_omits_backend(step: &Step, backend: &str) -> bool {
524    hosted_step_omits_backend(step, backend)
525        || (step.tag() == PORTABLE_FOCUSED_COMPAT_TAG
526            && PORTABLE_FOCUSED_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS.contains(&backend)
527            && carries_exclusion_once(
528                &step.cmd,
529                PORTABLE_FOCUSED_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS,
530                manifest_selector_flags("compat"),
531                " ",
532            ))
533}
534
535/// Whether `cmd` carries the current hosted-portable exclusion flags exactly
536/// once, directly after `anchor` and followed by `after`.
537fn carries_hosted_exclusion_once(cmd: &str, anchor: &str, after: &str) -> bool {
538    carries_exclusion_once(cmd, HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS, anchor, after)
539}
540
541/// Whether `cmd` carries the exclusion flags for `excluded` exactly once,
542/// directly after `anchor` and followed by `after`, and no other
543/// `--exclude-backend` word. `test-harness` refuses a repeated
544/// `--exclude-backend`, so a command that repeats the flags would fail when
545/// run; a substring check alone cannot see the repeat. The word count also
546/// keeps one generation's flags from matching a prefix of a later one's.
547fn carries_exclusion_once(cmd: &str, excluded: &[&str], anchor: &str, after: &str) -> bool {
548    let exclusion = exclusion_flags(excluded);
549    let anchored = format!("{anchor}{exclusion}{after}");
550    let anchored_count = if after.is_empty() {
551        usize::from(cmd.ends_with(&anchored))
552    } else {
553        cmd.matches(&anchored).count()
554    };
555    anchored_count == 1
556        && cmd
557            .split_whitespace()
558            .filter(|word| *word == "--exclude-backend")
559            .count()
560            == excluded.len()
561}
562
563fn hosted_portable_exclusion_flags() -> String {
564    exclusion_flags(HOSTED_PORTABLE_EXCLUDED_BACKENDS)
565}
566
567fn exclusion_flags(excluded: &[&str]) -> String {
568    excluded
569        .iter()
570        .map(|backend| format!(" --exclude-backend {backend}"))
571        .collect()
572}

678const PINNED_ROOT_FORWARDED_ENV: &[&str] = &[
679    "CI",
680    "CARGO_BUILD_JOBS",
681    "DAGRUN_STEP_STARTED_MONOTONIC_NS",
682    "E2E_BUILD_ROOT",
683    E2E_KERNEL_VERSION_ENV,
684    E2E_MACHINE_SHORTNAME_ENV,
685    "E2E_RESULT_ROOT",
686    "E2E_RUN_ID",
687    "HERMIT_E2E_EMPTY_WORKDIR",
688    // Forwarded only when set: one pinned epoch for every harness process of a
689    // run, so parity operands from different nodes give their guests one clock,
690    // and the parity post-pass's two activation variables, so a run that
691    // selects or disables parity cells does so inside the pinned root too.
692    "HERMIT_EPOCH",
693    crate::parity::PARITY_POST_PASS_ENV,
694    crate::parity::PARITY_SELECT_ENV,
695    crate::timeouts::TEST_CPU_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER_ENV,
696    crate::timeouts::TEST_WALL_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER_ENV,
697    "HERMIT_VALIDATE_HOST_CAPABILITY_PRESENT",
698    // The queue adapter supplies the stamped census base under these names
699    // (HERMIT_CENSUS_BASE_LISTED_IDS for a single-suite node,
700    // HERMIT_CENSUS_BASE_DIR with one stamped <suite>.listed-ids per suite
701    // plus HERMIT_CENSUS_BASE_COMMIT and HERMIT_CENSUS_DROPPED_FILE);
702    // forwarded only when set, they carry that supply into the pinned
703    // root, where counted nodes require their base and refuse by name
704    // without it. Without forwarding, hermetic counted nodes never see
705    // the base and fail closed.
706    "HERMIT_CENSUS_BASE_COMMIT",
707    "HERMIT_CENSUS_BASE_DIR",
708    "HERMIT_CENSUS_BASE_LISTED_IDS",
709    "HERMIT_CENSUS_DROPPED_FILE",
710    // validate --keep-going sets these to 0 on every step; forwarded only
711    // when set, they carry the run-past-the-first-failure opt-in into the
712    // pinned root, where the counted nextest wrapper and the e2e harness
713    // read them. Without forwarding, pinned-root nodes always fail fast.
714    "HERMIT_E2E_FAIL_FAST",
715    "HERMIT_NEXTEST_FAIL_FAST",
716    // validate --tests sets this on case-selected nextest steps; forwarded
717    // only when set, it carries the case filter into the pinned root.
718    "HERMIT_NEXTEST_FILTER_EXPR",
719    "HERMIT_VALIDATE_RELEASE_BUILD_MODE",
720    "HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUCK_DOTSLASH",
721    "HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUILD_MODE",
722    "HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUCK2",
723    "L4_REPS",
724    "NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS",
725    "PR_NUMBER",
726    // validate.rs sets it to 16 MiB for every cargo and rustc of a run.
727    "RUST_MIN_STACK",
728    "SUPER_REPETITIONS",
729    "THIRD_PARTY_BUILD_JOBS",
730    "VALIDATE_VERBOSITY",
731    "VALIDATE_RUN_STATE",
732];

946struct Scratch(PathBuf);
947
948impl Scratch {
949    fn create() -> Result<Self, String> {
950        let nonce = SystemTime::now()
951            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
952            .map_err(|error| format!("clock is before Unix epoch: {error}"))?
953            .as_nanos();
954        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
955            "hermit-generate-validation-dag-{}-{nonce}",
956            std::process::id()
957        ));
958        fs::create_dir(&path).map_err(|error| {
959            format!(
960                "cannot create scratch directory {}: {error}",
961                path.display()
962            )
963        })?;
964        Ok(Self(path))
965    }
966}
967
968impl Drop for Scratch {
969    fn drop(&mut self) {
970        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
971    }
972}
973
974pub fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
975    let output = Command::new("git")
976        .args(["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
977        .output()
978        .map_err(|error| format!("cannot run git rev-parse: {error}"))?;
979    if !output.status.success() {
980        return Err(format!(
981            "git rev-parse failed: {}",
982            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
983        ));
984    }
985    Ok(PathBuf::from(
986        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim(),
987    ))
988}

990fn generated_plan(root: &Path, scratch: &Path) -> Result<DagConfig, String> {
991    // In-process, so neither generate-validation-dag nor the freshness test
992    // compiles scripts/validate.rs (see scripts/lib/validate_generator.rs).
993    let repetitions = SUPER_REPETITIONS
994        .parse::<i64>()
995        .map_err(|error| format!("invalid SUPER_REPETITIONS {SUPER_REPETITIONS:?}: {error}"))?;
996    crate::validate_generator::committed_generated_partition(
997        root,
998        &scratch.join("run-state"),
999        repetitions,
1000    )

1003/// The required cells each run type's manifest bucket nodes own: the default
1004/// run type's from ci/expected-e2e-plan.json (dereferencing to them), and
1005/// each run type a node selects by label from the manifests themselves.
1006struct Populations {
1007    full: Vec<DagManifest>,
1008    labelled: BTreeMap<&'static str, Vec<DagManifest>>,
1009}
1010
1011impl std::ops::Deref for Populations {
1012    type Target = Vec<DagManifest>;
1013
1014    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
1015        &self.full
1016    }
1017}
1018
1019impl Populations {
1020    /// The required cells of the run type `label` selects: its labelled
1021    /// cells when a node selects it by label, else the default run type's
1022    /// subset for that profile.
1023    fn for_label(&self, label: &str) -> Vec<&DagManifest> {
1024        match self.labelled.get(label) {
1025            Some(cells) => cells.iter().collect(),
1026            None => expected_for_label(label, &self.full),
1027        }
1028    }
1029
1030    /// The cells a manifest bucket node owns.
1031    fn owned_by(&self, step: &Step) -> Vec<&DagManifest> {
1032        let Some(selector) = &step.manifest else {
1033            return Vec::new();
1034        };
1035        let cells = match crate::validation_dag_static::manifest_run_type(&step.tag()) {
1036            Some(label) => self.labelled.get(label).map_or(&[][..], Vec::as_slice),
1037            None => &self.full[..],
1038        };
1039        cells
1040            .iter()
1041            .filter(|cell| cell.lane == selector.lane && cell.category == selector.category)
1042            .collect()
1043    }
1044
1045    fn all(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &DagManifest> {
1046        self.full.iter().chain(self.labelled.values().flatten())
1047    }
1048}
1049
1050fn expected_cells(root: &Path) -> Result<Populations, String> {
1051    let path = root.join(EXPECTED_PLAN);
1052    let text = fs::read_to_string(&path)
1053        .map_err(|error| format!("cannot read {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
1054    let full = expected_cells_from_json(&text)
1055        .map_err(|error| format!("invalid {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
1056    let owners = crate::execution_owners::ExecutionOwners::load(root)?;
1057    for cell in &full {
1058        if owners.owner(cell.backend.as_deref())? != "core" {
1059            return Err(format!(
1060                "{EXPECTED_PLAN} still claims a transferred cell; regenerate the actual core expected plan and retain that identity in its extension owner"
1061            ));
1062        }
1063    }
1064    let manifests = crate::runner::ManifestSet::load(root)?;
1065    let mut labelled = BTreeMap::new();
1066    for label in crate::validation_dag_static::manifest_run_types() {
1067        if owners.run_type_owner(label) != "core" {
1068            continue;
1069        }
1070        let cells = manifests
1071            .select(&crate::runner::Selection {
1072                population: Some(crate::runner::Population::Required),
1073                execution_backends: Some(owners.backends("core")?),
1074                labels: vec![label.to_string()],
1075                ..Default::default()
1076            })?
1077            .into_iter()
1078            .map(|cell| DagManifest {
1079                lane: cell.test.lane.clone(),
1080                category: cell.category.clone(),
1081                test: Some(cell.id.test.clone()),
1082                mode: Some(cell.id.mode.clone()),
1083                backend: cell.id.backend.clone(),
1084            })
1085            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1086        if cells.is_empty() {
1087            return Err(format!("run type {label} requires no manifest cell"));
1088        }
1089        labelled.insert(label, cells);
1090    }
1091    Ok(Populations { full, labelled })
1092}
1093
1094/// Decode the same source-owned expected population for generation and retained
1095/// plan verification. Duplicates are refused before constructing any set.
1096pub fn expected_cells_from_json(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<DagManifest>, String> {
1097    let plan: ExpectedPlan = serde_json::from_str(text)
1098        .map_err(|error| format!("invalid expected E2E plan: {error}"))?;
1099    if plan.schema != 1 {
1100        return Err("expected E2E plan schema must be 1".into());
1101    }
1102    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
1103    let mut cells = Vec::new();
1104    for cell in plan.cells {
1105        if [
1106            &cell.lane,
1107            &cell.category,
1108            &cell.test,
1109            &cell.mode,
1110            &cell.backend,
1111        ]
1112        .iter()
1113        .any(|field| field.trim().is_empty())
1114            || cell
1115                .requires_host_capabilities
1116                .iter()
1117                .any(|field| field.trim().is_empty())
1118        {
1119            return Err("expected E2E plan contains an empty identity or capability".into());
1120        }
1121        let cell: DagManifest = cell.into();
1122        if !seen.insert(result_identity(&cell)) {
1123            return Err("expected E2E plan contains a duplicate cell identity".into());
1124        }
1125        cells.push(cell);
1126    }
1127    Ok(cells)
1128}
1129
1130fn normalize_step(step: &mut Step, root: &Path, run_state: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
1131    let root = root
1132        .to_str()
1133        .ok_or_else(|| "repository root is not valid UTF-8".to_string())?;
1134    let run_state = run_state
1135        .to_str()
1136        .ok_or_else(|| "generator scratch path is not valid UTF-8".to_string())?;
1137    step.result_manifests = Some(
1138        step.result_manifests
1139            .take()
1140            .unwrap_or_default()
1141            .into_iter()
1142            .filter(|manifest| matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)))
1143            .collect(),
1144    );
1145    step.cmd = step
1146        .cmd
1147        .replace(run_state, "$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE")
1148        .replace(root, "$PWD");
1149    step.desc = step
1150        .desc
1151        .replace(run_state, "$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE")
1152        .replace(root, "$PWD");
1153    step.description = step
1154        .description
1155        .replace(run_state, "$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE")
1156        .replace(root, "$PWD");
1157    for value in step.env.values_mut() {
1158        *value = value
1159            .replace(run_state, "$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE")
1160            .replace(root, "$PWD");
1161    }
1162    if step.timeout <= 0 || step.cpu_timeout <= 0 {
1163        return Err(format!(
1164            "{} does not carry explicit wall/CPU budgets: wall={} cpu={}",
1165            step.tag(),
1166            step.timeout,
1167            step.cpu_timeout
1168        ));
1169    }
1170    if step.hint.rss_baseline_bytes.is_none() && step.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes.is_none() {
1171        return Err(format!(
1172            "{} does not carry an explicit memory budget",
1173            step.tag()
1174        ));
1175    }
1176    Ok(())
1177}
1178
1179fn shell_quote(value: &str) -> String {
1180    if !value.is_empty()
1181        && value
1182            .bytes()
1183            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"@%+=:,./-_".contains(&byte))
1184    {
1185        return value.to_string();
1186    }
1187    format!("'{}'", value.replace('\'', r"'\''"))
1188}

1190fn pinned_root_twin_tag(tag: &str) -> String {

1202fn hosted_resource_tuples(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<Vec<(String, String, i64, i64)>, String> {
1203    let selected = select_steps_by_labels(cfg, &[HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL.to_string()])?;
1204    let mut tuples = Vec::new();
1205    for step in &selected.steps {
1206        let tag = step.tag();
1207        let tag = tag
1208            .strip_suffix(HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX)
1209            .unwrap_or(&tag)
1210            .to_string();
1211        for (resource, demand) in &step.hint.resources {
1212            let capacity = selected
1213                .resource_caps
1214                .get(resource)
1215                .copied()
1216                .ok_or_else(|| {
1217                    format!(
1218                        "{HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL} step {} demands undeclared resource {resource}",
1219                        step.tag()
1220                    )
1221                })?;
1222            tuples.push((tag.clone(), resource.clone(), *demand, capacity));
1223        }
1224    }
1225    tuples.sort();
1226    Ok(tuples)
1227}

1229fn is_pinned_root_producer(step: &Step) -> bool {
1230    PINNED_ROOT_PRODUCER_STEPS.contains(&step.tag().as_str())
1231        || step.job == "manifest_guests"
1232        || (step.job == "privileged_tests"
1233            && step.cmd.contains("cargo ")
1234            && step.cmd.contains("publish-hermit-e2e-artifact.sh"))
1235}

1284fn runs_in_pinned_root(step: &Step) -> bool {

1286        && !HOST_MANIFEST_RUNS.contains(&step.tag().as_str())
1287        && !is_buck_import_twin(step)
1288        && (is_manifest_run(step) || PINNED_ROOT_EXECUTION_STEPS.contains(&step.tag().as_str()))

1291/// The host-side name of the one Hermit binary that build.e2e_artifact publishes
1292/// inside the pinned root at target/ci/hermit.
1293pub(crate) const HOST_HERMIT_LINK_TAG: &str = "build.host_hermit_link";
1294
1295/// Route the local host consumers of the Hermit producers to the pinned-root
1296/// build.
1297///
1298/// The focused compatibility run types exercise host-installed programs that
1299/// the pinned image does not carry, so they, and the fixtures they read, still
1300/// run on the host. They reach the one Hermit through build.host_hermit_link,
1301/// which
1302/// links the host's target/ci/hermit to the pinned root's published binary; that
1303/// binary runs on the host because its loader and libraries are the host nix
1304/// store paths the image was built from. No local host step may depend on the
1305/// workspace build itself.
1306fn route_host_consumers_to_pinned_build(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
1307    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
1308        if is_hosted_variant(step)
1309            || (is_pinned_root_producer(step) && step.tag() != "compatprep.fixtures")
1310            || step.job.ends_with(PINNED_ROOT_TWIN_SUFFIX)
1311            || step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ")
1312            || !step
1313                .labels
1314                .iter()
1315                .any(|label| label != HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
1316        {
1317            continue;
1318        }
1319        let tag = step.tag();
1320        for dependency in &mut step.deps {
1321            if dependency == "build.workspace" {
1322                return Err(format!(
1323                    "local host step {tag} depends on build.workspace; only the pinned root builds Hermit"
1324                ));
1325            }
1326            // The corpus-only lane builds its release Hermit in the pinned
1327            // root; the host producer drops that lane's label.
1328            if dependency == "compatprep.hermit_release"
1329                && step.labels == ["portable-strict-compat-only"]
1330            {
1331                *dependency = pinned_root_twin_tag("compatprep.hermit_release");
1332            }
1333            if dependency == "build.e2e_artifact" {
1334                *dependency = if tag == HOST_HERMIT_LINK_TAG {
1335                    pinned_root_twin_tag("build.e2e_artifact")
1336                } else {
1337                    HOST_HERMIT_LINK_TAG.into()
1338                };
1339            }
1340        }
1341        step.deps.sort();
1342        step.deps.dedup();
1343    }
1344    Ok(())
1345}
1346
1347/// A pinned-root producer that compiles or publishes Hermit itself, as opposed
1348/// to the host tooling producers (rust scripts, the manifest plan, the manifest
1349/// guests) whose host and pinned-root copies test-harness validate requires.
1350fn builds_hermit(step: &Step) -> bool {
1351    matches!(
1352        step.tag().as_str(),
1353        "build.workspace"
1354            | "build.e2e_artifact"
1355            | "build.liteinst_allocator_fixtures"
1356            | LITEINST_RUNTIME_TAG
1357    ) || step.job == "privileged_tests"
1358}
1359
1360/// Retire host copies of the Hermit producers that no local host step consumes.
1361///
1362/// Every producer in [`PINNED_ROOT_PRODUCER_STEPS`] gains an `_in_pinned_root`
1363/// twin, and the local profiles consume the twins. A host copy of a Hermit
1364/// producer survives in a local profile only while some local host step still
1365/// depends on it. Until 2026-09-30 the host originals of build.workspace,
1366/// build.runtime_release, build.e2e_artifact and build.liteinst_runtime_release
1367/// kept their local labels and a full validation compiled Hermit on the host as
1368/// well as in the pinned root. An unconsumed copy keeps only its hosted-portable
1369/// label, or is removed when it has none. Host tooling producers are left as
1370/// they are.
1371fn retire_unconsumed_host_producers(cfg: &mut DagConfig) {
1372    loop {
1373        let before = (
1374            cfg.steps.len(),
1375            cfg.steps.iter().map(|s| s.labels.len()).sum::<usize>(),
1376        );
1377        let tags = cfg
1378            .steps
1379            .iter()
1380            .filter(|step| {
1381                is_pinned_root_producer(step)
1382                    && builds_hermit(step)
1383                    && !is_hosted_variant(step)
1384                    && !step.job.ends_with(PINNED_ROOT_TWIN_SUFFIX)
1385            })
1386            .map(Step::tag)
1387            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1388        for tag in tags {
1389            let local_consumer = cfg.steps.iter().any(|step| {
1390                step.tag() != tag
1391                    && step
1392                        .labels
1393                        .iter()
1394                        .any(|label| label != HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
1395                    && step.deps.iter().any(|dependency| dependency == &tag)
1396            });
1397            let any_consumer = cfg
1398                .steps
1399                .iter()
1400                .any(|step| step.deps.iter().any(|dependency| dependency == &tag));
1401            if local_consumer {
1402                continue;
1403            }
1404            let step = cfg
1405                .steps
1406                .iter_mut()
1407                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
1408                .expect("tag was collected from these steps");
1409            step.labels.retain(|label| label == HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL);
1410            if step.labels.is_empty() && !any_consumer {
1411                cfg.steps.retain(|step| step.tag() != tag);
1412            }
1413        }
1414        let after = (
1415            cfg.steps.len(),
1416            cfg.steps.iter().map(|s| s.labels.len()).sum::<usize>(),
1417        );
1418        if after == before {
1419            break;
1420        }
1421    }
1422}

1424// Dagrun appends admitted argv after the complete wrapper command. Re-quote
1425// each resulting argument before appending it to the original shell payload;
1426// preserve literal bytes and the original command's argument placement.
1427pub const PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD: &str = r#"/src/ci/hermetic/assert-no-network.sh && /src/ci/hermetic/assert-build-dependencies.sh && hermit_payload=$1 && shift && if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then printf -v hermit_extra ' %q' "$@"; hermit_payload+=$hermit_extra; fi && exec bash -c "$hermit_payload""#;
1428pub(super) const LEGACY_PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD: &str = r#"/src/ci/hermetic/assert-no-network.sh && /src/ci/hermetic/assert-build-dependencies.sh && exec bash -c "$1""#;
1429
1430fn needs_proc_locks_runtime(tag: &str) -> bool {
1431    matches!(
1432        tag,
1433        "test.hermit_integration"
1434            | "test.hermit_integration_2"
1435            | "test.hermit_integration_3"
1436            | "e2e.manifest_c_programs"
1437            | "quick.e2e_verify"
1438    )
1439}
1440
1441fn pinned_root_command(step: &Step) -> String {
1442    let mut env_names = PINNED_ROOT_FORWARDED_ENV
1443        .iter()
1444        .copied()
1445        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1446    if is_manifest_run(step)
1447        || step
1448            .structured_test_results_manifest()
1449            .ok()
1450            .flatten()
1451            .is_some()
1452    {
1453        env_names.insert("DAGRUN_TEST_COUNTS_PATH");
1454    }
1455    if !step.publishes.is_empty() {
1456        env_names.insert("DAGRUN_ARTIFACT_READY_DIR");
1457        env_names.insert("DAGRUN_OUTER_RUN");
1458    }
1459    env_names.extend(step.env.keys().map(String::as_str));
1460    // A width channel that the root does not forward leaves the command at its
1461    // own default however wide the step was admitted.
1462    env_names.extend(step.jobs_env.as_deref().filter(|name| !name.is_empty()));
1463    let mut argv = vec![
1464        "./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh".to_string(),
1465        "--src".into(),
1466        ".".into(),
1467        "--out".into(),
1468        "ignored/hermetic/split".into(),
1469        "--src-rw".into(),
1470        "--cargo-home".into(),
1471        "ignored/hermetic/split/cargo".into(),
1472    ];
1473    // Proc-locks snapshots include OFD locks from other PID namespaces. Share
1474    // the native host lease inode, not one file per container or validation.
1475    if needs_proc_locks_runtime(&step.tag()) {
1476        argv.push("--proc-locks-runtime".into());
1477    }
1478    if step.tag() == "test.regular_crates" {
1479        argv.push("--nextest-calibration".into());
1480    }
1481    for name in env_names {
1482        argv.extend(["--env".into(), name.into()]);
1483    }
1484    argv.extend([
1485        "--".into(),
1486        "bash".into(),
1487        "-c".into(),
1488        PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD.into(),
1489        "bash".into(),
1490        if step.tag() == "test.regular_crates" {
1491            step.cmd.replace("./ci/run-nextest-counted.sh", "./ci/run-nextest-counted.sh --calibration-launch-proof /run/hermit-nextest-launch.json")
1492        } else { step.cmd.clone() },
1493    ]);
1494    argv.iter()
1495        .map(|argument| shell_quote(argument))
1496        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1497        .join(" ")
1498}

1500// The authored source already contains wrapped manifest commands. Keep their
1501// command payload unchanged while carrying the current environment policy into
1502// the outer wrapper; otherwise only newly cloned producers see added settings.
1503pub(crate) fn refresh_pinned_root_environment(tag: &str, command: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
1504    let (header, payload) = command
1505        .split_once(" -- bash -c ")
1506        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{tag} has an unrecognized pinned-root command boundary"))?;
1507    let words = header.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
1508    let mut refreshed = header.to_owned();
1509    let lease_options = words
1510        .iter()
1511        .filter(|word| **word == "--proc-locks-runtime")
1512        .count();
1513    match (needs_proc_locks_runtime(tag), lease_options) {
1514        (true, 0) => {
1515            let position = header.find(" --env ").unwrap_or(header.len());
1516            refreshed.insert_str(position, " --proc-locks-runtime");
1517        }
1518        (true, 1) | (false, 0) => {}
1519        _ => return Err(format!("{tag} has an unexpected proc-locks runtime option")),
1520    }
1521    for name in PINNED_ROOT_FORWARDED_ENV {
1522        let count = words
1523            .windows(2)
1524            .filter(|pair| pair[0] == "--env" && pair[1] == *name)
1525            .count();
1526        match count {
1527            0 => refreshed.push_str(&format!(" --env {name}")),
1528            1 => {}
1529            _ => {
1530                return Err(format!(
1531                    "{tag} forwards pinned-root environment name {name} more than once"
1532                ));
1533            }
1534        }
1535    }
1536    let legacy = format!("{} bash ", shell_quote(LEGACY_PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD));
1537    let current = format!("{} bash ", shell_quote(PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD));
1538    let payload = if let Some(command) = payload.strip_prefix(&legacy) {
1539        format!("{current}{command}")
1540    } else if payload.starts_with(&current) {
1541        payload.to_owned()
1542    } else {
1543        return Err(format!("{tag} has an unrecognized pinned-root argv guard"));
1544    };
1545    Ok(format!("{refreshed} -- bash -c {payload}"))
1546}
1547
1548/// The fetch node. Its memory cap, 1.75 GiB, is sized for a COLD Cargo home,
1549/// not the warm shared one ordinary runs reuse (where the fetch takes 16-18 s).
1550/// Measured 2026-10-08 at hermit 8d464d3b, `run-split-validate.sh --fetch-only`
1551/// with no seed and no cap: peaks of 1,133,400,064 and 1,142,509,568 bytes
1552/// (most of it page cache from writing a ~958 MB Cargo home), 20-22 s. The
1553/// earlier 1 GiB cap OOM-killed every cold fetch, which is every
1554/// `--frozen-validate` run, because such a run starts with an empty Cargo home.
1555/// 1.5x the higher peak is 1,713,764,352 bytes, rounded up to 7 x 256 MiB.
1556fn pinned_root_fetch() -> Result<Step, String> {
1557    let text = format!(
1558        r#"{{"description":"Pinned-root fetch node","steps":[{{"group":"setup","job":"pinned_root_fetch","desc":"Fetch locked Cargo inputs","description":"Fetch locked Cargo inputs before network-disabled pinned-root commands.","cmd":{},"deps":[],"env":{{"VALIDATE_VERBOSITY":"1"}},"labels":[],"result_manifests":[],"timeout":600,"cpu_timeout":600,"hint":{{"rss_baseline_bytes":1879048192,"hard_mem_max_bytes":1879048192}},"fail_fast_family":"setup.pinned_root_fetch"}}]}}"#,
1559        serde_json::to_string(PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_COMMAND).expect("constant is serializable")
1560    );
1561    let mut step = dag_from_json(&text)
1562        .map_err(|error| format!("internal pinned-root fetch node is invalid: {error}"))?
1563        .steps
1564        .into_iter()
1565        .next()
1566        .ok_or_else(|| "internal pinned-root fetch node disappeared".to_string())?;
1567    step.deps = vec!["pre.reverie_pin".into()];
1568    Ok(step)
1569}
1570
1571/// One directly constructed pinned producer step of the native-exec cohort
1572/// pair, in the shape `split_pinned_workspace_twin` leaves its halves:
1573/// pinned dependencies and environment set, payload wrapped by
1574/// `pinned_root_command`. The cohort environment (slug and target
1575/// directory) comes from the one cohort declaration, exactly as
1576/// `materialize` attaches it to the authored consumer.
1577struct NativeExecPinnedStep {
1578    job: &'static str,
1579    desc: &'static str,
1580    description: &'static str,
1581    payload: String,
1582    deps: &'static [&'static str],
1583    est_duration_s: f64,
1584    timeout: i64,
1585    cpu_timeout: i64,
1586}
1587
1588fn native_exec_pinned_step(spec: NativeExecPinnedStep) -> Result<Step, String> {
1589    let NativeExecPinnedStep {
1590        job,
1591        desc,
1592        description,
1593        payload,
1594        deps,
1595        est_duration_s,
1596        timeout,
1597        cpu_timeout,
1598    } = spec;
1599    let cohort = crate::nextest_binaries::NATIVE_EXEC_COHORT;
1600    // Dependencies are assigned after the parse, like the fetch node's:
1601    // dag_from_json refuses a dependency no step in its own document
1602    // declares, and these producers depend on nodes of the full graph.
1603    let text = format!(
1604        r#"{{"description":"native-exec pinned producer","steps":[{{"group":"build","job":{job},"desc":{desc},"description":{description},"cmd":{cmd},"deps":[],"env":{{"HERMIT_E2E_EMPTY_WORKDIR":"/test",{cohort_env}:{slug},"CARGO_TARGET_DIR":{target_dir}}},"labels":["full","portable"],"result_manifests":[],"timeout":{timeout},"cpu_timeout":{cpu_timeout},"jobs_flag":"","jobs_env":"CARGO_BUILD_JOBS","hint":{{"est_duration_s":{est_duration_s},"rss_baseline_bytes":15032385536,"hard_mem_max_bytes":19327352832,"classification":"cpu-bound","preferred_inner_jobs":32}},"fail_fast_family":{family}}}]}}"#,
1605        job = serde_json::to_string(job).expect("constant is serializable"),
1606        desc = serde_json::to_string(desc).expect("constant is serializable"),
1607        description = serde_json::to_string(description).expect("constant is serializable"),
1608        cmd = serde_json::to_string(&payload).expect("constant is serializable"),
1609        cohort_env = serde_json::to_string(crate::nextest_binaries::COHORT_ENV)
1610            .expect("constant is serializable"),
1611        slug = serde_json::to_string(cohort.env_value().expect("native cohort has a slug"))
1612            .expect("constant is serializable"),
1613        target_dir = serde_json::to_string(
1614            cohort
1615                .target_dir()
1616                .expect("native cohort has a target directory")
1617        )
1618        .expect("constant is serializable"),
1619        family = serde_json::to_string(&format!("build.{job}")).expect("constant is serializable"),
1620    );
1621    let mut step = dag_from_json(&text)
1622        .map_err(|error| format!("internal native-exec producer node is invalid: {error}"))?
1623        .steps
1624        .into_iter()
1625        .next()
1626        .ok_or_else(|| "internal native-exec producer node disappeared".to_string())?;
1627    step.deps = deps.iter().map(|dependency| (*dependency).into()).collect();
1628    step.cmd = pinned_root_command(&step);
1629    Ok(step)
1630}

1632/// The native-exec cohort's compile and prepare producers, constructed in
1633/// their pinned form (no host node consumes them). Called after
1634/// `materialize_pinned_root`, whose retention would otherwise drop
1635/// authored `_in_pinned_root` jobs; admission is through
1636/// `POST_SPLIT_CORE_NODES` like every post-split node.
1637fn materialize_native_exec_producers(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
1638    let environment = crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_ENVIRONMENT;
1639    let selection = crate::nextest_build_selections::for_step("test.hermit_native_exec")
1640        .ok_or("test.hermit_native_exec has no declared Cargo build selection")?
1641        .join(" ");
1642    let compile = native_exec_pinned_step(NativeExecPinnedStep {
1643        job: PINNED_NATIVE_EXEC_COMPILE_JOB,
1644        desc: PINNED_NATIVE_EXEC_COMPILE_DESC,
1645        description: PINNED_NATIVE_EXEC_COMPILE_DESCRIPTION,
1646        payload: format!(
1647            "{environment}./ci/run-with-core-build.sh cargo build --locked --profile validate {selection} && ./ci/run-with-core-build.sh cargo build --locked -p hermit-manifest-plan --bin nextest-cpu-wrapper"
1648        ),
1649        deps: &["pre.reverie_pin", PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_TAG],
1650        est_duration_s: 350.0,
1651        timeout: 600,
1652        cpu_timeout: 4200,
1653    })?;
1654    let prepare = native_exec_pinned_step(NativeExecPinnedStep {
1655        job: PINNED_NATIVE_EXEC_PREPARE_JOB,
1656        desc: PINNED_NATIVE_EXEC_PREPARE_DESC,
1657        description: PINNED_NATIVE_EXEC_PREPARE_DESCRIPTION,
1658        payload: format!(
1659            "{environment}{}",
1660            crate::nextest_binaries::cohort_prepare_command(
1661                "full",
1662                crate::nextest_binaries::NATIVE_EXEC_COHORT
1663            )?
1664        ),
1665        deps: &[
1666            PINNED_NATIVE_EXEC_COMPILE_TAG,
1667            PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG,
1668            "pre.reverie_pin",
1669            PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_TAG,
1670        ],
1671        est_duration_s: 260.0,
1672        timeout: 600,
1673        cpu_timeout: 1800,
1674    })?;
1675    cfg.steps.push(compile);
1676    cfg.steps.push(prepare);
1677    Ok(())
1678}

1680/// Add the hosted label to the corpus-derived portable compatibility rows.
1681///
1682/// Authored hosted steps and host-only variants come from the independent typed
1683/// source. The corpus rows are regenerated, so their label is derived here from
1684/// their typed generated partition rather than copied from the output artifact.
1685fn materialize_hosted_portable_selection(cfg: &mut DagConfig) {
1686    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
1687        if generated_partition(step) == Some(GeneratedPartition::PortableCompat)
1688            && !step
1689                .labels
1690                .iter()
1691                .any(|label| label == HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
1692        {
1693            step.labels.push(HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL.into());
1694            step.labels.sort();
1695            step.labels.dedup();
1696        }
1697    }
1698}

1700/// Separate the hosted dependency closure without dropping fixture success checks.
1701/// Generated compatibility rows keep their commands and run-state paths; only
1702/// their hosted identity and dependencies change. Runtime consumes these nodes.
1703fn materialize_hosted_test_variants(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
1704    let mut split = cfg
1705        .steps
1706        .iter()
1707        .filter(|step| {
1708            runs_in_pinned_root(step)
1709                && step
1710                    .labels
1711                    .iter()
1712                    .any(|label| label == HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
1713        })
1714        .map(Step::tag)
1715        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1716    // 16 until test.dbt_parity was retired (slice S13 of
1717    // https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301); 15 until the one-build
1718    // change of 2026-09-30 moved the host consumers of the retired host Hermit
1719    // build into the pinned root: check.dbt_runtime_abi,
1720    // check.backend_parity_suites, lint.clippy, doc.doctests and doc.rustdoc,
1721    // which were already in this split's dependency closure and became its
1722    // roots; 20 until check.backend_parity_suites was retired with
1723    // tests/backend-parity (also slice S13). 20 since test.detcore_time and its hosted twin were enrolled.
1724    // 19 since test.liteinst_strict, whose hosted twin was
1725    // test.liteinst_strict_on_host, was retired with the LiteInst host hybrid
1726    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3520).
1727    let expected_roots = crate::dag_source_ownership::hosted_split_tags(false);
1728    if split != expected_roots {
1729        return Err(format!(
1730            "hosted core roots changed: {split:?} != {expected_roots:?}"
1731        ));
1732    }
1733
1734    // The hosted test consumers need a producer whose prepared population and
1735    // metadata belong to their committed profile. Keep the shared test cases
1736    // and features, including kvm-native-test-support, while separating the
1737    // hosted artifact identity from the pinned local producer.
1738    // Split the producer before closing over its shared downstream consumers,
1739    // so no hosted path retains a dependency on the local full producer.
1740    split.insert("build.workspace".into());
1741    loop {
1742        let previous = split.len();
1743        for step in &cfg.steps {
1744            if step
1745                .labels
1746                .iter()
1747                .any(|label| label == HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
1748                && step
1749                    .labels
1750                    .iter()
1751                    .any(|label| label != HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
1752                && step
1753                    .deps
1754                    .iter()
1755                    .any(|dependency| split.contains(dependency))
1756            {
1757                split.insert(step.tag());
1758            }
1759        }
1760        if split.len() == previous {
1761            break;
1762        }
1763    }
1764    // 213 until test.dbt_parity was retired (slice S13 of
1765    // https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301); 212 until the 189
1766    // compat.<program> nodes that depended on compatprep.fixtures became the
1767    // e2e.manifest_compat bucket (2026-10-01), whose hosted twin is authored.
1768    // 23 until check.backend_parity_suites was retired with
1769    // tests/backend-parity (also slice S13). 23 since test.detcore_time and its hosted twin were enrolled.
1770    // 22 since test.liteinst_strict, one of the split's roots, was retired
1771    // with the LiteInst host hybrid (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3520).
1772    let expected_closure = crate::dag_source_ownership::hosted_split_tags(true);
1773    if split != expected_closure {
1774        return Err(format!(
1775            "hosted core dependency closure changed: {split:?} != {expected_closure:?}"
1776        ));
1777    }
1778
1779    let mut variants = Vec::new();
1780    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
1781        if split.contains(&step.tag()) {
1782            let mut hosted = step.clone();
1783            if hosted.tag() == "test.rr_suite_contract" {
1784                if hosted.cmd.matches(RR_SUITE_SELECTION).count() != 1 {
1785                    return Err(format!(
1786                        "test.rr_suite_contract must select `{RR_SUITE_SELECTION}` once"
1787                    ));
1788                }
1789                hosted.cmd = hosted.cmd.replacen(
1790                    RR_SUITE_SELECTION,
1791                    &format!(
1792                        "--test rr_suite{} -j 1",
1793                        hosted_exclusion_filterset(HOSTED_PORTABLE_PMU_TIMER_RR_TESTS)
1794                    ),
1795                    1,
1796                );
1797            }
1798            if hosted.tag() == "test.hermit_unit" {
1799                if hosted.cmd.matches(HERMIT_UNIT_ARGUMENTS).count() != 1 {
1800                    return Err(format!(
1801                        "test.hermit_unit must pass its test binary's arguments after one \
1802                         `{HERMIT_UNIT_ARGUMENTS}`"
1803                    ));
1804                }
1805                hosted.cmd = hosted.cmd.replacen(
1806                    HERMIT_UNIT_ARGUMENTS,
1807                    &format!(
1808                        "{}{HERMIT_UNIT_ARGUMENTS}",
1809                        hosted_exclusion_filterset(
1810                            HOSTED_PORTABLE_CPUID_FAULTING_HERMIT_UNIT_TESTS
1811                        )
1812                    ),
1813                    1,
1814                );
1815            }
1816            hosted.job.push_str(HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX);
1817            hosted.labels = vec![HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL.into()];
1818            hosted.fail_fast_family = Some(hosted.tag());
1819            // Hosted twins carry no pinned population: each counted node is
1820            // census-guarded on its own listed IDs (see
1821            // validation_dag_static's note on the retired count table).
1822            let owner = hosted.tag();
1823            for result in hosted.result_manifests.iter_mut().flatten() {
1824                if let ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(result) = result {
1825                    result.owner = owner.clone();
1826                }
1827            }
1828            step.labels.retain(|label| label != HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL);
1829            variants.push(hosted);
1830        }
1831    }
1832    cfg.steps.extend(variants);
1833    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
1834        if step.labels == [HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL] {
1835            for dependency in &mut step.deps {
1836                if split.contains(dependency) {
1837                    dependency.push_str(HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX);
1838                }
1839            }
1840        }
1841    }
1842    let hosted_workspace = cfg
1843        .steps
1844        .iter_mut()
1845        .find(|step| step.tag() == "build.workspace_on_host")
1846        .ok_or("hosted workspace producer is absent")?;
1847    let local_prepare = "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs prepare full --build-mode \"${HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUILD_MODE:-cargo}\"";
1848    if hosted_workspace.cmd.matches(local_prepare).count() != 1 {
1849        return Err("hosted workspace producer lost the exact local preparation command".into());
1850    }
1851    hosted_workspace.cmd = hosted_workspace.cmd.replace(
1852        local_prepare,
1853        "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs prepare hosted-portable",
1854    );
1855    // The hosted profile has its own selections, so its workspace build
1856    // compiles their union rather than the local full profile's.
1857    let local_prebuild = crate::nextest_binaries::unified_prebuild_command(cfg, "full")?;
1858    let hosted_prebuild =
1859        crate::nextest_binaries::unified_prebuild_command(cfg, HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)?;
1860    let hosted_workspace = cfg
1861        .steps
1862        .iter_mut()
1863        .find(|step| step.tag() == "build.workspace_on_host")
1864        .ok_or("hosted workspace producer is absent")?;
1865    let local_prebuild = local_prebuild.replace(
1866        "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs prepare full --build-mode \"${HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUILD_MODE:-cargo}\"",
1867        "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs prepare hosted-portable",
1868    );
1869    if hosted_workspace.cmd.matches(&local_prebuild).count() != 1 {
1870        return Err("hosted workspace producer lost the local unified workspace build".into());
1871    }
1872    hosted_workspace.cmd = hosted_workspace
1873        .cmd
1874        .replace(&local_prebuild, &hosted_prebuild);
1875    // The hosted runner builds at three Cargo workers on varying hardware, so
1876    // the hosted twin alone carries a longer wall; its CPU bound and memory
1877    // hints stay the local node's. See HOSTED_WORKSPACE_WALL_DESCRIPTION.
1878    if hosted_workspace.timeout != crate::validation_dag_static::WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS {
1879        return Err(format!(
1880            "hosted workspace producer inherited a {}s wall, not build.workspace's {}s",
1881            hosted_workspace.timeout,
1882            crate::validation_dag_static::WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS
1883        ));
1884    }
1885    hosted_workspace.timeout = crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS;
1886    hosted_workspace
1887        .description
1888        .push_str(crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_WORKSPACE_WALL_DESCRIPTION);
1889    // The publisher verifies the binary it publishes against the preparation
1890    // record of the profile its workspace producer prepared.
1891    let hosted_publisher = cfg
1892        .steps
1893        .iter_mut()
1894        .find(|step| step.tag() == "build.e2e_artifact_on_host")
1895        .ok_or("hosted E2E publisher is absent")?;
1896    let local_assert = "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs assert full";
1897    if hosted_publisher.cmd.matches(local_assert).count() != 1 {
1898        return Err("hosted E2E publisher lost the exact prepared-record assertion".into());
1899    }
1900    hosted_publisher.cmd = hosted_publisher.cmd.replace(
1901        local_assert,
1902        "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs assert hosted-portable",
1903    );
1904    Ok(())
1905}

1910/// The shards of the local [`HERMIT_INTEGRATION_TAG`], as (job, first binary,
1911/// estimated seconds).
1912///
1913/// Until 2026-10-15 its binaries ran one test at a time, under nextest's
1914/// former `hermit-serialized` group, so the node's wall time was the sum of
1915/// its tests' times: on 2bf536af the 407 tests took 312.5 s of a 312.6 s
1916/// nextest run, and the node ended the DAG's portable tail at +723 s, 327 s
1917/// after it started. Each shard now runs eight tests at a time (its width
1918/// channel is NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS): every guest these binaries build under
1919/// CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR goes to a `<name>-<pid>` path, so two test processes
1920/// of one binary never overwrite each other's program.
1921///
1922/// Each shard takes a contiguous range of binary names, from its first
1923/// binary up to the next shard's. Every shard runs the authored command, with
1924/// its prepared selection, and narrows the authored filter to its own
1925/// binaries, so a binary runs in exactly one shard.
1926/// A binary added to the node joins the shard whose range holds its name; the
1927/// shard's listed population is census-guarded like every counted node's. The
1928/// hosted twin is made before this split and runs the whole node.
1929///
1930/// The ranges and estimates are the per-binary sums of the PASS times of the
1931/// 2bf536af and 656b74d4 runs, averaged: 66, 123 and 125 s.
1932/// One shard: its job name, its first binary (None for the first shard) and
1933/// its estimated seconds.
1934pub type Shard = (&'static str, Option<&'static str>, f64);
1935
1936pub const HERMIT_INTEGRATION_SHARDS: &[Shard] = &[
1937    ("hermit_integration", None, 66.0),
1938    (
1939        "hermit_integration_2",
1940        Some("copy_file_range_refusal"),
1941        123.0,
1942    ),
1943    ("hermit_integration_3", Some("procfs_determinism"), 125.0),
1944];

2022/// The binaries of the shard at INDEX, from the node's sorted binary list.
2023fn shard_binaries<'a>(shards: &[Shard], binaries: &'a [String], index: usize) -> Vec<&'a String> {
2024    let start = shards[index].1;
2025    let end = shards.get(index + 1).and_then(|(_, first, _)| *first);
2026    binaries
2027        .iter()
2028        .filter(|binary| start.is_none_or(|start| binary.as_str() >= start))
2029        .filter(|binary| end.is_none_or(|end| binary.as_str() < end))
2030        .collect()
2031}
2032
2033/// Split every node in [`SHARDED_NODES`] into its shards.
2034fn materialize_shards(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
2035    for (tag, shards) in SHARDED_NODES {
2036        materialize_node_shards(cfg, tag, shards)?;
2037    }
2038    Ok(())
2039}
2040
2041/// Split the node TAG into SHARDS.
2042///
2043/// Each shard runs the authored command, with its prepared selection and
2044/// `--test` list, and narrows the authored filter to the shard's binaries:
2045/// `-E '(binary(=a) | ...) & (<authored filter>)'`. A binary therefore runs in
2046/// exactly one shard, and a binary's tests stay serialized there.
2047fn materialize_node_shards(cfg: &mut DagConfig, tag: &str, shards: &[Shard]) -> Result<(), String> {
2048    let index = cfg
2049        .steps
2050        .iter()
2051        .position(|step| step.tag() == tag)
2052        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{tag} is absent"))?;
2053    let authored = cfg.steps[index].clone();
2054    if authored
2055        .labels
2056        .iter()
2057        .any(|label| label == HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
2058    {
2059        return Err(format!("{tag} is split before its hosted twin is made"));
2060    }
2061    let binaries = authored
2062        .integration_test_binaries
2063        .clone()
2064        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{tag} declares no integration test binaries"))?;
2065    if !binaries.windows(2).all(|pair| pair[0] < pair[1]) {
2066        return Err(format!(
2067            "{tag} must list its integration test binaries sorted and once each"
2068        ));
2069    }
2070    // The shard filter is ANDed onto the authored one, which must be the one
2071    // filter and end the command.
2072    const FILTER: &str = " -E '";
2073    let Some((head, filter)) = authored.cmd.split_once(FILTER) else {
2074        return Err(format!("{tag} must end with one authored filter -E '...'"));
2075    };
2076    let Some(filter) = filter.strip_suffix('\'') else {
2077        return Err(format!("{tag} must end with one authored filter -E '...'"));
2078    };
2079    if authored.cmd.matches(" -E ").count() != 1 || filter.contains('\'') || filter.is_empty() {
2080        return Err(format!("{tag} must end with one authored filter -E '...'"));
2081    }
2082    let mut split = Vec::new();
2083    let mut covered = 0;
2084    for (shard_index, (job, _, estimate)) in shards.iter().enumerate() {
2085        let members = shard_binaries(shards, &binaries, shard_index);
2086        let (Some(first), Some(last)) = (members.first(), members.last()) else {
2087            return Err(format!("{tag} shard {job} has no binaries"));
2088        };
2089        covered += members.len();
2090        let mut shard = authored.clone();
2091        shard.job = (*job).into();
2092        let shard_tag = shard.tag();
2093        let selected = members
2094            .iter()
2095            .map(|binary| format!("binary(={binary})"))
2096            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
2097            .join(" | ");
2098        shard.cmd = format!("{head}{FILTER}({selected}) & ({filter})'");
2099        for result in shard.result_manifests.iter_mut().flatten() {
2100            if let ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(result) = result {
2101                result.owner = shard_tag.clone();
2102            }
2103        }
2104        shard.fail_fast_family = Some(shard_tag.clone());
2105        shard.hint.est_duration_s = *estimate;
2106        let position = shard_index + 1;
2107        let count = shards.len();
2108        shard.desc.push_str(&format!(
2109            " -- shard {position} of {count}, {first} to {last}"
2110        ));
2111        shard.description.push_str(&format!(
2112            " SHARD {position} of {count} (validation_dag::SHARDED_NODES): the {} binaries from {first} to {last}, selected by binary(=NAME) on top of the authored filter. Each shard runs the same prepared selection, and each binary runs in one shard, serialized there. The {estimate} s estimate is this shard's.",
2113            members.len()
2114        ));
2115        split.push(shard);
2116    }
2117    if covered != binaries.len() {
2118        return Err(format!(
2119            "{tag} shards cover {covered} of {} binaries",
2120            binaries.len()
2121        ));
2122    }
2123    cfg.steps.splice(index..=index, split);
2124    Ok(())
2125}

2127/// The authored script unit-test node, which the local lanes run.
2128const SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG: &str = "check.script_unit_tests";
2129/// Its hosted twin, which carries the longer hosted wall.

2132/// Give the hosted portable lane its own copy of check.script_unit_tests.

2134/// The hosted runner runs the node at three CPUs on slower hardware, so the
2135/// twin alone carries a longer wall; its command, dependencies, CPU bound and
2136/// memory hints stay the local node's. See
2137/// HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_DESCRIPTION for the measurement.
2138fn materialize_hosted_script_unit_tests(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
2139    let local = cfg
2140        .steps
2141        .iter_mut()
2142        .find(|step| step.tag() == SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)
2143        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} is absent"))?;
2144    if !local
2145        .labels
2146        .iter()
2147        .any(|label| label == HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
2148    {
2149        return Err(format!(
2150            "{SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} lost its {HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL} label"
2151        ));
2152    }
2153    if local.timeout != crate::validation_dag_static::SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_SECONDS {
2154        return Err(format!(
2155            "{SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} has a {}s wall, not its authored {}s",
2156            local.timeout,
2157            crate::validation_dag_static::SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_SECONDS
2158        ));
2159    }
2160    let mut hosted = local.clone();
2161    local.labels.retain(|label| label != HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL);
2162    hosted.job.push_str(HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX);
2163    hosted.labels = vec![HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL.into()];
2164    hosted.fail_fast_family = Some(hosted.tag());
2165    hosted.timeout = crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_SECONDS;
2166    hosted
2167        .description
2168        .push_str(crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_DESCRIPTION);
2169    cfg.steps.push(hosted);
2170    Ok(())
2171}

2173/// The label of the Buck E2E nodes a `--e2e-runner buck-local|buck-hybrid` full run
2174/// adds to the `full` selection; see [`buck_e2e_selection`].
2175pub const FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL: &str = "full-buck-e2e";
2176/// The host node that runs every E2E cell under Buck/Tpx.
2177///
2178/// Fail-fast exemption (owner early-exit directive, 2026-11-04): this
2179/// node deliberately runs EVERY cell even after one fails, in both
2180/// the default and `--keep-going` modes. All cells execute as one or
2181/// two parallel `buck2 test` invocations, the import twins judge the
2182/// complete row set, and a full run populates the RE test-result
2183/// cache that makes the next unchanged cell free. Stopping at the
2184/// first failing cell would break judging and waste the cache. The
2185/// node also emits no early-failure line: `ci/buck-e2e/run` captures
2186/// buck2's output to its work log and fetches verdicts with testx
2187/// only after the batch completes, so through this runner per-cell
2188/// results cannot stream; the first failure signal is the batch's
2189/// completion. The graph still aborts around it as usual.
2190pub const BUCK_CELLS_TAG: &str = "e2e.buck_cells";
2191/// The wall bound of e2e.buck_cells, in seconds, which ci/buck-e2e/validate-node
2192/// cannot read from dagrun.
2193const BUCK_STEP_WALL_ENV: &str = "HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUCK_STEP_WALL_SECONDS";
2194/// The host node that stages the inputs Buck does not build for
2195/// [`BUCK_CELLS_TAG`]. It needs only the pinned Reverie, so it runs beside the
2196/// rust-script build and the manifest-plan build that the cells wait for.
2197pub const BUCK_STAGE_TAG: &str = "e2e.buck_stage";
2198const BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX: &str = "_buck";
2199/// The assignment that puts a twin's `target/debug/test-harness run` in import mode,
2200/// naming where e2e.buck_cells leaves the Buck rows.
2201pub const BUCK_IMPORT_ASSIGNMENT: &str =
2202    "E2E_IMPORT_RESULTS=\"$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/buck-e2e/results\" ";
2203const BUCK_CELLS_COMMAND: &str = r#"export PATH="$PWD/ci/rust-script-bin:$PATH"; export HERMIT_RUST_SCRIPT_ARTIFACT_ROOT="$PWD/target/ci/rust-scripts"; export HERMIT_PREBUILT_RUST_SCRIPTS_REQUIRED=1; ./ci/buck-e2e/validate-node --cells-only"#;
2204/// The stage keeps the rust-script environment although it runs no rust-script
2205/// (its cargo builds, ci/publish-hermit-e2e-artifact.sh, `test-harness build` and
2206/// tests/compat/prepare_real_compat_fixtures.sh call none), so one added later
2207/// fails loudly instead of compiling unprepared. It no longer waits for
2208/// build.rust_scripts, so whether such a call finds the prepared binaries would
2209/// depend on timing: it would fail or run the prepared binary, never run
2210/// something unprepared.
2211const BUCK_STAGE_COMMAND: &str = r#"export PATH="$PWD/ci/rust-script-bin:$PATH"; export HERMIT_RUST_SCRIPT_ARTIFACT_ROOT="$PWD/target/ci/rust-scripts"; export HERMIT_PREBUILT_RUST_SCRIPTS_REQUIRED=1; ./ci/buck-e2e/validate-node --stage-only"#;

2213const FULL_SCORECARD_TAG: &str = "full-scorecard.compatibility";
2214/// The `full` nodes that exist only to build inputs for, or to run, the cargo
2215/// E2E buckets. A Buck full run drops them with the buckets they serve.
2216pub const BUCK_REPLACED_PRODUCERS: &[&str] = &[
2217    "build.host_hermit_link",
2218    "build.manifest_guests_in_pinned_root",
2219    "compatprep.fixtures",
2220    "privileged-build.manifest_guests_in_pinned_root",
2221    "setup.manifest_plan_in_pinned_root",
2222];

2224/// The two `full-buck-e2e` nodes that run the Buck runner itself rather than
2225/// replace a cargo node: the stage and the cells.
2226fn is_buck_runner_node(step: &Step) -> bool {
2227    matches!(step.tag().as_str(), BUCK_CELLS_TAG | BUCK_STAGE_TAG)
2228}
2229
2230fn is_buck_import_twin(step: &Step) -> bool {
2231    step.job.ends_with(BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX)
2232        && step.manifest.is_some()
2233        && step.labels == [FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL]
2234}

2236/// The `full` selection of a Buck E2E run: every `full` node except the cargo
2237/// E2E buckets, their scorecard and [`BUCK_REPLACED_PRODUCERS`], plus the
2238/// `full-buck-e2e` nodes: e2e.buck_stage, e2e.buck_cells, one import twin per
2239/// bucket and the twin scorecard. Each twin owns its bucket's cells and writes its bucket's
2240/// result files, so the selection reports the same cells at the same paths.
2241///
2242/// Refuses a `full` node that still depends on a replaced node, since the
2243/// label closure would silently bring the cargo path back.
2244pub fn buck_e2e_selection(committed: &DagConfig) -> Result<DagConfig, String> {
2245    let replaced = buck_replaced_tags(committed)?;
2246    let mut pruned = committed.clone();
2247    // Post-split extension nodes named *_buck (the rr twins and
2248    // build.reverie_buck) are part of this selection's population per the
2249    // registry contract; no exclusion is applied here. The bracket is
2250    // accounted for explicitly in validate.rs's runner plan and in
2251    // assert_buck_e2e_selection's dropped-set derivation below.
2252    for step in &mut pruned.steps {
2253        if replaced.contains(&step.tag()) {
2254            step.labels.retain(|label| label != "full");
2255        }
2256    }
2257    let selected =
2258        select_steps_by_labels(&pruned, &["full".to_string(), FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL.into()])?;
2259    let kept = selected
2260        .steps
2261        .iter()
2262        .map(Step::tag)
2263        .filter(|tag| replaced.contains(tag))
2264        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2265    if !kept.is_empty() {
2266        let dependents = selected
2267            .steps
2268            .iter()
2269            .filter(|step| step.deps.iter().any(|dep| kept.contains(dep)))
2270            .map(Step::tag)
2271            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2272        return Err(format!(
2273            "the Buck E2E selection still needs replaced node(s) {kept:?}, through {dependents:?}"
2274        ));
2275    }
2276    Ok(selected)
2277}

2316/// The preflight nodes the `--buck-s0` node runs beside, in dependency order.

2321/// Where each `--buck-s0` preflight node writes `<tag>.rc`, its exit status;
2322/// ci/buck-e2e/validate-node reads `$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/preflight/$tag.rc`.
2323const BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT_STATUS_DIR: &str = "$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/preflight";
2324/// Where each `--buck-s0` import twin writes `<tag>.rc`, its exit status, for
2325/// the last node ([`buck_no_cargo_job`]), which waits for every twin's record
2326/// instead of depending on the twins, so a failed twin does not skip it.
2327const BUCK_TWIN_STATUS_DIR: &str = "$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/twin-status";
2328/// The job of the first `--buck-s0` node, which removes an earlier execution's
2329/// preflight and twin records before the preflight and the twins write them or
2330/// validate-node and the last node wait for them. A run state is reused by a
2331/// plan export's scheduler (`<export dir>/run-state`) and by a nested payload,
2332/// and a record left there by an earlier execution would otherwise pass a wait
2333/// before this execution's node finished (`buck_s0_records`).
2334fn buck_records_job(name: &str) -> String {
2335    format!("buck_{name}_records")
2336}
2337
2338/// The command of the [`buck_records_job`] node, tagged `tag`. It refuses (exit 2, nothing
2339/// deleted) unless VALIDATE_RUN_STATE is an absolute path to an existing
2340/// directory, not a symbolic link, whose last component is named like a run
2341/// state (`run-<profile>-<pid>-<nonce>`, or a plan export's `run-state`); then
2342/// it removes only that directory's `preflight` and `twin-status` children.
2343fn clear_preflight_records(tag: &str) -> String {
2344    let refuse = format!(r#"refuse() {{ echo "{tag}: $1; nothing was deleted" >&2; exit 2; }}"#);
2345    let script = [
2346        refuse.as_str(),
2347        r#"d=${VALIDATE_RUN_STATE-}"#,
2348        r#"[[ -n $d ]] || refuse "VALIDATE_RUN_STATE is unset or empty""#,
2349        r#"[[ $d == /* ]] || refuse "VALIDATE_RUN_STATE=$d is not an absolute path""#,
2350        r#"name=${d##*/}"#,
2351        r#"[[ $name =~ ^run-[A-Za-z0-9-]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$ || $name == run-state ]] || refuse "VALIDATE_RUN_STATE=$d is not named like a run state (run-<profile>-<pid>-<nonce>, or a plan export's run-state)""#,
2352        r#"[[ -d $d && ! -L $d ]] || refuse "VALIDATE_RUN_STATE=$d is not an existing directory""#,
2353        r#"rm -rf -- "$d/preflight" "$d/twin-status""#,
2354    ]
2355    .join("; ");
2356    format!("bash -c {}", shell_quote(&script))
2357}

2359const BUCK_S0_AWAIT_PREFLIGHT_SECONDS_ENV: &str = "HERMIT_VALIDATE_AWAIT_PREFLIGHT_SECONDS";
