2388/// The buck2 daemon runs in its own systemd scope (buck2.slice), outside the
2389/// node's cgroup, so the node's box and CPU budget do not see the cells:
2390/// ci/buck-e2e/validate-node sets the scope's MemoryMax to this many bytes and
2391/// stops the daemon once the scope's CPU passes the node's CPU budget.
2392const BUCK_S0_DAEMON_MEMORY_MAX_ENV: &str = "HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUCK_DAEMON_MEMORY_MAX";
2393const BUCK_S0_DAEMON_CPU_SECONDS_ENV: &str = "HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUCK_DAEMON_CPU_SECONDS";
2394/// 32 GiB: 1.5 times the highest daemon-scope memory.peak measured in a cold
2395/// `--buck-s0` run of s0 (21.3 GiB on 2026-11-17, on the host named in
2396/// docs/TESTING_ENVIRONMENTS.md, Named measurement hosts; the range was
2397/// 12.4-21.3 GiB). Also the node's admission estimate, since dagrun cannot see
2398/// the daemon's memory to correct it.
2399const BUCK_S0_DAEMON_MEMORY_MAX_BYTES: i64 = 32 << 30;
2400
2401/// `cmd` with its exit status written to `<dir>/<tag>.rc` (by rename, so a
2402/// reader never sees half a file) and kept as the node's own. An EXIT trap set
2403/// before `cmd` writes the record, so `cmd` stays the END of the command
2404/// string: dagrun appends a step's inner-parallelism arguments there
2405/// (`dagrun::model::command_with_inner_jobs`, for example the c-programs
2406/// twin's `--jobs 8`), and they must reach `cmd`'s last program, not land
2407/// after a trailing `exit`. The trap runs on every exit of the node's shell,
2408/// an `exit` inside `cmd` and a `set -e` failure included, and its own `exit`
2409/// keeps the status.
2410///
2411/// dagrun ends a node it kills (at its wall or CPU budget, or on a
2412/// cancellation) with SIGTERM to the node's process group, then SIGKILL after
2413/// a grace. Bash runs the EXIT trap on that SIGTERM too, but `$?` there is the
2414/// status of the last command that completed, typically an earlier `export`,
2415/// so the record would read 0 for a killed node. The TERM, INT and HUP traps
2416/// therefore exit with the shell's own statuses for those signals (143, 130 and
2417/// 129), and the EXIT trap records that. A node killed by SIGKILL (for example
2418/// one whose child ignores SIGTERM, so its shell is still waiting when the
2419/// grace ends) writes no record, which leaves the reader to refuse when its
2420/// wait runs out. `cmd` must not set a trap of its own or `exec`, either of
2421/// which would drop or falsify the record ([`refuse_record_breakers`]).
2422///
2423/// The signal traps come BEFORE the EXIT trap. Once an EXIT trap is set, bash
2424/// handles TERM, INT and HUP itself and runs that trap with `$?` from the last
2425/// completed command (0 for the `trap` builtin), so a signal landing between an
2426/// earlier EXIT trap and its signal trap would record 0. In this order a signal
2427/// at any point leaves either no record (before the EXIT trap is set: the
2428/// shell dies of it, or exits from its signal trap) or the signal's status.
2429fn recording_status(cmd: &str, dir: &str, tag: &str) -> String {
2430    assert!(
2431        !dir.contains('\'') && !tag.contains('\''),
2432        "a status record path is quoted in single quotes"
2433    );
2434    let file = format!("{dir}/{tag}.rc");
2435    format!(
2436        "trap 'exit {}' TERM; trap 'exit {}' INT; trap 'exit {}' HUP; trap 'rc=$?; mkdir -p \"{dir}\" && echo \"$rc\" > \"{file}.tmp\" && mv \"{file}.tmp\" \"{file}\"; exit $rc' EXIT; {cmd}",
2437        RECORDED_SIGNAL_STATUSES[0], RECORDED_SIGNAL_STATUSES[1], RECORDED_SIGNAL_STATUSES[2]
2438    )
2439}
2440
2441/// The statuses [`recording_status`] records for a node killed by SIGTERM,
2442/// SIGINT and SIGHUP: 128 plus the signal number, as the shell reports them.
2443const RECORDED_SIGNAL_STATUSES: [u8; 3] = [143, 130, 129];
2444
2445/// Refuse a command [`recording_status`] cannot record: one that sets any trap
2446/// of its own (replacing the recorder's EXIT trap, or the TERM, INT and HUP
2447/// traps that keep a killed node's record non-zero) or `exec`s (leaving the
2448/// shell before the trap runs), or that runs `eval` or `source`, which could do
2449/// either out of sight. A word counts with its quotes and backslashes removed,
2450/// and an assignment's value is a word (`x=exec`), so `\exec`, `"trap"` and
2451/// `x=exec; $x` are refused too.
2452///
2453/// It is a cheap lint on the command's words, which cannot see inside a script
2454/// the command runs, a `.` (it also names the current directory, as in
2455/// `--src .`), a variable set outside the command, or a word the shell builds
2456/// at run time (`$'\x65xec'`, `$(printf …)`, `${a}p`). A hidden `exec` or EXIT
2457/// trap fails closed: no record, so the reader refuses. A hidden trap that
2458/// restores a signal's default does not: bash still runs the EXIT trap on that
2459/// signal, so a killed node would record its last completed command's status.
2460/// No committed command it checks runs a trap, `exec`, `eval` or `source`: the
2461/// selection tests build every subset through it.
2462fn refuse_record_breakers(tag: &str, cmd: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
2463    let words = cmd
2464        .split(|c: char| {
2465            c.is_whitespace()
2466                || matches!(c, ';' | '&' | '|' | '(' | ')' | '=' | '`' | '$' | '{' | '}')
2467        })
2468        .map(|word| word.replace(['"', '\'', '\\'], ""))
2469        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2470    for breaker in ["trap", "exec", "eval", "source"] {
2471        if words.iter().any(|word| word == breaker) {
2472            return Err(format!(
2473                "{tag}'s command runs `{breaker}`, which would drop its exit-status record"
2474            ));
2475        }
2476    }
2477    Ok(())
2478}
2479
2480/// [`recording_status`] into `$VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/preflight`, where
2481/// ci/buck-e2e/validate-node waits for a preflight node's record.
2482fn recording_preflight_status(cmd: &str, tag: &str) -> String {
2483    recording_status(cmd, BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT_STATUS_DIR, tag)
2484}
2485
2486/// The command of the last `--buck-<name>` node ([`buck_no_cargo_job`]),
2487/// tagged `tag`: wait up to `bound` seconds for each import twin's exit status
2488/// in [`BUCK_TWIN_STATUS_DIR`], so every twin has finished and no node can
2489/// still call cargo, then refuse on any refused cargo call. It reports each
2490/// twin's status but judges none: the twins own their verdicts, and this node's
2491/// verdict is the no-cargo property alone. A twin killed at its wall or
2492/// cancelled by an eager exit leaves no verdict, whichever way it shows: no
2493/// status within the bound (killed by SIGKILL), or a recorded signal status
2494/// ([`RECORDED_SIGNAL_STATUSES`]), written while dagrun's reap grace may still
2495/// leave the twin's processes running. Either way the node names the twin and
2496/// exits 1.
2497fn buck_no_cargo_wait_then_check(tag: &str, twins: &[String], bound: i64) -> String {
2498    let killed = RECORDED_SIGNAL_STATUSES
2499        .map(|status| status.to_string())
2500        .join("|");
2501    let wait = format!(
2502        "deadline=$((SECONDS + {bound})); statuses=; for twin in {}; do f=\"{BUCK_TWIN_STATUS_DIR}/$twin.rc\"; until [ -e \"$f\" ]; do if [ \"$SECONDS\" -ge \"$deadline\" ]; then echo \"{tag}: the import twin $twin wrote no exit status to $f within {bound} s, so it may not have finished; no verdict\" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 5; done; s=$(cat \"$f\"); case \"$s\" in {killed}) echo \"{tag}: the import twin $twin was killed by a signal (exit $s in $f), so its processes may still be running; no verdict\" >&2; exit 1;; esac; statuses=\"$statuses $twin=$s\"; done; echo \"{tag}: every import twin finished (exit statuses:$statuses; the twins own those verdicts)\"",
2503        twins.join(" ")
2504    );
2505    format!(
2506        "{wait}; {}; echo \"{tag}: the no-cargo shim refused no call\"",
2507        buck_s0_cargo_refusal_check(tag)
2508    )
2509}
2510
2511/// A Buck-only E2E subset: the plan cells in every one of its lists. `name`
2512/// is one of [`BUCK_SUBSETS`] and names the selection's nodes.
2513#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
2514pub struct BuckSubset {
2515    pub name: String,
2516    pub lanes: Vec<String>,
2517    pub backends: Vec<String>,
2518    pub categories: Vec<String>,
2519}
2520
2521impl BuckSubset {
2522    /// Subset `name` from the text of its file, [`buck_subset_path`]`(name)`,
2523    /// whose own `name` must be `name`.
2524    pub fn from_json(name: &str, text: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {
2525        #[derive(Deserialize)]
2526        struct File {
2527            name: String,
2528            lanes: Vec<String>,
2529            backends: Vec<String>,
2530            categories: Vec<String>,
2531        }
2532        let path = buck_subset_path(name);
2533        if !BUCK_SUBSETS.contains(&name) {
2534            return Err(format!(
2535                "no Buck-only subset is named {name:?}; the subsets are {BUCK_SUBSETS:?}"
2536            ));
2537        }
2538        let file: File = serde_json::from_str(text).map_err(|error| format!("{path}: {error}"))?;
2539        if file.name != name {
2540            return Err(format!("{path}: its name is {:?}, not {name:?}", file.name));
2541        }
2542        let subset = BuckSubset {
2543            name: file.name,
2544            lanes: file.lanes,
2545            backends: file.backends,
2546            categories: file.categories,
2547        };
2548        if subset.lanes.is_empty() || subset.backends.is_empty() || subset.categories.is_empty() {
2549            return Err(format!(
2550                "{path}: lanes, backends and categories must each name at least one"
2551            ));
2552        }
2553        Ok(subset)
2554    }
2555}
2556
2557/// Whether a node command runs cargo, a rust-script (which cargo compiles, or
2558/// the ci/rust-script-bin wrapper reads from target/ci/rust-scripts) or a Cargo
2559/// build product, which a `--buck-s0` plan must never do. A cheap lint on the
2560/// command strings, which cannot see inside the scripts a command runs; the
2561/// enforcement is [`BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_PATH`].
2562fn runs_cargo(cmd: &str) -> bool {
2563    let cmd = &cmd.replace(BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_SHIM, "ci/buck-e2e/no-cargo/");
2564    cmd.split(|c: char| !(c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-'))
2565        .any(|word| word == "cargo" || word == "rust-script")
2566        || cmd
2567            .split(|c: char| c.is_whitespace() || matches!(c, ';' | '&' | '|' | '(' | ')'))
2568            .any(|word| word.ends_with(".rs"))
2569        || cmd.contains("target/debug/")
2570        || cmd.contains("target/release/")
2571        || cmd.contains("target/validate/")
2572}
2573
2574/// The shell check a `--buck-s0` gate node runs first: exit 1, naming every
2575/// refused call, if the no-cargo shim recorded any ([`BUCK_S0_CARGO_REFUSED_LOG`]).
2576fn buck_s0_cargo_refusal_check(tag: &str) -> String {
2577    format!(
2578        "if [ -e \"$PWD/{BUCK_S0_CARGO_REFUSED_LOG}\" ]; then echo \"{tag}: the no-cargo shim refused these calls from --buck-s0 nodes:\" >&2; cat \"$PWD/{BUCK_S0_CARGO_REFUSED_LOG}\" >&2; exit 1; fi"
2579    )
2580}
2581
2582/// The plan of `scripts/validate.rs --buck-s0`: a Buck-only validation of one
2583/// subset with ZERO cargo nodes, in a checkout that needs no Cargo target
2584/// directory. It keeps the two preflight nodes (pre.submodules, and
2585/// pre.reverie_pin with its rustc checkers compiled into the run's state), adds
2586/// ONE node, e2e.buck_s0, built from the committed e2e.buck_cells, that stages
2587/// and runs the cells with one buck2 daemon (ci/buck-e2e/validate-node with no
2588/// argument under HERMIT_VALIDATE_E2E_RUNNER=buck-stock: ci/buck-e2e/stage
2589/// --from-buck, then the public buck2's stock test runner over the subset's
2590/// cells) beside the preflight, waiting for the preflight before any cell;
2591/// gate.manifest_s0, which refuses if any node ran cargo and runs the staged
2592/// Buck-built harness's `validate --without-footprint-check`
2593/// (`BUCK_GATE_VALIDATE`) in place of gate.manifest; and one import twin per
2594/// (lane, category) of the subset,
2595/// cloned from the committed `<bucket>_buck` twin with the staged Buck-built
2596/// harness and the plan's other backends excluded, so each twin selects exactly
2597/// the subset's cells of its bucket and writes that bucket's result files,
2598/// recording its exit status; and gate.no_cargo_s0, which waits for every
2599/// twin's record and then refuses if any node ran cargo, so its verdict exists
2600/// even when a twin fails (`buck_no_cargo_wait_then_check`).
2601/// Every other node is left out. Every node runs with the refusing cargo shim
2602/// first on its PATH (`BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_PATH`).
2603///
2604/// `plan_backends` is every backend of ci/expected-e2e-plan.json. Refuses a
2605/// subset that names a backend outside them, a category or lane without a
2606/// committed twin, and any selected node whose command string runs cargo.
2607pub fn buck_subset_selection(
2608    committed: &DagConfig,
2609    subset: &BuckSubset,
2610    plan_backends: &BTreeSet<String>,
2611) -> Result<DagConfig, String> {
2612    let name = subset.name.as_str();
2613    let flag = format!("--buck-{name}");
2614    let subset_path = buck_subset_path(name);
2615    let node_job = buck_node_job(name);
2616    let gate_job = buck_gate_job(name);
2617    let find = |tag: &str| {
2618        committed
2619            .steps
2620            .iter()
2621            .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
2622            .cloned()
2623            .ok_or_else(|| format!("the {flag} selection needs committed node {tag}"))
2624    };
2625    let unknown = subset
2626        .backends
2627        .iter()
2628        .filter(|backend| !plan_backends.contains(*backend))
2629        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2630    if !unknown.is_empty() {
2631        return Err(format!(
2632            "{subset_path} names backends {unknown:?} the plan does not hold"
2633        ));
2634    }
2635    let excluded = plan_backends
2636        .iter()
2637        .filter(|backend| !subset.backends.contains(*backend))
2638        .map(|backend| format!(" --exclude-backend {backend}"))
2639        .collect::<String>();
2640    let relabel = |step: &mut Step| {
2641        step.labels = vec![format!("buck-{name}")];
2642        step.fail_fast_family = Some(step.tag());
2643    };
2644    let mut steps = Vec::new();
2645
2646    // First, before the preflight writes its records or validate-node reads
2647    // them, an earlier execution's records go (buck_records_job).
2648    let mut records = find(BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[0])?;
2649    records.job = buck_records_job(name);
2650    records.cmd = clear_preflight_records(&records.tag());
2651    records.desc = format!("Remove an earlier execution's {flag} preflight records");
2652    records.description = format!(
2653        "Selected only by scripts/validate.rs {flag}, first. Removes {BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT_STATUS_DIR}, so the preflight nodes ({}) and e2e.{node_job}, which depend on this node, see only this execution's records: a run state is reused by a plan export's scheduler and by a nested payload, and an earlier execution's 0 would otherwise pass e2e.{node_job}'s preflight wait before this execution's preflight finished. Refuses, deleting nothing, unless VALIDATE_RUN_STATE is an existing absolute directory named like a run state (run-<profile>-<pid>-<nonce>, or a plan export's run-state).",
2654        BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT.join(", ")
2655    );
2656    records.deps = Vec::new();
2657    records.env.clear();
2658    records.timeout = 60;
2659    records.cpu_timeout = 30;
2660    relabel(&mut records);
2661    let records_tag = records.tag();
2662    steps.push(records);
2663
2664    let mut submodules = find(BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[0])?;
2665    refuse_record_breakers(BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[0], &submodules.cmd)?;
2666    submodules.cmd = recording_preflight_status(&submodules.cmd, BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[0]);
2667    submodules.deps = vec![records_tag.clone()];
2668    relabel(&mut submodules);
2669    let submodules_wall = submodules.timeout;
2670    steps.push(submodules);
2671    let mut pin = find(BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[1])?;
2672    let pin_call = "hermit_run_pin_check ./ci/run-reverie-pin-check.sh";
2673    if pin.cmd.matches(pin_call).count() != 1 {
2674        return Err("pre.reverie_pin lost its one ci/run-reverie-pin-check.sh call".into());
2675    }
2676    pin.cmd = pin
2677        .cmd
2678        .replace(pin_call, &format!("{BUCK_S0_PIN_CHECK_ROOT}{pin_call}"));
2679    refuse_record_breakers(BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[1], &pin.cmd)?;
2680    pin.cmd = recording_preflight_status(&pin.cmd, BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[1]);
2681    relabel(&mut pin);
2682    let pin_wall = pin.timeout;
2683    steps.push(pin);
2684
2685    // ONE node stages and runs the cells, so the stage's buck2 daemon is the
2686    // cells' daemon. dagrun ends every node by killing each process that
2687    // carries the node's DAGRUN_STEP nonce, and a buck2 daemon inherits it
2688    // from its client, so a daemon never outlives its node: with a stage node
2689    // and a cells node, the cells always started a cold daemon and analysed
2690    // and built again. The node runs beside the preflight, which only reads
2691    // the checkout (the pin check skips the staged copy). A failed preflight
2692    // cancels it at once by the default fail-fast (validate collapses every
2693    // family into the global eager exit), and under -k, which cancels
2694    // nothing, validate-node waits for the preflight's exit statuses before
2695    // the first cell and refuses on a failed or silent one.
2696    let stage = find(BUCK_STAGE_TAG)?;
2697    let mut cells = find(BUCK_CELLS_TAG)?;
2698    let cells_only = "./ci/buck-e2e/validate-node --cells-only";
2699    if cells.cmd.matches(cells_only).count() != 1 {
2700        return Err(format!("{BUCK_CELLS_TAG} lost its one {cells_only} call"));
2701    }
2702    cells.cmd = cells.cmd.replace(cells_only, "./ci/buck-e2e/validate-node");
2703    cells.job = node_job.clone();
2704    cells.desc = "Stage and run the Buck-only subset's cells with one buck2 daemon".into();
2705    cells.description = format!(
2706        "Selected only by scripts/validate.rs {flag}. One node, so the stage's buck2 daemon is the cells' daemon (dagrun reaps a node's processes, a daemon its client started included, when the node ends). On the host, ci/buck-e2e/validate-node with no argument under HERMIT_VALIDATE_E2E_RUNNER=buck-stock runs ci/buck-e2e/stage --from-buck (//ci/buck-e2e:harness-bin built by the given buck2, `git archive HEAD`, the subset's fixtures built by that Buck-built harness, and the libunwind runtime closure the Buck-built hermit loads; it refuses a tree with uncommitted changes to tracked files), then waits for the preflight it runs beside ({}, each one's exit status in {BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT_STATUS_DIR}/<tag>.rc; a failed or silent preflight ends the node before any cell), then runs the subset's shell-test twins (//ci/buck-e2e:stock-local, every cell on this host, the Buck-built //hermit-cli:hermit-release) and ingests their artifacts into $VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/buck-e2e/results with ci/buck-e2e/ingest.py --local-listing, which refuses unless the cells Buck ran are exactly the subset plan's. No cargo runs and nothing is written to target/; the third-party rules shim/third-party/rust/BUCK are the checkout's setup, generated once by bootstrap/regenerate-rust-deps for this checkout's inputs (refused on a stamp mismatch). The buck2 daemon and the cells run in the daemon's own systemd scope, outside this node's cgroup, so this node's box and CPU budget do not cover them: before the stage, validate-node starts the daemon, sets the scope's MemoryMax to {BUCK_S0_DAEMON_MEMORY_MAX_ENV} bytes, stops the daemon (failing the node) once the scope's CPU passes {BUCK_S0_DAEMON_CPU_SECONDS_ENV} (this node's CPU budget), and records the scope's CPU and memory.peak. It judges nothing: the import twins own the verdicts. Subset: {subset_path}.",
2707        BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT.join(", ")
2708    );
2709    // Beside the preflight: only after the first node's clear.
2710    cells.deps = vec![records_tag.clone()];
2711    // Both committed bounds: this node does the stage's work and the cells'.
2712    cells.timeout += stage.timeout;
2713    cells.cpu_timeout += stage.cpu_timeout;
2714    cells.hint.est_duration_s += stage.hint.est_duration_s;
2715    cells.hint.rss_baseline_bytes = Some(BUCK_S0_DAEMON_MEMORY_MAX_BYTES);
2716    cells.env.insert(
2717        BUCK_S0_DAEMON_MEMORY_MAX_ENV.into(),
2718        BUCK_S0_DAEMON_MEMORY_MAX_BYTES.to_string(),
2719    );
2720    cells.env.insert(
2721        BUCK_S0_DAEMON_CPU_SECONDS_ENV.into(),
2722        cells.cpu_timeout.to_string(),
2723    );
2724    cells
2725        .env
2726        .insert(BUCK_STEP_WALL_ENV.into(), cells.timeout.to_string());
2727    cells.env.insert(
2728        BUCK_S0_AWAIT_PREFLIGHT_ENV.into(),
2729        BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT.join(" "),
2730    );
2731    cells.env.insert(
2732        BUCK_S0_AWAIT_PREFLIGHT_SECONDS_ENV.into(),
2733        (submodules_wall + pin_wall).to_string(),
2734    );
2735    relabel(&mut cells);
2736    steps.push(cells.clone());
2737
2738    // gate.manifest runs the Cargo-built target/debug/test-harness validate.
2739    // The staged Buck-built harness runs the same validate here, with
2740    // --without-footprint-check: every audit (DAG correspondence, budget
2741    // ordering, determinism-stress evidence, CLI brackets, the expected plan
2742    // and the synced cell files, after the front-door manifest planner) except
2743    // the generated footprints, whose target/debug/generate-test-footprints runs
2744    // `cargo metadata`; validate prints that check as NOT RUN.
2745    let mut gate = find("gate.manifest")?;
2746    gate.job = gate_job.clone();
2747    let gate_template = gate.clone();
2748    gate.cmd = format!(
2749        "{}; {BUCK_GATE_VALIDATE}",
2750        buck_s0_cargo_refusal_check(&format!("gate.{gate_job}"))
2751    );
2752    gate.desc =
2753        "Buck-only gate: no node ran cargo, and the staged harness's manifest audits".into();
2754    gate.description = format!(
2755        "Selected only by scripts/validate.rs {flag}, in place of gate.manifest (the Cargo-built target/debug/test-harness validate). After {}, whose preflight wait means both preflight nodes have exited: it refuses if any {flag} node ran cargo ({BUCK_S0_CARGO_REFUSED_LOG}, which {BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_SHIM} appends to), then runs the staged Buck-built harness's validate over the staged source ({BUCK_GATE_VALIDATE}). That is gate.manifest's own command on the Buck-built binary: the front-door manifest planner, then the DAG correspondence, budget ordering, determinism-stress evidence and CLI bracket audits, each printing what it checked, then the expected plan and the cell files synced from the manifests. One audit does not run in this mode, and validate prints it as NOT RUN: the generated test footprints, whose Cargo-built target/debug/generate-test-footprints runs cargo metadata.",
2756        cells.tag()
2757    );
2758    gate.deps = vec![cells.tag()];
2759    gate.env.clear();
2760    relabel(&mut gate);
2761    let gate_tag = gate.tag();
2762    steps.push(gate);
2763    let mut twin_tags = Vec::new();
2764    let mut longest_twin_wall = 0;
2765
2766    for lane in &subset.lanes {
2767        let group = match lane.as_str() {
2768            "portable" => "e2e",
2769            "privileged" => "privileged-e2e",
2770            other => {
2771                return Err(format!(
2772                    "{subset_path} names lane {other}, which has no E2E group"
2773                ));
2774            }
2775        };
2776        for category in &subset.categories {
2777            let tag = format!(
2778                "{group}.manifest_{}{BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX}",
2779                category.replace('-', "_")
2780            );
2781            let mut twin = find(&tag)?;
2782            let launcher = format!("{BUCK_IMPORT_ASSIGNMENT}target/debug/test-harness run ");
2783            if twin.cmd.matches(&launcher).count() != 1 {
2784                return Err(format!(
2785                    "{tag} lost its one import-mode test-harness launcher"
2786                ));
2787            }
2788            twin.cmd = format!(
2789                "{}{excluded}",
2790                twin.cmd.replace(
2791                    &launcher,
2792                    &format!("{BUCK_IMPORT_ASSIGNMENT}{BUCK_S0_HARNESS}")
2793                )
2794            );
2795            twin.job.push_str(&format!("_{name}"));
2796            twin.desc = format!("{} (Buck-only subset)", twin.desc);
2797            twin.description = format!(
2798                "The {flag} import twin of {tag}: the same bucket's result files from the rows {} wrote, judged by the staged Buck-built test-harness, with the plan's backends outside the subset excluded ({}), so it owns exactly the subset's cells of the bucket. Its exit status also goes to {BUCK_TWIN_STATUS_DIR}/<tag>.rc, which the last node waits for.",
2799                cells.tag(),
2800                excluded.trim()
2801            );
2802            twin.deps = vec![cells.tag(), gate_tag.clone(), BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[1].into()];
2803            relabel(&mut twin);
2804            let owner = twin.tag();
2805            refuse_record_breakers(&owner, &twin.cmd)?;
2806            twin.cmd = recording_status(&twin.cmd, BUCK_TWIN_STATUS_DIR, &owner);
2807            longest_twin_wall = longest_twin_wall.max(twin.timeout);
2808            twin_tags.push(owner.clone());
2809            for result in twin.result_manifests.iter_mut().flatten() {
2810                if let ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(result) = result {
2811                    result.owner = owner.clone();
2812                }
2813            }
2814            steps.push(twin);
2815        }
2816    }
2817
2818    // The twins run after gate.manifest_s0, so this last node checks the shim's
2819    // record again once they are done: its verdict says whether any node, the
2820    // twins included, ran cargo. It waits for the twins' recorded exit statuses
2821    // rather than depending on the twins, because dagrun skips every dependent
2822    // of a failed node: a twin's FAIL would otherwise leave the no-cargo
2823    // question without a verdict, as it did in every run before this.
2824    let mut last = gate_template;
2825    last.job = buck_no_cargo_job(name);
2826    let last_tag = last.tag();
2827    // The longest twin wall plus a minute for the last record to land. The
2828    // twins start when this node does (both wait on gate.manifest_s0) and run
2829    // side by side; import-only twins took 2-7 s each in the 2026-11-18 s0 run
2830    // against walls of 600 s. So one twin running to its own wall still fits,
2831    // and twins that queue behind each other near their walls end in a "no
2832    // verdict" refusal, never a pass. Summing the walls instead made this the
2833    // plan's longest node (5520 s for s0, above the cells node), which refused
2834    // --run-timeout values the plan accepted before and held this node's
2835    // memory reservation for up to 91 minutes after a twin was killed.
2836    let wait_bound = longest_twin_wall + 60;
2837    last.cmd = buck_no_cargo_wait_then_check(&last_tag, &twin_tags, wait_bound);
2838    last.desc = "Buck-only gate: no node, the import twins included, ran cargo".into();
2839    last.description = format!(
2840        "Selected only by scripts/validate.rs {flag}, after {gate_tag} and beside the import twins: it waits up to {wait_bound} s for every twin's exit status in {BUCK_TWIN_STATUS_DIR}/<tag>.rc ({}), prints them, then refuses if any {flag} node ran cargo ({BUCK_S0_CARGO_REFUSED_LOG}, which {BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_SHIM} appends to). {gate_tag} checks the same record before the twins run; this covers the twins too. Its verdict is the no-cargo property alone, whatever the twins' verdicts, which stay theirs: it waits for the twins instead of depending on them, because dagrun skips every dependent of a failed node. A twin killed at its wall or cancelled leaves no verdict, and the node says which: it wrote no status within the wait (SIGKILL), or its record holds a signal status (143, 130 or 129, from SIGTERM, SIGINT or SIGHUP), written while dagrun's reap grace may still leave its processes running. Under validate's default eager exit a failed twin also cancels this node; `-k` keeps every node in its own fail-fast family, so a run that needs this verdict whatever the twins say runs with -k (which also sets HERMIT_E2E_FAIL_FAST=0, so the twins judge every cell).",
2841        twin_tags.join(", ")
2842    );
2843    last.deps = vec![gate_tag.clone()];
2844    last.timeout = wait_bound + 60;
2845    last.env.clear();
2846    relabel(&mut last);
2847    steps.push(last);
2848
2849    let cargo = steps
2850        .iter()
2851        .filter(|step| runs_cargo(&step.cmd))
2852        .map(Step::tag)
2853        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2854    if !cargo.is_empty() {
2855        return Err(format!(
2856            "the {flag} selection must run no cargo, but {cargo:?} would"
2857        ));
2858    }
2859    for step in &mut steps {
2860        step.cmd = format!("{BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_PATH}{}", step.cmd);
2861    }
2862    let mut selected = committed.clone();
2863    selected.steps = steps;
2864    Ok(selected)
2865}
2866
2867/// The cargo nodes a Buck full run replaces: every bucket and scorecard that
2868/// has a `_buck` twin, and the producers only they consume.
2869fn buck_replaced_tags(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<BTreeSet<String>, String> {
2870    let tags = cfg.steps.iter().map(Step::tag).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
2871    let mut replaced = BTreeSet::new();
2872    for step in &cfg.steps {
2873        if step.labels != [FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL] || is_buck_runner_node(step) {
2874            continue;
2875        }
2876        let cargo = step
2877            .tag()
2878            .strip_suffix(BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX)
2879            .map(str::to_string)
2880            .ok_or_else(|| format!("{} is a Buck node with no cargo counterpart", step.tag()))?;
2881        if !tags.contains(&cargo) {
2882            return Err(format!("{} replaces absent node {cargo}", step.tag()));
2883        }
2884        replaced.insert(cargo);
2885    }
2886    for producer in BUCK_REPLACED_PRODUCERS {
2887        if !tags.contains(*producer) {
2888            return Err(format!("Buck-replaced producer {producer} is absent"));
2889        }
2890        replaced.insert((*producer).to_string());
2891    }
2892    Ok(replaced)
2893}
2894
2895/// Add the `full-buck-e2e` nodes: e2e.buck_stage, which stages the inputs Buck
2896/// does not build; e2e.buck_cells, which runs every cell under Buck/Tpx against
2897/// them; one host import twin per `full` E2E bucket; and a twin of the full
2898/// scorecard that waits for the twins.
2899///
2900/// A twin keeps its bucket's manifest selector and test-harness arguments, so
2901/// it owns the same cells and writes the same result files. It only adds
2902/// `E2E_IMPORT_RESULTS`, so the harness executes nothing and publishes the
2903/// Buck rows instead; a cell with no row becomes an ERROR row.
2904fn materialize_buck_e2e(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
2905    let buckets = cfg
2906        .steps
2907        .iter()
2908        .filter(|step| {
2909            step.manifest.is_some()
2910                && matches!(step.group.as_str(), "e2e" | "privileged-e2e")
2911                && step.labels.iter().any(|label| label == "full")
2912        })
2913        .cloned()
2914        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2915    // 17 since the rr bucket (first post-split extension bucket) joined;
2916    // 18 with the gvisor bucket.
2917    if buckets.len() != 18 {
2918        return Err(format!(
2919            "the full profile has {} E2E buckets, expected 18",
2920            buckets.len()
2921        ));
2922    }
2923    let deps = [
2924        BUCK_CELLS_TAG,
2925        "build.rust_scripts",
2926        "gate.manifest",
2927        "pre.reverie_pin",
2928        "setup.manifest_plan",
2929    ];
2930    let mut added = Vec::new();
2931    let mut bucket_tags = BTreeSet::new();
2932    for bucket in &buckets {
2933        let cargo = bucket.tag();
2934        // A twin executes no cell, so it runs on the host (runs_in_pinned_root
2935        // excludes it): keep only the payload of an authored pinned-root wrapper.
2936        let payload = if bucket
2937            .cmd
2938            .starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ")
2939        {
2940            let argv = shell_words::split(&bucket.cmd)
2941                .map_err(|error| format!("{cargo}: invalid pinned-root quoting: {error}"))?;
2942            let boundary = argv
2943                .iter()
2944                .position(|arg| arg == "--")
2945                .ok_or_else(|| format!("{cargo}: missing pinned-root payload boundary"))?;
2946            match &argv[boundary..] {
2947                [_, bash, dash_c, guard, name, payload]
2948                    if bash == "bash"
2949                        && dash_c == "-c"
2950                        && name == "bash"
2951                        && [PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD, LEGACY_PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD]
2952                            .contains(&guard.as_str()) =>
2953                {
2954                    payload.clone()
2955                }
2956                _ => return Err(format!("{cargo}: unrecognized pinned-root invocation")),
2957            }
2958        } else {
2959            bucket.cmd.clone()
2960        };
2961        let launcher = [
2962            "./ci/run-with-hermit-e2e-artifact.sh --require-install target/debug/test-harness run ",
2963            "./ci/run-with-hermit-e2e-artifact.sh target/debug/test-harness run ",
2964        ]
2965        .into_iter()
2966        .find(|launcher| payload.matches(launcher).count() == 1)
2967        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{cargo} lost its one test-harness run launcher"))?;
2968        let mut twin = bucket.clone();
2969        twin.job.push_str(BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX);
2970        let tag = twin.tag();
2971        twin.desc = format!("{} (Buck rows)", bucket.desc);
2972        // Lead with the counterpart's own description: the twin owns exactly
2973        // its cells, so what that says about the selection holds here too.
2974        twin.description = format!(
2975            "{} Buck import twin: publishes the cells of {cargo} from the rows e2e.buck_cells wrote: test-harness in import mode (E2E_IMPORT_RESULTS) with {cargo}'s arguments, so it owns the same cells and writes the same result files. It executes no cell. A cell with no row, a row from another commit or an unclean tree, or a PASS without complete evidence is an ERROR, so executed equals plan. Selected only by scripts/validate.rs --e2e-runner buck-local|buck-hybrid, which drops {cargo}.",
2976            bucket.description
2977        );
2978        twin.labels = vec![FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL.into()];
2979        twin.cmd = payload.replace(
2980            launcher,
2981            &format!("{BUCK_IMPORT_ASSIGNMENT}target/debug/test-harness run "),
2982        );
2983        twin.deps = deps.iter().map(|dep| (*dep).to_string()).collect();
2984        twin.env.clear();
2985        // The import's parity post-pass counts its bound from the step start,
2986        // so dagrun must not kill the step first.
2987        twin.timeout = crate::parity::PARITY_STEP_WALL_FLOOR.as_secs() as i64;
2988        twin.cpu_timeout = 600;
2989        twin.hint.resources.clear();
2990        let (seconds, workers) = BUCK_TWIN_MEASURED_ESTIMATES
2991            .iter()
2992            .find_map(|(twin_tag, seconds, workers)| {
2993                (*twin_tag == tag).then_some((*seconds, *workers))
2994            })
2995            .unwrap_or((1.0, 1));
2996        twin.hint.est_duration_s = seconds;
2997        twin.hint.rss_baseline_bytes = Some(1 << 30);
2998        twin.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes = Some(3 << 30);
2999        twin.hint.classification = dagrun::model::StepClass::Light;
3000        twin.hint.preferred_inner_jobs = (workers > 1).then_some(workers);
3001        twin.fail_fast_family = Some(tag.clone());
3002        for result in twin.result_manifests.iter_mut().flatten() {
3003            if let ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(result) = result {
3004                result.owner = tag.clone();
3005            }
3006        }
3007        bucket_tags.insert(cargo);
3008        added.push(twin);
3009    }
3010
3011    let scorecard = cfg
3012        .steps
3013        .iter()
3014        .find(|step| step.tag() == FULL_SCORECARD_TAG)
3015        .ok_or("the full scorecard is absent")?;
3016    let scorecard_deps = scorecard
3017        .deps
3018        .iter()
3019        .filter(|dep| bucket_tags.contains(*dep))
3020        .count();
3021    if scorecard_deps != bucket_tags.len() {
3022        return Err(format!(
3023            "{FULL_SCORECARD_TAG} waits for {scorecard_deps} of the {} full E2E buckets",
3024            bucket_tags.len()
3025        ));
3026    }
3027    let mut scorecard_twin = scorecard.clone();
3028    scorecard_twin.job.push_str(BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX);
3029    scorecard_twin.labels = vec![FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL.into()];
3030    scorecard_twin.description = format!(
3031        "{FULL_SCORECARD_TAG}, run after the Buck import twins instead of the cargo buckets. {}",
3032        scorecard.description
3033    );
3034    for dep in &mut scorecard_twin.deps {
3035        if bucket_tags.contains(dep) {
3036            dep.push_str(BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX);
3037        }
3038    }
3039    scorecard_twin.fail_fast_family = Some(scorecard_twin.tag());
3040    added.push(scorecard_twin);
3041
3042    let release_artifact = cfg
3043        .steps
3044        .iter()
3045        .find(|step| step.tag() == "build.buck_release_artifact")
3046        .ok_or("build.buck_release_artifact is absent")?
3047        .clone();
3048
3049    // The stage is three Cargo builds and the fixtures, in target/release,
3050    // target/stage-hermit and target/validate, so it keeps the release
3051    // artifact's 64-GiB hard cap, CPU-bound class and 32-wide CARGO_BUILD_JOBS.
3052    let mut stage = release_artifact.clone();
3053    stage.group = "e2e".into();
3054    stage.job = "buck_stage".into();
3055    stage.desc = "Stage the inputs Buck does not build for the E2E cells".into();
3056    stage.description = "Selected only by scripts/validate.rs --e2e-runner buck-local|buck-hybrid, with e2e.buck_cells. On the host it runs ci/buck-e2e/stage --from-cargo (ci/buck-e2e/validate-node --stage-only): a Cargo build in the checkout's target/ of the release test-harness and hermit-manifest-plan (target/release), the validate-profile hermit (target/stage-hermit, copied to target/validate/hermit) and detcore-dbt then the install bundle (target/validate), published with ci/publish-hermit-e2e-artifact.sh; then git archive HEAD and the CI-selected fixtures built from it. It writes ci/buck-e2e/staged/ for HEAD, SOURCE_SHA last, and refuses a tree with uncommitted changes to tracked files. It needs no buck2 and no runner, only the pinned Reverie (pre.reverie_pin): it builds nothing in target/ci or target/debug, so it runs beside build.rust_scripts (target/ci/rust-script-build) and setup.manifest_plan (target/debug), and Cargo's per-profile-directory locks keep the three from waiting on each other. Until 2026-10-05 the stage ran inside e2e.buck_cells, after those two and gate.manifest: in the full validation of hermit f53e746779 on a 284-core host they took 202, 34 and 3 seconds before the 422.74-second e2e.buck_cells began.".into();
3057    stage.labels = vec![FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL.into()];
3058    stage.cmd = BUCK_STAGE_COMMAND.into();
3059    stage.deps = vec!["pre.reverie_pin".into()];
3060    // ci/buck-e2e/stage with its builds side by side (02eba338ab), cold:
3061    // 143.3 to 144.2 s wall at 32 jobs and 128.6 s at 96, 2276 to 2312 CPU-s.
3062    // Since reproducible staging (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3948)
3063    // it builds in a fixed directory: six full validations on 2026-10-08/09
3064    // measured 172.6 to 181.2 s wall and 2438 to 2561 CPU-s.
3065    // The CPU bound was the next 300-s bucket above 1.5 x 2561 (3842), 3900.
3066    // Until 2026-10-26 every stage was cold (the fixed directory was wiped
3067    // before and after). It is now kept and refreshed by content, so most stages
3068    // rebuild only what changed, but a stage is still cold when its directory is
3069    // new, at least once a day and over its size bound, so the bounds below stay
3070    // those of a cold stage. The work grew by
3071    // about 500 CPU-s when d4594afa (2026-10-17) added a cold build of the
3072    // liteinst-runtime profile to the stage, which b42f1992 then ran beside the
3073    // other builds (its throttled time doubled, its CPU did not change). Across
3074    // the 169 passing full validations from d4594afa to 2026-10-24, the step's cgroup
3075    // CPU was 2558 to 3801 CPU-s (median 3269, p99 3597), and the validation of
3076    // 46be6638 was killed at 3901 CPU-s and 215 s wall, before its builds
3077    // finished. The CPU bound is the next 300-s bucket above 1.5 x 3901 (5851).
3078    // The wall bound keeps build.buck_release_artifact's 1800 s for the same builds,
3079    // about 10 times the measurement; it also encloses the stage's lock wait,
3080    // whose default (HERMIT_BUCK_STAGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT, 1200 s) leaves room for one
3081    // stage after it.
3082    // 2026-11-02 (step_limits.rs): under concurrent full validations two stages
3083    // were killed at that 1800-second WALL bound with 4039 and 3248 CPU-s used,
3084    // and 499 passing stages to that date peaked at 4419 CPU-s. The CPU bound is
3085    // the next 300-s bucket above 1.5 x 4419 (6628), 6900; the wall is 1.5 x
3086    // the 1800-s kill bound, 2700, so a full lock wait still leaves 1500 s for
3087    // the stage itself. It cannot be 3000: no node's wall may leave less than
3088    // PREPARATION_RESERVE_S of the 4200-s run budget
3089    // (committed_selections_survive_a_slow_preparation).
3090    stage.timeout = 2700;
3091    stage.cpu_timeout = 6900;
3092    stage.hint.est_duration_s = 177.0;
3093    // The baseline cloned from build.buck_release_artifact (8.39 GiB) is below
3094    // what ci/buck-e2e/stage peaks at with its builds running side by side:
3095    // cgroup memory.peak 8.69 and 9.27 GiB cold at 32 jobs, 9.47 GiB at 96.
3096    stage.hint.rss_baseline_bytes = Some(10 << 30);
3097    stage.fail_fast_family = Some(BUCK_STAGE_TAG.into());
3098    added.push(stage);
3099
3100    let mut cells = release_artifact;
3101    cells.group = "e2e".into();
3102    cells.job = "buck_cells".into();
3103    cells.desc = "Run every E2E cell under Buck/Tpx".into();
3104    cells.description = "Selected only by scripts/validate.rs --e2e-runner buck-local|buck-hybrid, which passes the runner in HERMIT_VALIDATE_E2E_RUNNER and the internal buck2 in HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUCK2. On the host (ci/buck-e2e/validate-node --cells-only) it refuses with exit 2 unless e2e.buck_stage staged the inputs Buck does not build for HEAD (ci/buck-e2e/staged/SOURCE_SHA), regenerates the Buck third-party rules, stages the RE link inputs for buck-hybrid, and runs every cell of ci/expected-e2e-plan.json under Buck (ci/buck-e2e/run --no-verdict), locally or with RE-routed cells on Meta RE. It judges nothing: the rows go to $VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/buck-e2e/results for the import twins, which own the verdicts. The verify logs (run1_log_*, run2_log_*) of every cell execution that did not pass, which for an RE cell exist only as its Tpx artifacts, go to $E2E_RESULT_ROOT/buck-failed-verify-logs with an index.jsonl, each log bounded at 1 GiB + 1 MiB (hermit's own 1 GiB log bound plus its truncation marker); so do the last 64 KiB of each such execution's Hermit stderr (hermit-stderr.tail) and, in its index entry, the class of its HERMIT_INTERNAL_FAILURE line, whether or not it left a log. Any other runner value exits 2; nothing falls back to cargo.".into();
3105    cells.labels = vec![FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL.into()];
3106    cells.cmd = BUCK_CELLS_COMMAND.into();
3107    // The rust-script tools (bootstrap/regenerate-rust-deps runs two) and the
3108    // debug test-harness the import twins share come from the producers that
3109    // the stage no longer waits for.
3110    let mut cells_deps = deps[1..]
3111        .iter()
3112        .map(|dep| (*dep).to_string())
3113        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
3114    cells_deps.push(BUCK_STAGE_TAG.into());
3115    cells_deps.sort();
3116    cells.deps = cells_deps;
3117    // Measured: across the 131 e2e.buck_cells runs in the retained step
3118    // profiles of one development host (2026-09 to 2026-10-08), median 164 s,
3119    // p95 520 s, max 831 s, 6 over 600 s, none over 1000 s, none timed out;
3120    // the slowest are Buck RE downloads, which buck2 does not time out.
3121    // 2400 s is 2.9 times that maximum and equals check.lint_checks, the
3122    // largest other node budget in the full selection, so it costs the
3123    // preparation reserve nothing. It was 3600 s, carried from the node that
3124    // also staged. The committed selection is never clamped to the time left
3125    // after preparation, so a 3600 s node made every buck-runner full
3126    // validation refuse once its preparation passed the 600 s that a 4200 s
3127    // run budget left (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3896; see
3128    // committed_selections_survive_a_slow_preparation).
3129    cells.timeout = 2400;
3130    // dagrun gives a step the time it started (DAGRUN_STEP_STARTED_MONOTONIC_NS)
3131    // but not its wall bound; validate-node keeps the Buck invocation records
3132    // only in what is left of this one. The committed Buck selection is never
3133    // clamped, so this is the bound dagrun enforces.
3134    cells
3135        .env
3136        .insert(BUCK_STEP_WALL_ENV.into(), cells.timeout.to_string());
3137    cells.cpu_timeout = 14400;
3138    // 422.74 s for the node that also staged (hermit f53e746779, before
3139    // 02eba338ab overlapped the stage's builds), minus the 258.9 s its step
3140    // log shows those then-serial Cargo builds took (46.10, 46.60, 120 and
3141    // 46.20 s): at most 163.8 s for the rest, of which the archive and the
3142    // fixtures also moved to e2e.buck_stage.
3143    cells.hint.est_duration_s = 165.0;
3144    // Not lowered with the stage gone: the 10-GiB baseline covered the stage's
3145    // measured peak, and the peak of the Buck run alone (its daemon and up to
3146    // 32 cells at once) has not been measured.
3147    cells.hint.rss_baseline_bytes = Some(10 << 30);
3148    cells.fail_fast_family = Some(BUCK_CELLS_TAG.into());
3149    added.push(cells);
3150
3151    cfg.steps.extend(added);
3152    Ok(())
3153}
3154
3155/// Cut the workspace producer's payload into its Cargo half and its
3156/// preparation half. Both halves keep the leading rust-script environment, so
3157/// `join_workspace_payloads` restores the original bytes exactly. Refuses
3158/// unless the payload starts with that environment and contains the
3159/// preparation boundary exactly once.
3160pub(crate) fn split_workspace_payload(payload: &str) -> Result<(String, String), String> {
3161    let environment = crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_ENVIRONMENT;
3162    if payload.matches(WORKSPACE_PREPARATION_BOUNDARY).count() != 1 {
3163        return Err(format!(
3164            "workspace producer lost its exact Nextest preparation boundary `{WORKSPACE_PREPARATION_BOUNDARY}`"
3165        ));
3166    }
3167    if !payload.starts_with(environment) {
3168        return Err("workspace producer lost its leading rust-script environment".into());
3169    }
3170    let (compile, profile) = payload
3171        .split_once(WORKSPACE_PREPARATION_BOUNDARY)
3172        .expect("boundary counted above");
3173    let preparation = &WORKSPACE_PREPARATION_BOUNDARY[" && ".len()..];
3174    let prepare = format!("{environment}{preparation}{profile}");
3175    if join_workspace_payloads(compile, &prepare)? != payload {
3176        return Err("workspace producer payload does not split losslessly".into());
3177    }
3178    Ok((compile.to_string(), prepare))
3179}
3180
3181fn workspace_compile_payload_with_signal(payload: &str) -> String {
3182    format!("{payload}{HERMIT_BIN_SIGNAL_SUFFIX}")
3183}
3184
3185fn workspace_prepare_payload_with_gate(payload: &str) -> String {
3186    format!("{payload}{EARLY_ARTIFACT_GATE_SUFFIX}")
3187}
3188
3189/// Rejoin the two halves into the payload the unsplit producer ran: the Cargo
3190/// half, ` && `, then the preparation half without its repeated environment.
3191pub fn join_workspace_payloads(compile: &str, prepare: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
3192    let compile = compile
3193        .strip_suffix(HERMIT_BIN_SIGNAL_SUFFIX)
3194        .unwrap_or(compile);
3195    let prepare = prepare
3196        .strip_suffix(EARLY_ARTIFACT_GATE_SUFFIX)
3197        .unwrap_or(prepare);
3198    let environment = crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_ENVIRONMENT;
3199    let preparation = &WORKSPACE_PREPARATION_BOUNDARY[" && ".len()..];
3200    let Some(prepare_tail) = prepare.strip_prefix(environment) else {
3201        return Err(format!(
3202            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} lost its leading rust-script environment"
3203        ));
3204    };
3205    if !prepare_tail.starts_with(preparation) {
3206        return Err(format!(
3207            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} runs something before `{preparation}`"
3208        ));
3209    }
3210    if !compile.starts_with(environment) {
3211        return Err(format!(
3212            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} lost its leading rust-script environment"
3213        ));
3214    }
3215    if compile.contains(preparation.trim_end()) {
3216        return Err(format!(
3217            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} runs Nextest preparation itself"
3218        ));
3219    }
3220    Ok(format!("{compile} && {prepare_tail}"))
3221}
3222
3223/// The complete payload of the pinned-root workspace producer, rejoined from
3224/// its two nodes. Refuses unless both nodes exist, run under byte-identical
3225/// pinned-root wrappers apart from the compile node's artifact-signal
3226/// environment (the same --src, --out, --cargo-home, other forwarded
3227/// environment and guard), and the prepare node depends directly on the
3228/// compile node. Checks written for the unsplit producer apply unchanged to
3229/// the returned bytes.
3230pub fn pinned_workspace_producer_payload(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
3231    let find = |tag: &str| {
3232        cfg.steps
3233            .iter()
3234            .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
3235            .ok_or_else(|| format!("validation DAG lost {tag}"))
3236    };
3237    let compile = find(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG)?;
3238    let prepare = find(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)?;
3239    if !prepare
3240        .deps
3241        .iter()
3242        .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG)
3243    {
3244        return Err(format!(
3245            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} can prepare before {PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} has built"
3246        ));
3247    }
3248    let wrapper = |step: &Step| -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
3249        if !step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ") {
3250            return Err(format!("{} does not run in the pinned root", step.tag()));
3251        }
3252        let mut argv =
3253            shell_words::split(&step.cmd).map_err(|error| format!("{}: {error}", step.tag()))?;
3254        argv.pop();
3255        // Only the publishing compile node forwards the scheduler-owned
3256        // artifact-ready channel. Every other wrapper argument must match.
3257        let mut normalized = Vec::with_capacity(argv.len());
3258        let mut index = 0;
3259        while index < argv.len() {
3260            if argv[index] == "--env"
3261                && matches!(
3262                    argv.get(index + 1).map(String::as_str),
3263                    Some("DAGRUN_ARTIFACT_READY_DIR" | "DAGRUN_OUTER_RUN")
3264                )
3265            {
3266                index += 2;
3267            } else {
3268                normalized.push(std::mem::take(&mut argv[index]));
3269                index += 1;
3270            }
3271        }
3272        Ok(normalized)
3273    };
3274    if wrapper(compile)? != wrapper(prepare)? {
3275        return Err(format!(
3276            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} and {PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} run under different pinned-root wrappers"
3277        ));
3278    }
3279    join_workspace_payloads(
3280        &crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(compile)?,
3281        &crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(prepare)?,
3282    )
3283}
3284
3285/// Turn the pinned-root workspace twin into its compile and prepare nodes.
3286/// `twin` arrives with its pinned-root dependencies and environment set and
3287/// its payload not yet wrapped.
3288fn split_pinned_workspace_twin(twin: Step) -> Result<[Step; 2], String> {
3289    let (compile_payload, prepare_payload) = split_workspace_payload(&twin.cmd)?;
3290    let mut compile = twin.clone();
3291    compile.job = PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_JOB.into();
3292    compile.desc = PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_DESC.into();
3293    compile.description = PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_DESCRIPTION.into();
3294    compile.cmd = workspace_compile_payload_with_signal(&compile_payload);
3295    compile.publishes = vec![dagrun::model::PublishedArtifact {
3296        name: HERMIT_BIN_ARTIFACT.into(),
3297        path: Some("target/validate/hermit".into()),
3298    }];
3299    compile
3300        .deps
3301        .retain(|dependency| dependency != PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG);
3302    compile.fail_fast_family = None;
3303    compile.cmd = pinned_root_command(&compile);
3304
3305    let mut prepare = twin;
3306    prepare.desc = PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_DESC.into();
3307    prepare.description = PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_DESCRIPTION.into();
3308    prepare.cmd = workspace_prepare_payload_with_gate(&prepare_payload);
3309    // The twin's own dependencies, build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root among
3310    // them, stay on the prepare node.
3311    prepare.deps.push(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG.into());
3312    prepare.deps.sort();
3313    prepare.deps.dedup();
3314    prepare.hint.est_duration_s = PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_EST_SECONDS;
3315    prepare.hint.rss_baseline_bytes = Some(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_RSS_BASELINE_BYTES);
3316    prepare.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes = Some(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_HARD_MEM_MAX_BYTES);
3317    prepare.timeout = PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_WALL_SECONDS;
3318    prepare.cpu_timeout = PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_CPU_SECONDS;
3319    prepare.cmd = pinned_root_command(&prepare);
3320    Ok([compile, prepare])
3321}
3322
3323/// One writer for the shared compat fixtures (issue 4997). The host
3324/// compatprep.fixtures and its pinned-root twin both build
3325/// $VALIDATE_RUN_STATE/strict-compat/real-compat-fixtures, with different
3326/// toolchains, and the bucket depends only on the twin. If the host copy
3327/// kept its full/portable labels it stayed selected with no consumer and
3328/// could rm -rf and rebuild the shared directory while cells were reading
3329/// it, so the same cell saw different inputs across runs. When the twin
3330/// exists, retire the host copy from the local profiles; the authored
3331/// hosted variant (compatprep.fixtures_on_host) is a separate step.
3332fn retire_host_fixtures_when_twin_present(cfg: &mut DagConfig) {
3333    // Called after the twins are pushed into cfg, so the twin is visible
3334    // in cfg.steps.
3335    let twin_present = cfg
3336        .steps
3337        .iter()
3338        .any(|step| step.tag() == "compatprep.fixtures_in_pinned_root");
3339    if !twin_present {
3340        return;
3341    }
3342    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3343        if step.tag() == "compatprep.fixtures" {
3344            step.labels
3345                .retain(|label| label != "full" && label != "portable");
3346        }
3347    }
3348}
3349
3350fn materialize_pinned_root(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
3351    cfg.steps.retain(|step| {
3352        step.tag() != PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_TAG && !step.job.ends_with(PINNED_ROOT_TWIN_SUFFIX)
3353    });
3354
3355    let producers = cfg
3356        .steps
3357        .iter()
3358        .filter(|step| is_pinned_root_producer(step))
3359        .cloned()
3360        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
3361    let producer_tags = producers.iter().map(Step::tag).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
3362    let has_rust_scripts = producer_tags.contains("build.rust_scripts");
3363
3364    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3365        if is_hosted_variant(step) {
3366            continue;
3367        }
3368        if !runs_in_pinned_root(step) {
3369            continue;
3370        }
3371        if step.tag() == "test.envelope_levels" {
3372            let previous =
3373                "ARGS='run --base-env=minimal --no-virtualize-cpuid --max-timeslice=disabled'";
3374            if step.cmd.matches(previous).count() != 1 {
3375                return Err(
3376                    "working-envelope command lost its exact guest argument boundary".into(),
3377                );
3378            }
3379            step.cmd = step.cmd.replace(previous, "ARGS='run --base-env=minimal --no-virtualize-cpuid --max-timeslice=disabled --mount=type=tmpfs,target=/test --workdir=/test'");
3380        }
3381        step.env
3382            .insert("HERMIT_E2E_EMPTY_WORKDIR".into(), "/test".into());
3383        step.deps = step
3384            .deps
3385            .iter()
3386            .map(|dependency| {
3387                if producer_tags.contains(dependency) {
3388                    pinned_root_twin_tag(dependency)
3389                } else {
3390                    dependency.clone()
3391                }
3392            })
3393            .collect();
3394        // The image supplies Nextest. Test execution consumes the metadata
3395        // prepared in that same root, not a host installation or Cargo cache.
3396        step.deps.retain(|dependency| dependency != "setup.nextest");
3397        // The dev-profile consumers build in target directories of their own and
3398        // read nothing the validate-profile build writes, so they do not wait for it
3399        // (DEV_PROFILE_PINNED_CONSUMERS). Hosted variants are skipped above and keep
3400        // their order: a hosted runner has too little memory for clippy beside the
3401        // workspace build.
3402        if DEV_PROFILE_PINNED_CONSUMERS.contains(&step.tag().as_str()) {
3403            let e2e_artifact = pinned_root_twin_tag("build.e2e_artifact");
3404            step.deps.retain(|dependency| *dependency != e2e_artifact);
3405        }
3406        if (step.group == "privileged-e2e" || step.group == "e2e")
3407            && producer_tags.contains("build.e2e_artifact")
3408            && !step
3409                .deps
3410                .iter()
3411                .any(|dependency| dependency == "build.e2e_artifact_in_pinned_root")
3412        {
3413            step.deps.push("build.e2e_artifact_in_pinned_root".into());
3414        }
3415        if has_rust_scripts
3416            && !step
3417                .deps
3418                .iter()
3419                .any(|dependency| dependency == "build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root")
3420        {
3421            step.deps.push("build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root".into());
3422        }
3423        if !step
3424            .deps
3425            .iter()
3426            .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_TAG)
3427        {
3428            step.deps.push(PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_TAG.into());
3429        }
3430        // The isolation matrix reads and hashes the declared installation
3431        // (target/install_pkg) before and after every cell, and
3432        // build.workspace_in_pinned_root is the node whose stager
3433        // (stage-detcore-liteinst) rewrites install_pkg/libdetcore_liteinst.so
3434        // while the matrix runs: in 3 of 3 failing donor jobs the stager
3435        // rewrote it +7.5 to +25.4 s into the matrix and the same cells
3436        // failed input_stability; in the 2 passing jobs the compile ran
3437        // past the matrix (+173/+188 s). This is a true data dependency -
3438        // the matrix hashes that node's output - not an ordering hint
3439        // (https://github.com/rrnewton/dev-hermit-beads/blob/main/issues/dh-j8eb7.md).
3440        if ISOLATION_MATRIX_TAGS.contains(&step.tag().as_str())
3441            && !step
3442                .deps
3443                .iter()
3444                .any(|dependency| dependency == "build.workspace_in_pinned_root")
3445        {
3446            step.deps.push("build.workspace_in_pinned_root".into());
3447            step.deps.sort();
3448            step.deps.dedup();
3449        }
3450        step.deps.sort();
3451        step.deps.dedup();
3452        if !step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ") {
3453            step.cmd = pinned_root_command(step);
3454        } else {
3455            step.cmd = refresh_pinned_root_environment(&step.tag(), &step.cmd)?;
3456        }
3457    }
3458
3459    let mut twins = Vec::with_capacity(producers.len());
3460    for producer in &producers {
3461        let mut twin = producer.clone();
3462        twin.job.push_str(PINNED_ROOT_TWIN_SUFFIX);
3463        twin.labels.retain(|label| label != HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL);
3464        if producer.tag() == "compatprep.hermit_release" {
3465            twin.labels
3466                .retain(|label| label == "portable-strict-compat-only");
3467        }
3468        twin.deps = producer
3469            .deps
3470            .iter()
3471            .filter(|dependency| producer_tags.contains(*dependency))
3472            .map(|dependency| pinned_root_twin_tag(dependency))
3473            .collect();
3474        if producer.tag() == "build.e2e_artifact" {
3475            // This host-only node is a no-op in the default Cargo mode. In the
3476            // explicit Buck mode it prepares one content-addressed binary
3477            // before the network-disabled pinned root installs those bytes.
3478            twin.deps.push("build.buck_release_artifact".into());
3479        }
3480        // The ordinary-runtime prebuild runs no rust-script, so it starts beside
3481        // the workspace compile rather than after the rust-script tools.
3482        if producer.tag() != "build.rust_scripts"
3483            && producer.tag() != LITEINST_RUNTIME_TAG
3484            && has_rust_scripts
3485        {
3486            twin.deps.push("build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root".into());
3487        }
3488        if producer.job == "manifest_guests" && producer_tags.contains("setup.manifest_plan") {
3489            twin.deps.push("setup.manifest_plan_in_pinned_root".into());
3490        }
3491        // The host rust-script producer prepares the tracked Rust dagrun before
3492        // opening its Cargo build directory. The pinned-root twin has private
3493        // agent-utils state and publishes only rust-script artifacts, so it
3494        // must not repeat that host-cache preparation.
3495        if producer.tag() == "build.rust_scripts" {
3496            if twin.cmd.matches(DAGRUN_PREPARE_COMMAND).count() != 1 {
3497                return Err(
3498                    "rust-script producer lost its exact dagrun preparation boundary".into(),
3499                );
3500            }
3501            twin.cmd = twin.cmd.replacen(DAGRUN_PREPARE_COMMAND, "", 1);
3502            if twin.cmd.matches(RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_INVOCATION).count() != 1 {
3503                return Err(
3504                    "rust-script producer lost its one prepare-rust-scripts.sh call".into(),
3505                );
3506            }
3507            twin.cmd = twin.cmd.replacen(
3508                RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_INVOCATION,
3509                RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_RELEASE_ONLY_INVOCATION,
3510                1,
3511            );
3512            twin.description.push_str(
3513                " RELEASE-ONLY IN THE PINNED ROOT 2026-10-17: this twin runs ci/prepare-rust-scripts.sh --release-only, which publishes the release executables alone, without the clippy pass or the test harnesses. No pinned-root node runs a script's test harness (check.script_unit_tests runs them on the host, against build.rust_scripts), the host producer already runs clippy over the same sources with the same compiler, and ci/rust-script-bin refuses a test-harness request against a release-only publication by name. Measured cold at CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8: clippy 106 CPU-s; release plus harnesses 1,138 CPU-s, roughly a third of it the debug harness build.",
3514            );
3515        }
3516        if producer.tag() == "compatprep.hermit_release" {
3517            twin.deps.push("gate.manifest".into());
3518        }
3519        if producer.tag() == "build.e2e_artifact" {
3520            // The pinned publisher is the one early consumer of the compile
3521            // node's hermit-bin signal. It stages the LiteInst runtime itself
3522            // and publishes while that compile finishes; the prepare node
3523            // later gates the snapshot against the final staged tree. The
3524            // hosted publisher keeps its prepared-record assertion.
3525            let local_assert = "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs assert full && ";
3526            if twin.cmd.matches(local_assert).count() != 1 {
3527                return Err(
3528                    "pinned E2E publisher lost its exact Cargo preparation assertion".into(),
3529                );
3530            }
3531            twin.cmd = twin.cmd.replace(
3532                local_assert,
3533                "target/validate/stage-detcore-liteinst --source-copy target && ",
3534            );
3535            twin.deps
3536                .retain(|dependency| dependency != PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG);
3537            if producer_tags.contains(LITEINST_RUNTIME_TAG) {
3538                twin.deps.push(pinned_root_twin_tag(LITEINST_RUNTIME_TAG));
3539            }
3540            twin.artifact_deps.push(dagrun::model::ArtifactDep {
3541                step: PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG.into(),
3542                artifact: HERMIT_BIN_ARTIFACT.into(),
3543            });
3544            twin.description.push_str(
3545                " EARLY IN THE PINNED ROOT: this twin stages the LiteInst runtime itself and publishes on the compile node's hermit-bin signal, before Nextest preparation; build.workspace_in_pinned_root depends on it and verifies the snapshot against the final binary and staged resources.",
3546            );
3547        }
3548        twin.deps.push(PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_TAG.into());
3549        twin.deps.sort();
3550        twin.deps.dedup();
3551        twin.env
3552            .insert("HERMIT_E2E_EMPTY_WORKDIR".into(), "/test".into());
3553        // Only the trailing `nextest-binaries.rs prepare` needs the prebuilt
3554        // rust-script tools, so the Cargo half starts without them. The
3555        // packaged-LiteInst finalizer in the prepare half reuses the ordinary
3556        // runtime the prebuild twin compiled, so only that half waits for it.
3557        if producer.tag() == "build.workspace" {
3558            let mut halves = split_pinned_workspace_twin(twin)?;
3559            if producer_tags.contains(LITEINST_RUNTIME_TAG) {
3560                let prepare = &mut halves[1];
3561                prepare
3562                    .deps
3563                    .push(pinned_root_twin_tag(LITEINST_RUNTIME_TAG));
3564                prepare.deps.sort();
3565                prepare.deps.dedup();
3566            }
3567            if producer_tags.contains("build.e2e_artifact") {
3568                let prepare = &mut halves[1];
3569                prepare
3570                    .deps
3571                    .push(pinned_root_twin_tag("build.e2e_artifact"));
3572                prepare.deps.sort();
3573                prepare.deps.dedup();
3574            }
3575            twins.extend(halves);
3576            continue;
3577        }
3578        twin.cmd = pinned_root_command(&twin);
3579        twins.push(twin);
3580    }
3581
3582    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3583        if step.tag() == "compatprep.hermit_release" {
3584            step.labels
3585                .retain(|label| label != "portable-strict-compat-only");
3586        }
3587    }
3588    cfg.steps.push(pinned_root_fetch()?);
3589    cfg.steps.extend(twins);
3590    route_host_consumers_to_pinned_build(cfg)?;
3591    // Prepared-executable consumers used to reach the prepare node
3592    // transitively through the E2E publisher. That edge now runs the other
3593    // way (prepare gates the publisher's early snapshot), so a consumer
3594    // carrying a prepared Cargo selection must name the prepare node
3595    // directly; its executables are not ready at the hermit-bin signal.
3596    if cfg
3597        .steps
3598        .iter()
3599        .any(|step| step.tag() == PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG)
3600    {
3601        for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3602            if step
3603                .deps
3604                .iter()
3605                .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG)
3606                && step
3607                    .env
3608                    .contains_key(crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV)
3609            {
3610                step.deps.push(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG.into());
3611                step.deps.sort();
3612                step.deps.dedup();
3613            }
3614        }
3615    }
3616    // Retire after routing: clearing the host fixtures step's labels first
3617    // would exempt it from routing, leaving its dependency on the host
3618    // build producers in place and keeping those retired producers alive.
3619    retire_host_fixtures_when_twin_present(cfg);
3620    retire_unconsumed_host_producers(cfg);
3621    if cfg.steps.iter().any(|step| {
3622        step.deps
3623            .iter()
3624            .any(|dependency| dependency == "compatprep.hermit_release")
3625    }) {
3626        return Err("first-party graph retained a host focused-template consumer".into());
3627    }
3628    cfg.steps
3629        .retain(|step| step.tag() != "compatprep.hermit_release");
3630    Ok(())
3631}

3633// These six shared ancestors need separate immutable IDs because quick/super
3634// use the measured 1200-second Rust-script CPU budget, while the other profiles
3635// keep the established 7200-second cold-build budget. This is generation, not
3636// a runtime rewrite of the selected graph. Each `selftest.<name>` node also
3637// gets a variant (`is_quick_super_variant`): it depends on gate.manifest, so
3638// without one a quick/super selection would pull the ordinary producers too.
3639const QUICK_SUPER_VARIANTS: &[&str] = &[
3640    "build.rust_scripts",
3641    "build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root",
3642    "gate.manifest",
3643    "setup.manifest_plan",
3644    "setup.manifest_plan_in_pinned_root",
3645    "setup.nextest",
3646];
3647
3648fn quick_super_variant(tag: &str) -> String {
3649    format!("quick-super-{tag}")
3650}
3651
3652fn is_quick_super_variant(tag: &str) -> bool {
3653    QUICK_SUPER_VARIANTS.contains(&tag)
3654        || tag
3655            .strip_prefix(TOOL_SELF_TEST_GROUP_PREFIX)
3656            .is_some_and(|name| TOOL_SELF_TESTS.iter().any(|tool| tool.name == name))
3657}
3658
3659fn materialize_quick_super_budgets(cfg: &mut DagConfig) {
3660    let is_quick_super = |label: &str| matches!(label, "quick" | "super");
3661    let mut variants = Vec::new();
3662    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3663        if is_quick_super_variant(&step.tag()) {
3664            let mut variant = step.clone();
3665            variant.group = format!("quick-super-{}", variant.group);
3666            variant.labels.retain(|label| is_quick_super(label));
3667            variant.fail_fast_family = Some(variant.tag());
3668            if step.group == "build" {
3669                variant.timeout = crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_WALL_SECONDS;
3670                variant.cpu_timeout =
3671                    crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_QUICK_SUPER_CPU_SECONDS;
3672                variant.hint.rss_baseline_bytes =
3673                    Some(crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_RSS_BASELINE_BYTES);
3674                variant.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes =
3675                    Some(crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_HARD_MEM_MAX_BYTES);
3676                variant.hint.est_duration_s = 0.0;
3677            }
3678            step.labels.retain(|label| !is_quick_super(label));
3679            variants.push(variant);
3680        }
3681    }
3682    cfg.steps.extend(variants);
3683    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3684        if !step.labels.is_empty() && step.labels.iter().all(|label| is_quick_super(label)) {
3685            for dependency in &mut step.deps {
3686                if is_quick_super_variant(dependency) {
3687                    *dependency = quick_super_variant(dependency);
3688                }
3689            }
3690            step.deps.sort();
3691            step.deps.dedup();
3692        }
3693    }
3694}

3696/// DAG label marking a super-labelled node as pressure-tier: measured
3697/// nightly by the pressure sweep, excluded from the alerting super
3698/// selection until it has hermetic-image pass evidence (owner model
3699/// 2026-11-04: super is expected-pass; pressure owns the negative
3700/// space). Selected directly with `dagrun run --labels pressure`.
3701pub const PRESSURE_LABEL: &str = "pressure";
3702
3703/// Super-labelled nodes with no hermetic-image pass evidence. Each is
3704/// a diagnostic/stress node by construction (nonblocking unmeasured
3705/// probes, the host-sensitive mem_race family, weekly ignored/chaos
3706/// cases, determinism diagnostics) or a producer only those nodes
3707/// consume. A node leaves this list only with retained pass evidence
3708/// in the pinned root, recorded in its promotion change.
3709const PRESSURE_NODES: &[&str] = &[
3710    "super-compatprep.fixtures",
3711    "super.chaos_hello_race_verification_diagnostic",
3712    "super.full_leveldb_strict_determinism",
3713    "super.ipc_determinism_diagnostic",
3714    "super.managed_jvm_strict_verify_diagnostics",
3715    "super.network_syscall_determinism_diagnostic",
3716    "super.pmu_analyze_hello_race_stress_calibrated_skid",
3717    "super.pmu_buck_chaos_cases",
3718    "super.post_fork_scheduling_diagnostics",
3719    "super.pselect_signal_interruption_diagnostic",
3720    "super.random_source_determinism_diagnostic",
3721    "super.record_replay_matrix_diagnostic",
3722    "super.relaxed_hermit_flag_matrix",
3723    "super.sqlite_veryquick_strict_determinism",
3724    "super.threaded_integration_matrix_diagnostic",
3725    "super.weekly_ignored_portable_chaos_cases",
3726    "super.weekly_pmu_parallel_memory_diagnostic_mem_race_bottom_detcore",
3727    "super.weekly_pmu_parallel_memory_diagnostic_mem_race_default_detcore",
3728    "super.weekly_pmu_parallel_memory_diagnostic_mem_race_middle_detcore",
3729    "super.weekly_pmu_parallel_memory_diagnostic_mem_race_top_detcore",
3730    "super.weekly_portable_chaos_cases",
3731    "super.weekly_relaxed_default_mode_cases",
3732    "supercompat.manifest_compat",
3733    "superstress.kvm_available",
3734    "superstress.kvm_verify",
3735    "superstress.ptrace_pipeline",
3736    "superstress.ptrace_record_replay",
3737    "superstress.ptrace_strict_verify",
3738];
3739
3740fn materialize_pressure_labels(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
3741    let mut marked = 0usize;
3742    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3743        if PRESSURE_NODES.contains(&step.tag().as_str()) {
3744            if !step.labels.iter().any(|label| label == "super") {
3745                return Err(format!(
3746                    "pressure node {} does not carry the super label it re-tiers from",
3747                    step.tag()
3748                ));
3749            }
3750            if !step.labels.iter().any(|label| label == PRESSURE_LABEL) {
3751                step.labels.push(PRESSURE_LABEL.to_string());
3752                step.labels.sort();
3753            }
3754            marked += 1;
3755        }
3756    }
3757    if marked != PRESSURE_NODES.len() {
3758        return Err(format!(
3759            "pressure re-tier marked {marked} of {} named nodes; a renamed or \
3760             retired node must update PRESSURE_NODES with its evidence",
3761            PRESSURE_NODES.len()
3762        ));
3763    }
3764    Ok(())
3765}
