3767/// Keep direct preflight dependencies on host commands and tests so focused
3768/// selection cannot drop their source/gate ordering. Pinned preparation retains
3769/// its original pin/fetch prerequisites and can overlap the manifest audit.
3770/// A preflight check (group `pre`) is not given the manifest gate either: it is
3771/// preflight itself and consumes nothing the audit produces, so it keeps its
3772/// authored dependencies plus the pin gate. Given the gate, pre.cargo_lock
3773/// (a 900-second wall) ran after the whole portable preflight chain and moved
3774/// its critical path from 3900 to 4800 seconds, past the preflight job's bound.
3775fn materialize_focused_preflight(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
3776    for (labels, gate, pin, manifest_producer) in [
3777        (
3778            vec![
3779                "full",
3780                "portable",
3781                "quick",
3782                "super",
3783                "privileged",
3784                HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL,
3785            ],
3786            "gate.manifest",
3787            "pre.reverie_pin",
3788            "setup.manifest_plan",
3789        ),
3790        (
3791            vec![HOSTED_PRIVILEGED_LABEL],
3792            "gate.manifest_on_host",
3793            "pre.reverie_pin_on_host",
3794            "setup.manifest_plan_on_host",
3795        ),
3796    ] {
3797        let selected = select_steps_by_labels(
3798            cfg,
3799            &labels.into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
3800        )?;
3801        let executable_tags = selected
3802            .steps
3803            .iter()
3804            .map(Step::tag)
3805            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
3806        let preflight = dagrun::select_steps_by_tags(cfg, &[gate.into()], false)?;
3807        let gate_ancestors = preflight
3808            .steps
3809            .iter()
3810            .map(Step::tag)
3811            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
3812        let pin_preflight = dagrun::select_steps_by_tags(cfg, &[pin.into()], false)?;
3813        let pin_ancestors = pin_preflight
3814            .steps
3815            .iter()
3816            .map(Step::tag)
3817            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
3818        for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3819            let tag = step.tag();
3820            if !executable_tags.contains(&tag) {
3821                continue;
3822            }
3823            let pinned_preparation =
3824                step.job.ends_with(PINNED_ROOT_TWIN_SUFFIX) || tag == PINNED_ROOT_FETCH_TAG;
3825            let preflight_check = step.group == "pre";
3826            if !pinned_preparation && !preflight_check && !gate_ancestors.contains(&tag) {
3827                step.deps.push(gate.into());
3828            }
3829            if !pin_ancestors.contains(&tag) && !gate_ancestors.contains(&tag) {
3830                step.deps.push(pin.into());
3831            }
3832            // Manifest commands need their canonical test-harness producer
3833            // even when focused selection uses other already-built artifacts.
3834            if is_manifest_run(step)
3835                || step
3836                    .job
3837                    .strip_suffix(HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX)
3838                    .unwrap_or(&step.job)
3839                    == "manifest_guests"
3840            {
3841                step.deps.push(manifest_producer.into());
3842                if step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ") {
3843                    step.deps.push("setup.manifest_plan_in_pinned_root".into());
3844                }
3845            }
3846            step.deps.sort();
3847            step.deps.dedup();
3848        }
3849    }
3850    Ok(())
3851}
3852
3853fn materialize_runtime_policy(cfg: &mut DagConfig) {
3854    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3855        if step.fail_fast_family.is_none() {
3856            step.fail_fast_family = Some(step.tag());
3857        }
3858        // The CLI verbosity is scheduler invocation policy. Leaving a fixed
3859        // value on every node both duplicates that policy and prevents a
3860        // caller-selected level from reaching child helpers.
3861        step.env.remove("VALIDATE_VERBOSITY");
3862    }
3863}
3864
3865fn materialize_regular_calibration_launch(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
3866    let producer = cfg
3867        .steps
3868        .iter()
3869        .any(|step| step.tag() == "build.rust_scripts");
3870    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
3871        match step.tag().as_str() {
3872            "test.regular_crates" => {
3873                if !producer
3874                    || !step.cmd.contains("--nextest-calibration")
3875                    || !step
3876                        .cmd
3877                        .contains("--calibration-launch-proof /run/hermit-nextest-launch.json")
3878                {
3879                    return Err(
3880                        "regular pinned calibration lost its explicit launch observation boundary"
3881                            .into(),
3882                    );
3883                }
3884                step.deps.push("build.rust_scripts".into());
3885                step.deps.sort();
3886                step.deps.dedup();
3887            }
3888            "test.regular_crates_on_host" => {
3889                const RUNNER: &str = "./ci/run-nextest-counted.sh";
3890                if step.cmd.matches(RUNNER).count() != 1 || step.cmd.contains("--calibration-") {
3891                    return Err(
3892                        "regular host calibration requires its explicit native command boundary"
3893                            .into(),
3894                    );
3895                }
3896                step.cmd = step
3897                    .cmd
3898                    .replace(RUNNER, &format!("{RUNNER} --calibration-host"));
3899                if step.cmd.matches(REGULAR_CRATES_SELECTION_END).count() != 1 {
3900                    return Err(format!(
3901                        "test.regular_crates_on_host must end its selection with \
3902                         `{REGULAR_CRATES_SELECTION_END}` once"
3903                    ));
3904                }
3905                step.cmd = step.cmd.replacen(
3906                    REGULAR_CRATES_SELECTION_END,
3907                    &format!(
3908                        "{REGULAR_CRATES_SELECTION_END}{}",
3909                        hosted_exclusion_filterset(HOSTED_PORTABLE_PMU_TIMER_REPLAY_TESTS)
3910                    ),
3911                    1,
3912                );
3913            }
3914            _ => {}
3915        }
3916    }
3917    Ok(())
3918}

3920#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
3921enum GeneratedPartition {
3922    PortableCompat,
3923    PortableFocusedCompat,
3924    SabreCompat,
3925    E9patchCompat,
3926    RrCompat,
3927    SuperCompat,
3928    SuperStress,
3929}
3930
3931fn generated_partition(step: &Step) -> Option<GeneratedPartition> {
3932    match step.group.as_str() {
3933        // The focused lane's corpus is the static bucket node
3934        // portablecompat.manifest_compat; only its fixtures are generated.
3935        "portablecompatprep" => {
3936            return Some(GeneratedPartition::PortableFocusedCompat);
3937        }
3938        // The SaBRe lane's rows are the compat.yaml cells labelled
3939        // sabre-compat-only, run by the static node
3940        // sabrecompat.manifest_compat; only its fixtures are generated.
3941        "sabrecompatprep" => return Some(GeneratedPartition::SabreCompat),
3942        "e9patchcompat" | "e9patchcompatprep" => {
3943            return Some(GeneratedPartition::E9patchCompat);
3944        }
3945        // The rr lane's rows are the compat.yaml replay cells labelled
3946        // rr-compat-only, run by the static node rrcompat.manifest_compat;
3947        // only its fixtures are generated.
3948        "rrcompatprep" => return Some(GeneratedPartition::RrCompat),
3949        _ => {}
3950    }
3951    if step.group == "superstress" {
3952        return Some(GeneratedPartition::SuperStress);
3953    }
3954    // The super run type's compat rows are the compat.yaml heavy rows' ptrace
3955    // cells, run by the static node supercompat.manifest_compat; only their
3956    // fixtures are generated.
3957    if step.tag() == "super-compatprep.fixtures" {
3958        return Some(GeneratedPartition::SuperCompat);
3959    }
3960    if step.tag() == "compatprep.fixtures"
3961        || (step.group == "compat"
3962            && step
3963                .labels
3964                .iter()
3965                .any(|label| matches!(label.as_str(), "portable" | "full")))
3966    {
3967        return Some(GeneratedPartition::PortableCompat);
3968    }
3969    None
3970}
3971
3972fn partition_source_tags(partition: GeneratedPartition, core_only: bool) -> BTreeSet<String> {
3973    use GeneratedPartition::*;
3974    let (prefixes, exact): (&[&str], &[&str]) = match partition {
3975        PortableCompat => (&["compat."], &["compatprep.fixtures"]),
3976        PortableFocusedCompat => (&["portablecompatprep."], &[]),
3977        SabreCompat => (&["sabrecompatprep."], &[]),
3978        E9patchCompat => (&["e9patchcompat.", "e9patchcompatprep."], &[]),
3979        RrCompat => (&["rrcompatprep."], &[]),
3980        SuperCompat => (&[], &["super-compatprep.fixtures"]),
3981        SuperStress => (&["superstress."], &[]),
3982    };
3983    crate::dag_source_ownership::source_partition_tags(prefixes, exact, core_only)
3984}
3985fn refresh_generated_partitions(
3986    mut committed: DagConfig,
3987    generated: DagConfig,
3988) -> Result<DagConfig, String> {
3989    // These complete original partition oracles retain their source meaning.
3990    // External physical producers moved to the real catalogs; their absence
3991    // is not turned into a smaller original assertion or a successful result.
3992    const ORIGINAL: &[(GeneratedPartition, usize)] = &[
3993        (GeneratedPartition::PortableCompat, 1),
3994        (GeneratedPartition::PortableFocusedCompat, 1),
3995        (GeneratedPartition::SabreCompat, 1),
3996        (GeneratedPartition::E9patchCompat, 175),
3997        (GeneratedPartition::RrCompat, 1),
3998        (GeneratedPartition::SuperCompat, 1),
3999        (GeneratedPartition::SuperStress, 7),
4000    ];
4001    let mut replacements = BTreeMap::<GeneratedPartition, Vec<Step>>::new();
4002    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
4003    for step in generated.steps {
4004        if !seen.insert(step.tag()) {
4005            return Err(format!("duplicate actual generated node {}", step.tag()));
4006        }
4007        let Some(partition) = generated_partition(&step) else {
4008            if step.labels == ["generator-dependency-anchor"] || step.tag() == "build.rust_scripts"
4009            {
4010                continue;
4011            }
4012            return Err(format!(
4013                "generated exporter emitted static-looking node {}",
4014                step.tag()
4015            ));
4016        };
4017        replacements.entry(partition).or_default().push(step);
4018    }
4019    let mut expected_partitions = BTreeSet::new();
4020    for &(partition, original_count) in ORIGINAL {
4021        let original = partition_source_tags(partition, false);
4022        if original.len() != original_count {
4023            return Err(format!(
4024                "original {partition:?} source partition changed: {} != {original_count}",
4025                original.len()
4026            ));
4027        }
4028        let expected = partition_source_tags(partition, true);
4029        let actual = replacements
4030            .get(&partition)
4031            .into_iter()
4032            .flatten()
4033            .map(Step::tag)
4034            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4035        if actual != expected {
4036            return Err(format!(
4037                "actual core {partition:?} source tags changed: {actual:?} != {expected:?}"
4038            ));
4039        }
4040        if !expected.is_empty() {
4041            expected_partitions.insert(partition);
4042        }
4043    }
4044    let mut inserted = BTreeSet::new();
4045    let mut steps = Vec::with_capacity(committed.steps.len());
4046    for step in committed.steps {
4047        let Some(partition) = generated_partition(&step) else {
4048            steps.push(step);
4049            continue;
4050        };
4051        if !expected_partitions.contains(&partition) {
4052            return Err(format!(
4053                "core static source retained external partition {partition:?}"
4054            ));
4055        }
4056        if inserted.insert(partition) {
4057            steps.extend(
4058                replacements
4059                    .remove(&partition)
4060                    .expect("validated core partition exists"),
4061            );
4062        }
4063    }
4064    for &(partition, _) in ORIGINAL {
4065        if expected_partitions.contains(&partition) && inserted.insert(partition) {
4066            steps.extend(
4067                replacements
4068                    .remove(&partition)
4069                    .expect("validated core partition exists"),
4070            );
4071        }
4072    }
4073    if inserted != expected_partitions || !replacements.is_empty() {
4074        return Err("core generated partition placement changed".into());
4075    }
4076    committed.steps = steps;
4077    Ok(committed)
4078}

4080fn attach_result_ownership(cfg: &mut DagConfig, cells: &Populations) {
4081    for step in &mut cfg.steps {
4082        let structured = step
4083            .result_manifests
4084            .take()
4085            .unwrap_or_default()
4086            .into_iter()
4087            .filter(|manifest| matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)))
4088            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4089        let hosted_portable = step.labels == [HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL];
4090        let portable_focused = step.tag() == PORTABLE_FOCUSED_COMPAT_TAG;
4091        let mut owned = cells
4092            .owned_by(step)
4093            .into_iter()
4094            .filter(|cell| !(hosted_portable && hosted_portable_excludes(cell)))
4095            .filter(|cell| !(portable_focused && portable_focused_excludes(cell)))
4096            .cloned()
4097            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4098        if step.tag() == "quick.e2e_verify" {
4099            owned.extend(cells.iter().filter(|cell| quick_verify_cell(cell)).cloned());
4100        }
4101        owned.sort_by_key(result_identity);
4102        let mut manifests = owned
4103            .into_iter()
4104            .map(ResultManifest::ManifestCell)
4105            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4106        manifests.extend(structured);
4107        step.result_manifests = Some(manifests);
4108    }
4109}

4111fn assert_structured_result_producers(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
4112    let mut expected = BTreeMap::<&str, StructuredResultProducerKind>::new();
4113    for kind in StructuredResultProducerKind::ALL {
4114        for tag in kind.tags() {
4115            if expected.insert(tag, kind).is_some() {
4116                return Err(format!(
4117                    "structured result producer registry declares {tag} more than once"
4118                ));
4119            }
4120        }
4121    }
4122    // 118 since the five super stress probe nodes, each writing one row per
4123    // repetition, joined them; 113 since rrcompat.manifest_compat, the rr
4124    // lane's bucket, joined them;
4125    // 112 since strictcompat.manifest_compat, the strict lane's bucket, joined
4126    // them; 111 since sabrecompat.manifest_compat, the SaBRe lane's bucket, joined
4127    // them; 110 since portablecompat.manifest_compat, the focused lane's corpus
4128    // bucket, joined them; 109 since e2e.manifest_compat and its hosted twin
4129    // joined the test-harness producers (2026-10-01); 120 since
4130    // test.detcore_time and its hosted twin were enrolled; 121 since
4131    // privileged-test.pmu_detcore_time_cases took the 29 tests_time cases that
4132    // need a PMU (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3663). 137 with
4133    // the 16 Buck import twins. 133 since test.liteinst_strict, its hosted
4134    // twin, liteinst.strict and super.liteinst_python3_verify_diagnostics
4135    // were retired with the LiteInst host hybrid
4136    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3520). 134 since
4137    // test.record_replay joined the Nextest producers. 135 since
4138    // test.pmu_integration_cases took the 25 external_signal_interrupt
4139    // ptrace cases that need the PMU timer.
4140    // One required local M1 target adds one Nextest result producer.
4141    // 137 with the additive required M2 stack consumer; all 136 prior producers remain.
4142    // 136 since strictcompat.manifest_compat was retired with the
4143    // compat/strict-<row> tests (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4276).
4144    // 137 with supercompat.manifest_compat, which runs the super run type's
4145    // heavy compat rows from compat.yaml (same issue).
4146    // test.inherited_terminal_read adds one producer for the six terminal regressions.
4147    // test.hermit_integration_2 and _3, the shards of the local
4148    // test.hermit_integration, add two; privileged-cpuid.cpu_profile_v3, the
4149    // must-qualify x86-64-v3 CLI cases, adds one more
4150    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4243).
4151    // test.pmu_integration_cases_2, the second PMU integration shard, adds one.
4152    // 145 since the isolation matrix's three nodes joined as Conformance
4153    // producers (2026-10-17).
4154    // 146 with sabrecompat.sabre_examples, the archived SaBRe suite's tests
4155    // outside the per-commit smoke pair (2026-10-26).
4156    // 147 with privileged-test.deadline_slice_cap_kvm, the KVM gap-ledger
4157    // producer (2026-10-30).
4158    // 148 with privileged-test.binder_cli_cases, the Binderfs-capable
4159    // privileged node for PR 4742's two host-limited Binder CLI cases.
4160    // 151 with the rr bucket's three producers (pinned, on-host, Buck
4161    // twin), the first post-split extension bucket (148 + 3); 154 with
4162    // the gvisor bucket's three producers.
4163    // 155 with test.hermit_native_exec, the native-exec cohort's counted
4164    // consumer (dh-10l17).
4165    if expected.len() != 155 {
4166        return Err(format!(
4167            "structured result producer registry has {} entries, expected 155",
4168            expected.len()
4169        ));
4170    }
4171
4172    let expected_core_group_counts = StructuredResultProducerKind::ALL
4173        .into_iter()
4174        .map(|kind| {
4175            kind.tags()
4176                .iter()
4177                .filter(|tag| crate::dag_source_ownership::is_admitted_core(tag))
4178                .count()
4179        })
4180        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4181    expected.retain(|tag, _| crate::dag_source_ownership::is_admitted_core(tag));
4182    let mut seen_by_kind = BTreeMap::<StructuredResultProducerKind, usize>::new();
4183    for step in &cfg.steps {
4184        let tag = step.tag();
4185        let command_kinds = StructuredResultProducerKind::ALL
4186            .into_iter()
4187            .filter_map(|kind| {
4188                let occurrences = step.cmd.matches(kind.command_marker()).count();
4189                (occurrences != 0).then_some((kind, occurrences))
4190            })
4191            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4192        let command_kind = match command_kinds.as_slice() {
4193            [] => None,
4194            [(kind, 1)] => Some(*kind),
4195            [(kind, occurrences)] => {
4196                return Err(format!(
4197                    "{tag} invokes the {kind:?} structured result producer {occurrences} times; expected exactly once"
4198                ));
4199            }
4200            _ => {
4201                return Err(format!(
4202                    "{tag} invokes more than one structured result producer: {command_kinds:?}"
4203                ));
4204            }
4205        };
4206        let command = crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(step)?;
4207        if command.contains("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED") {
4208            return Err(format!(
4209                "{tag} declares NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED in command text instead of typed step environment"
4210            ));
4211        }
4212        if command_kind == Some(StructuredResultProducerKind::Nextest)
4213            || command_kind == Some(StructuredResultProducerKind::KvmGapLedger)
4214            || step.cmd.contains("nextest-binaries.rs executable ")
4215        {
4216            crate::nextest_build_selections::assert_command_selection(step)?;
4217        }
4218        let declared = step
4219            .structured_test_results_manifest()
4220            .map_err(|error| format!("{tag}: {error}"))?;
4221        match (expected.remove(tag.as_str()), command_kind, declared) {
4222            (Some(expected_kind), Some(actual_kind), Some(manifest)) => {
4223                if actual_kind != expected_kind {
4224                    return Err(format!(
4225                        "{tag} is registered as {expected_kind:?} but invokes {actual_kind:?}"
4226                    ));
4227                }
4228                if manifest.owner != tag {
4229                    return Err(format!(
4230                        "{tag} declares structured result owner {:?}",
4231                        manifest.owner
4232                    ));
4233                }
4234                *seen_by_kind.entry(expected_kind).or_default() += 1;
4235            }
4236            (Some(expected_kind), None, _) => {
4237                return Err(format!(
4238                    "{tag} is registered as {expected_kind:?} but no longer invokes that writer"
4239                ));
4240            }
4241            (Some(expected_kind), Some(actual_kind), None) => {
4242                return Err(format!(
4243                    "{tag} invokes {actual_kind:?} and is registered as {expected_kind:?}, but omits its structured result declaration"
4244                ));
4245            }
4246            (None, Some(actual_kind), _) => {
4247                return Err(format!(
4248                    "{tag} invokes unregistered structured result producer {actual_kind:?}"
4249                ));
4250            }
4251            (None, None, Some(_)) => {
4252                return Err(format!(
4253                    "{tag} declares structured results but invokes no registered writer"
4254                ));
4255            }
4256            (None, None, None) if is_planned_test_node(step) => {
4257                return Err(format!(
4258                    "{tag} is a test node (scripts/validate.rs plans every test.*, *-test.* and *:test.* node and counts it executed only through its structured result file), but it invokes no registered structured result writer; register it, or a passing validation is never VALIDATED"
4259                ));
4260            }
4261            (None, None, None) => {}
4262        }
4263
4264        // Counted populations are census-guarded by identity (see
4265        // validation_dag_static): no DAG step may carry a pinned
4266        // NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED. The counted wrapper derives that
4267        // variable from the run's own inventory at run time; a value in
4268        // the committed DAG would be a count pin again.
4269        if let Some(actual) = step.env.get("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED") {
4270            return Err(format!(
4271                "{tag} declares retired NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED={actual:?}; counted populations are census-guarded, never pinned"
4272            ));
4273        }
4274    }
4275    if !expected.is_empty() {
4276        return Err(format!(
4277            "registered structured result producers are absent from the DAG: {}",
4278            expected.keys().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
4279        ));
4280    }
4281    let actual_group_counts = StructuredResultProducerKind::ALL
4282        .into_iter()
4283        .map(|kind| seen_by_kind.get(&kind).copied().unwrap_or_default())
4284        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4285    // TestHarness 34 -> 36 with the compat bucket and its hosted twin, and
4286    // 37 with the focused lane's portablecompat.manifest_compat, and 38 with
4287    // the SaBRe lane's sabrecompat.manifest_compat, and 39 with the strict
4288    // lane's strictcompat.manifest_compat, and 40 with the rr lane's
4289    // rrcompat.manifest_compat. Envelope 2 -> 7 with the five super stress
4290    // probe nodes. Nextest 69 -> 71 when test.detcore_time and its hosted twin
4291    // were enrolled, and 72 with privileged-test.pmu_detcore_time_cases
4292    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3663). TestHarness 56 with
4293    // the 16 Buck import twins. Nextest 68 since test.liteinst_strict, its
4294    // hosted twin, liteinst.strict and super.liteinst_python3_verify_diagnostics
4295    // were retired with the LiteInst host hybrid
4296    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3520), and 69 with
4297    // test.record_replay, and 70 with test.pmu_integration_cases.
4298    // The local required allocator and stack consumers each add one Nextest writer.
4299    // TestHarness 55 since strictcompat.manifest_compat was retired
4300    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4276), and 56 with
4301    // supercompat.manifest_compat (same issue).
4302    // test.inherited_terminal_read adds the 73rd Nextest writer; other groups are unchanged.
4303    // The shards test.hermit_integration_2 and _3 add the 74th and 75th;
4304    // privileged-cpuid.cpu_profile_v3 adds the 76th
4305    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4243).
4306    // The second PMU integration shard adds the 77th Nextest writer.
4307    // Conformance 3: the three isolation-matrix nodes (2026-10-17).
4308    // sabrecompat.sabre_examples adds the 78th Nextest writer (2026-10-26).
4309    if actual_group_counts != expected_core_group_counts {
4310        return Err(format!(
4311            "structured result producer group counts changed: {actual_group_counts:?}"
4312        ));
4313    }
4314    Ok(())
4315}

4317/// The node set scripts/validate.rs `test_nodes_of` plans as test nodes: its
4318/// per-node coverage counts each one executed only through the structured
4319/// result file it writes, so every one must be a registered producer.
4320fn is_planned_test_node(step: &Step) -> bool {
4321    step.group == "test" || step.group.ends_with("-test") || step.group.ends_with(":test")
4322}

4324fn result_identity(result: &DagManifest) -> String {
4325    format!(
4326        "{}/{}/{}/{}/{}",
4327        result.lane,
4328        result.category,
4329        result.test.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
4330        result.mode.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
4331        result.backend.as_deref().unwrap_or("")
4332    )
4333}
4334
4335/// The manifest-cell result selectors a step owns, borrowed.
4336///
4337/// The same population as `Step::effective_result_manifests`, which clones
4338/// every selector on every call: the explicit `result_manifests` cells when
4339/// the step declares them (an explicit empty list owns nothing), else its
4340/// `manifest` selector.
4341fn result_selectors(step: &Step) -> impl Iterator<Item = &DagManifest> + '_ {
4342    let explicit = step.result_manifests.as_deref();
4343    let fallback = if explicit.is_none() {
4344        step.manifest.as_ref()
4345    } else {
4346        None
4347    };
4348    explicit
4349        .into_iter()
4350        .flatten()
4351        .filter_map(|manifest| match manifest {
4352            ResultManifest::ManifestCell(cell) => Some(cell),
4353            ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_) => None,
4354        })
4355        .chain(fallback)
4356}
4357
4358/// Selector fields in the order `DagManifest::matches_exact_result` compares
4359/// them: lane, category, then test, mode and backend, where `None` matches
4360/// any value.
4361type SelectorKey<'a> = (
4362    &'a str,
4363    &'a str,
4364    Option<&'a str>,
4365    Option<&'a str>,
4366    Option<&'a str>,
4367);
4368
4369/// `result_manifest_owner` for many results against one step list.
4370///
4371/// `result_manifest_owner` scans every step and clones every step's
4372/// selectors for each result, so checking a profile's results costs results
4373/// times selectors, almost all of it allocation: 1,233 by 1,233 for the full
4374/// profile, about seven million selector clones across the profiles and the
4375/// Buck E2E selection, which made `generate` 80% of the scorecard self-test's
4376/// CPU time. This indexes the borrowed selectors once by their
4377/// exact fields. A selector matches an exact result exactly when its lane
4378/// and category are equal and each of test, mode and backend is either unset
4379/// or equal, so the owners of an exact result are precisely the steps under
4380/// the eight keys that set each of those three fields to the result's value
4381/// or leave it unset.
4382///
4383/// The index alone decides only the one-owner case. An inexact result, no
4384/// owner, or several owners is handed to `result_manifest_owner` itself, so
4385/// every refusal and its text are the library's own.
4386struct ResultOwnerIndex<'a> {
4387    steps: &'a [Step],
4388    owners: BTreeMap<SelectorKey<'a>, Vec<usize>>,
4389}
4390
4391impl<'a> ResultOwnerIndex<'a> {
4392    fn new(steps: &'a [Step]) -> Self {
4393        let mut owners = BTreeMap::<SelectorKey<'a>, Vec<usize>>::new();
4394        for (index, step) in steps.iter().enumerate() {
4395            for selector in result_selectors(step) {
4396                let key = (
4397                    selector.lane.as_str(),
4398                    selector.category.as_str(),
4399                    selector.test.as_deref(),
4400                    selector.mode.as_deref(),
4401                    selector.backend.as_deref(),
4402                );
4403                let steps = owners.entry(key).or_default();
4404                if steps.last() != Some(&index) {
4405                    steps.push(index);
4406                }
4407            }
4408        }
4409        Self { steps, owners }
4410    }
4411
4412    fn owner(&self, result: &DagManifest) -> Result<&'a Step, String> {
4413        let lane = result.lane.as_str();
4414        let category = result.category.as_str();
4415        let (Some(test), Some(mode), Some(backend)) = (
4416            result.test.as_deref(),
4417            result.mode.as_deref(),
4418            result.backend.as_deref(),
4419        ) else {
4420            return result_manifest_owner(self.steps, result);
4421        };
4422        if [lane, category, test, mode, backend]
4423            .iter()
4424            .any(|field| field.is_empty())
4425        {
4426            return result_manifest_owner(self.steps, result);
4427        }
4428        let mut found = Vec::new();
4429        for test in [Some(test), None] {
4430            for mode in [Some(mode), None] {
4431                for backend in [Some(backend), None] {
4432                    if let Some(steps) = self.owners.get(&(lane, category, test, mode, backend)) {
4433                        found.extend_from_slice(steps);
4434                    }
4435                }
4436            }
4437        }
4438        found.sort_unstable();
4439        found.dedup();
4440        match found.as_slice() {
4441            [owner] => Ok(&self.steps[*owner]),
4442            _ => result_manifest_owner(self.steps, result),
4443        }
4444    }
4445}
4446
4447/// Manifest categories the quick profile's pinned-root verify smoke
4448/// (quick.e2e_verify) omits: the compatibility corpus runs programs installed
4449/// on the validation host and reads fixtures compatprep.fixtures prepares,
4450/// neither of which the quick profile has. quick.e2e_verify passes
4451/// `--exclude-category` for each, and neither its expected cells nor its
4452/// owned results include them.
4453pub const QUICK_EXCLUDED_CATEGORIES: &[&str] = &["compat"];
4454
4455/// The exact harness command quick.e2e_verify runs, with one
4456/// `--exclude-category` per [`QUICK_EXCLUDED_CATEGORIES`] entry. The generator
4457/// requires the committed node to end with it and validate.rs requires it of
4458/// the raw publisher, so the omitted cells and the omitted results agree.
4459pub fn quick_verify_command() -> String {
4460    let mut command =
4461        "target/debug/test-harness run --lane portable --mode verify --backend ptrace --ci-only"
4462            .to_string();
4463    for category in QUICK_EXCLUDED_CATEGORIES {
4464        command.push_str(" --exclude-category ");
4465        command.push_str(category);
4466    }
4467    command
4468}
4469
4470fn quick_verify_cell(cell: &DagManifest) -> bool {
4471    cell.lane == "portable"
4472        && cell.mode.as_deref() == Some("verify")
4473        && cell.backend.as_deref() == Some("ptrace")
4474        && !QUICK_EXCLUDED_CATEGORIES.contains(&cell.category.as_str())
4475}
4476
4477fn expected_for_label<'a>(label: &str, cells: &'a [DagManifest]) -> Vec<&'a DagManifest> {
4478    cells
4479        .iter()
4480        .filter(|cell| match label {
4481            "full" => true,
4482            "portable" => cell.lane == "portable",
4483            HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL => cell.lane == "portable" && !hosted_portable_excludes(cell),
4484            HOSTED_PRIVILEGED_LABEL => cell.lane == "privileged",
4485            "privileged" => cell.lane == "privileged",
4486            "quick" => quick_verify_cell(cell),
4487            // The corpus-only run type runs exactly the strict compatibility
4488            // bucket, without the backends its release build cannot run.
4489            "portable-strict-compat-only" => {
4490                cell.lane == "portable"
4491                    && cell.category == "compat"
4492                    && !portable_focused_excludes(cell)
4493            }
4494            "super" => false,
4495            // The import twins own every cell, as the cargo buckets do in full.
4496            FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL => true,
4497            _ => false,
4498        })
4499        .collect()
4500}

4502/// The extension tags the Buck E2E selection drops, pinned by name.
4503/// Independent of any selection: a same-count swap must fail here.
4504const BUCK_E2E_EXTENSION_DROPPED: [&str; 2] = ["e2e.manifest_gvisor", "e2e.manifest_rr"];
4505
4506fn check_buck_e2e_extension_dropped(actual: &BTreeSet<String>) -> Result<(), String> {
4507    let expected = BUCK_E2E_EXTENSION_DROPPED
4508        .iter()
4509        .map(|tag| (*tag).to_string())
4510        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4511    if *actual != expected {
4512        return Err(format!(
4513            "the Buck E2E selection drops extension tags {actual:?}, expected exactly {expected:?}"
4514        ));
4515    }
4516    Ok(())
4517}
4518
4519/// The Buck full selection replaces exactly the cargo E2E path and reports
4520/// the same cells, each owned by exactly one node.
4521fn assert_buck_e2e_selection(cfg: &DagConfig, cells: &[DagManifest]) -> Result<(), String> {
4522    let replaced = buck_replaced_tags(cfg)?;
4523    let mut expected_replaced = BUCK_REPLACED_PRODUCERS
4524        .iter()
4525        .map(|tag| (*tag).to_string())
4526        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4527    expected_replaced.insert(FULL_SCORECARD_TAG.into());
4528    for category in [
4529        "applications",
4530        "bin_c",
4531        "c_programs",
4532        "chaos_c",
4533        "compat",
4534        "data_handling",
4535        "debugger_c",
4536        "determinism_stress",
4537        "determinism_stress_c",
4538        "gvisor",
4539        "language_runtimes",
4540        "rr",
4541        "shared_futex_c",
4542        "system_utils",
4543        "util_c",
4544    ] {
4545        expected_replaced.insert(format!("e2e.manifest_{category}"));
4546    }
4547    for category in ["applications", "c_programs", "system_utils"] {
4548        expected_replaced.insert(format!("privileged-e2e.manifest_{category}"));
4549    }
4550    let selected = buck_e2e_selection(cfg)?;
4551    let full = select_steps_by_labels(cfg, &["full".to_string()])?;
4552    let full_tags = full.steps.iter().map(Step::tag).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4553    let selected_tags = selected
4554        .steps
4555        .iter()
4556        .map(Step::tag)
4557        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4558    // The selection is the full profile minus the replaced nodes plus exactly
4559    // the full-buck-e2e nodes (on the committed DAG: 90 - 22 + 19 = 87, pinned
4560    // by committed_buck_e2e_selection_replaces_22_nodes_with_18, named before
4561    // e2e.buck_stage made the added nodes 19).
4562    let added = selected_tags
4563        .difference(&full_tags)
4564        .cloned()
4565        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4566    let buck_nodes = cfg
4567        .steps
4568        .iter()
4569        .filter(|step| step.labels == [FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL])
4570        .map(Step::tag)
4571        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4572    if added != buck_nodes {
4573        return Err(format!(
4574            "the Buck E2E selection adds {added:?}, expected the full-buck-e2e nodes {buck_nodes:?}"
4575        ));
4576    }
4577    let dropped = full_tags
4578        .difference(&selected_tags)
4579        .cloned()
4580        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4581    // A replaced producer may already be absent from full: since issue
4582    // 4997 the host compatprep.fixtures step is retired from full/portable
4583    // whenever its pinned-root twin exists (one writer for the shared
4584    // fixtures), so full cannot drop it again. It must still never be
4585    // selected by the Buck selection.
4586    let kept_replaced = replaced
4587        .intersection(&selected_tags)
4588        .cloned()
4589        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4590    if !kept_replaced.is_empty() {
4591        return Err(format!(
4592            "the Buck E2E selection still selects replaced node(s) {kept_replaced:?}"
4593        ));
4594    }
4595    // Extension tags present in full but absent from the selection are
4596    // dropped without being replaced. The expected set is pinned by
4597    // name, independently of the selection: deriving it from the
4598    // selection itself (as this code briefly did) cannot catch a swap
4599    // that drops a different extension tag at the same count.
4600    let extension_dropped = crate::dag_source_ownership::extension_tags()
4601        .iter()
4602        .filter(|tag| full_tags.contains(*tag) && !selected_tags.contains(*tag))
4603        .cloned()
4604        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4605    check_buck_e2e_extension_dropped(&extension_dropped)?;
4606    if replaced != expected_replaced {
4607        return Err(format!(
4608            "the Buck E2E selection replaces {:?}, expected {:?}",
4609            replaced, expected_replaced
4610        ));
4611    }
4612    let mut expected_dropped = replaced
4613        .intersection(&full_tags)
4614        .cloned()
4615        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4616    expected_dropped.extend(extension_dropped);
4617    if dropped != expected_dropped {
4618        return Err(format!(
4619            "the Buck E2E selection drops {dropped:?}, but replaces {replaced:?} (of which full had {expected_dropped:?})"
4620        ));
4621    }
4622    // The stage needs only the pinned Reverie, so it overlaps the producers
4623    // the cells wait for; the cells refuse inputs staged for another commit,
4624    // so they must wait for it.
4625    let runner_node = |tag: &str, flag: &str| {
4626        selected
4627            .steps
4628            .iter()
4629            .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
4630            .filter(|step| {
4631                step.cmd
4632                    .ends_with(&format!("./ci/buck-e2e/validate-node {flag}"))
4633            })
4634            .ok_or_else(|| {
4635                format!("the Buck E2E selection has no {tag} running validate-node {flag}")
4636            })
4637    };
4638    let stage = runner_node(BUCK_STAGE_TAG, "--stage-only")?;
4639    if stage.deps != ["pre.reverie_pin"] {
4640        return Err(format!(
4641            "{BUCK_STAGE_TAG} depends on {:?}, expected only pre.reverie_pin",
4642            stage.deps
4643        ));
4644    }
4645    let cells_node = runner_node(BUCK_CELLS_TAG, "--cells-only")?;
4646    if !cells_node.deps.iter().any(|dep| dep == BUCK_STAGE_TAG) {
4647        return Err(format!(
4648            "{BUCK_CELLS_TAG} does not wait for {BUCK_STAGE_TAG}"
4649        ));
4650    }
4651    // Keeping the records after the cells ran must end inside the bound dagrun
4652    // enforces, or completed work is reaped and reported as a timeout.
4653    let wall = cells_node.timeout.to_string();
4654    if cells_node.timeout == 0 || cells_node.env.get(BUCK_STEP_WALL_ENV) != Some(&wall) {
4655        return Err(format!(
4656            "{BUCK_CELLS_TAG} sets {BUCK_STEP_WALL_ENV} to {:?}, expected its wall bound {wall:?}",
4657            cells_node.env.get(BUCK_STEP_WALL_ENV)
4658        ));
4659    }
4660    for step in &selected.steps {
4661        if step.labels == [FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL]
4662            && !is_buck_runner_node(step)
4663            && !step
4664                .deps
4665                .iter()
4666                .any(|dep| dep == BUCK_CELLS_TAG || dep.ends_with(BUCK_TWIN_SUFFIX))
4667        {
4668            return Err(format!("{} does not wait for the Buck rows", step.tag()));
4669        }
4670        // A twin reads rows it is handed on the host; inside the pinned root
4671        // $VALIDATE_RUN_STATE would not name the rows e2e.buck_cells wrote.
4672        if is_buck_import_twin(step)
4673            && (step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh")
4674                || step.cmd.matches("E2E_IMPORT_RESULTS=").count() != 1
4675                || step.cmd.contains("run-with-hermit-e2e-artifact"))
4676        {
4677            return Err(format!(
4678                "{} is not a host-side import of the Buck rows",
4679                step.tag()
4680            ));
4681        }
4682    }
4683    let expected = expected_for_label("full", cells);
4684    let owners = ResultOwnerIndex::new(&selected.steps);
4685    for result in &expected {
4686        owners
4687            .owner(result)
4688            .map_err(|error| format!("Buck E2E result ownership failed: {error}"))?;
4689    }
4690    let expected_ids = expected
4691        .into_iter()
4692        .map(result_identity)
4693        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4694    let actual_ids = selected
4695        .steps
4696        .iter()
4697        .flat_map(result_selectors)
4698        .map(result_identity)
4699        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
4700    if actual_ids != expected_ids {
4701        return Err(format!(
4702            "the Buck E2E selection reports {} cells, the full profile {}",
4703            actual_ids.len(),
4704            expected_ids.len()
4705        ));
4706    }
4707    Ok(())
4708}
4709
4710/// The pinned-root workspace producer's two nodes. The Cargo half has no path
4711/// to the rust-script producer, the preparation half depends directly on both,
4712/// nothing but the preparation half consumes the Cargo half by completion
4713/// (so no ordinary consumer can read target/validate before its executables
4714/// are listed and hashed), and the two payloads rejoin to exactly the
4715/// unsplit producer's payload. The one artifact consumer is the pinned E2E
4716/// publisher: it may snapshot the signalled Hermit binary early, and the
4717/// preparation half then depends on it and gates that snapshot against the
4718/// final staged tree.
4719fn assert_pinned_workspace_split(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
4720    let by_tag = cfg
4721        .steps
4722        .iter()
4723        .map(|step| (step.tag(), step))
4724        .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
4725    let find = |tag: &str| {
4726        by_tag
4727            .get(tag)
4728            .copied()
4729            .ok_or_else(|| format!("validation DAG lost {tag}"))
4730    };
4731    let compile = find(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG)?;
4732    let prepare = find(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)?;
4733    let mut pending = compile.deps.clone();
4734    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
4735    while let Some(dependency) = pending.pop() {
4736        if dependency == PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG {
4737            return Err(format!(
4738                "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} waits for {PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG}; only the preparation half needs the rust-script tools"
4739            ));
4740        }
4741        if seen.insert(dependency.clone()) {
4742            pending.extend(find(&dependency)?.deps.iter().cloned());
4743        }
4744    }
4745    for required in [PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG, PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG] {
4746        if !prepare.deps.iter().any(|dependency| dependency == required) {
4747            return Err(format!(
4748                "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} must depend directly on {required}"
4749            ));
4750        }
4751    }
4752    if let Some(consumer) = cfg.steps.iter().find(|step| {
4753        step.tag() != PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG
4754            && step
4755                .deps
4756                .iter()
4757                .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG)
4758    }) {
4759        return Err(format!(
4760            "{} consumes {PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} directly; only {PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} may, so no consumer runs before preparation",
4761            consumer.tag()
4762        ));
4763    }
4764    if compile.publishes
4765        != [dagrun::model::PublishedArtifact {
4766            name: HERMIT_BIN_ARTIFACT.into(),
4767            path: Some("target/validate/hermit".into()),
4768        }]
4769    {
4770        return Err(format!(
4771            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} must publish exactly the {HERMIT_BIN_ARTIFACT} artifact"
4772        ));
4773    }
4774    for step in &cfg.steps {
4775        for artifact_dep in &step.artifact_deps {
4776            if step.tag() != PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG
4777                || artifact_dep.step != PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG
4778                || artifact_dep.artifact != HERMIT_BIN_ARTIFACT
4779            {
4780                return Err(format!(
4781                    "{} has an unexpected artifact dependency on {}:{}; only {PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG} may consume {PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG}:{HERMIT_BIN_ARTIFACT} early",
4782                    step.tag(),
4783                    artifact_dep.step,
4784                    artifact_dep.artifact
4785                ));
4786            }
4787        }
4788    }
4789    if let Some(publisher) = by_tag.get(PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG) {
4790        if publisher.artifact_deps
4791            != [dagrun::model::ArtifactDep {
4792                step: PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG.into(),
4793                artifact: HERMIT_BIN_ARTIFACT.into(),
4794            }]
4795            || publisher
4796                .deps
4797                .iter()
4798                .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)
4799            || !publisher
4800                .deps
4801                .iter()
4802                .any(|dependency| dependency == "build.liteinst_runtime_in_pinned_root")
4803        {
4804            return Err(format!(
4805                "{PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG} lost its early hermit-bin artifact dependency shape"
4806            ));
4807        }
4808        if !prepare
4809            .deps
4810            .iter()
4811            .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG)
4812        {
4813            return Err(format!(
4814                "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} must gate the early snapshot from {PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG}"
4815            ));
4816        }
4817        for step in &cfg.steps {
4818            if step
4819                .deps
4820                .iter()
4821                .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG)
4822                && step
4823                    .env
4824                    .contains_key(crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV)
4825                && !step
4826                    .deps
4827                    .iter()
4828                    .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)
4829            {
4830                return Err(format!(
4831                    "{} carries a prepared Cargo selection but does not depend on {PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} directly",
4832                    step.tag()
4833                ));
4834            }
4835        }
4836    }
4837    if compile.labels != prepare.labels {
4838        return Err(format!(
4839            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} labels {:?} differ from {PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} labels {:?}",
4840            compile.labels, prepare.labels
4841        ));
4842    }
4843    let payload = pinned_workspace_producer_payload(cfg)?;
4844    let (compile_payload, prepare_payload) = split_workspace_payload(&payload)?;
4845    if workspace_compile_payload_with_signal(&compile_payload)
4846        != crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(compile)?
4847        || workspace_prepare_payload_with_gate(&prepare_payload)
4848            != crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(prepare)?
4849    {
4850        return Err(format!(
4851            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} and {PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG} are not the exact halves of one workspace payload"
4852        ));
4853    }
4854    // The Cargo half carries the unsplit producer's heavy budget, which the
4855    // hosted producer still runs whole. The walls are compared with their
4856    // authored values: the Cargo half keeps build.workspace's, and only the
4857    // hosted twin carries the longer hosted wall.
4858    if compile.timeout != crate::validation_dag_static::WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS {
4859        return Err(format!(
4860            "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} lost the workspace build's budget"
4861        ));
4862    }
4863    if let Some(hosted) = by_tag.get("build.workspace_on_host") {
4864        if hosted.timeout != crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS {
4865            return Err(format!(
4866                "build.workspace_on_host has a {}s wall, not the hosted {}s",
4867                hosted.timeout,
4868                crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS
4869            ));
4870        }
4871        if compile.cpu_timeout != hosted.cpu_timeout
4872            || compile.hint.rss_baseline_bytes != hosted.hint.rss_baseline_bytes
4873            || compile.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes != hosted.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes
4874            || compile.hint.classification != hosted.hint.classification
4875        {
4876            return Err(format!(
4877                "{PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG} lost the workspace build's budget"
4878            ));
4879        }
4880    }
4881    Ok(())
4882}
4883
4884/// check.script_unit_tests_on_host is check.script_unit_tests with only its
4885/// hosted identity and longer wall changed, and the local node keeps the
4886/// authored wall and leaves the hosted lane to its twin.
4887fn assert_hosted_script_unit_tests(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
4888    let only = |tag: &str| -> Result<&Step, String> {
4889        let mut found = cfg.steps.iter().filter(|step| step.tag() == tag);
4890        match (found.next(), found.next()) {
4891            (Some(step), None) => Ok(step),
4892            (None, _) => Err(format!("{tag} is absent")),
4893            (Some(_), Some(_)) => Err(format!("{tag} appears more than once")),
4894        }
4895    };
4896    let local = only(SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)?;
4897    let hosted = only(HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)?;
4898    if local.timeout != crate::validation_dag_static::SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_SECONDS {
4899        return Err(format!(
4900            "{SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} has a {}s wall, not its authored {}s",
4901            local.timeout,
4902            crate::validation_dag_static::SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_SECONDS
4903        ));
4904    }
4905    if hosted.timeout != crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_SECONDS {
4906        return Err(format!(
4907            "{HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} has a {}s wall, not the hosted {}s",
4908            hosted.timeout,
4909            crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_SECONDS
4910        ));
4911    }
4912    if local
4913        .labels
4914        .iter()
4915        .any(|label| label == HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL)
4916    {
4917        return Err(format!(
4918            "{SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} keeps the {HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL} label its hosted twin carries"
4919        ));
4920    }
4921    if hosted.labels != [HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL] {
4922        return Err(format!(
4923            "{HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} has labels {:?}, not only {HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL}",
4924            hosted.labels
4925        ));
4926    }
4927    if hosted.fail_fast_family.as_deref() != Some(HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG) {
4928        return Err(format!(
4929            "{HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} is not its own fail-fast family"
4930        ));
4931    }
4932    // Everything else is the local node's: undo the four permitted changes and
4933    // the description suffix, then compare the two nodes' serialized form.
4934    let mut normalized = hosted.clone();
4935    normalized.job = local.job.clone();
4936    normalized.labels = local.labels.clone();
4937    normalized.timeout = local.timeout;
4938    normalized.fail_fast_family = local.fail_fast_family.clone();
4939    normalized.description = hosted
4940        .description
4941        .strip_suffix(crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_WALL_DESCRIPTION)
4942        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} lost its hosted wall description"))?
4943        .to_string();
4944    let one = |step: &Step| {
4945        dag_to_json(&DagConfig {
4946            steps: vec![step.clone()],
4947            ..Default::default()
4948        })
4949    };
4950    if one(&normalized) != one(local) {
4951        return Err(format!(
4952            "{HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} differs from {SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG} in more than its hosted identity and wall"
4953        ));
4954    }
4955    Ok(())
4956}
4957
4958fn assert_rust_script_producer_contract(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
4959    type ProducerContract<'a> = (&'a str, &'a [&'a str], &'a [&'a str], i64, f64);
4960    let expected: &[ProducerContract<'_>] = &[
4961        (
4962            "build.rust_scripts",
4963            &["full", "hosted-portable", "portable"],
4964            &["pre.reverie_pin"],
4965            7200,
4966            190.0,
4967        ),
4968        (
4969            "build.rust_scripts_on_host",
4970            &["hosted-privileged"],
4971            &["pre.reverie_pin_on_host"],
4972            7200,
4973            190.0,
4974        ),
4975        (
4976            "build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root",
4977            &["full", "portable"],
4978            &["pre.reverie_pin", "setup.pinned_root_fetch"],
4979            7200,
4980            190.0,
4981        ),
4982        (
4983            "quick-super-build.rust_scripts",
4984            &["quick", "super"],
4985            &["pre.reverie_pin"],
4986            crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_QUICK_SUPER_CPU_SECONDS,
4987            0.0,
4988        ),
4989        (
4990            "quick-super-build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root",
4991            &["quick", "super"],
4992            &["pre.reverie_pin", "setup.pinned_root_fetch"],
4993            crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_QUICK_SUPER_CPU_SECONDS,
4994            0.0,
4995        ),
4996    ];
4997    let expected_tags = expected
4998        .iter()
4999        .map(|(tag, ..)| (*tag).to_string())
5000        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
5001    let actual_producers = cfg
5002        .steps
5003        .iter()
5004        .filter(|step| {
5005            matches!(
5006                step.job.as_str(),
5007                "rust_scripts" | "rust_scripts_on_host" | "rust_scripts_in_pinned_root"
5008            )
5009        })
5010        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
5011    let actual_tags = actual_producers
5012        .iter()
5013        .map(|step| step.tag())
5014        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
5015    if actual_producers.len() != expected.len() || actual_tags != expected_tags {
5016        return Err(format!(
5017            "rust-script producer identity population changed: expected={} {expected_tags:?}, actual={} {actual_tags:?}",
5018            expected.len(),
5019            actual_producers.len(),
5020        ));
5021    }
5022
5023    for (tag, labels, deps, cpu_timeout, est_duration_s) in expected {
5024        let step = cfg
5025            .steps
5026            .iter()
5027            .find(|step| step.tag() == *tag)
5028            .ok_or_else(|| format!("committed DAG lost {tag}"))?;
5029        let execution_command = crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(step)?;
5030        let expected_command = if matches!(
5031            *tag,
5032            "build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root" | "quick-super-build.rust_scripts_in_pinned_root"
5033        ) {
5034            crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_COMMAND
5035                .replacen(DAGRUN_PREPARE_COMMAND, "", 1)
5036                .replacen(
5037                    RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_INVOCATION,
5038                    RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_RELEASE_ONLY_INVOCATION,
5039                    1,
5040                )
5041        } else {
5042            crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_COMMAND.to_string()
5043        };
5044        let expected_labels = labels
5045            .iter()
5046            .map(|label| (*label).to_string())
5047            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
5048        let expected_deps = deps
5049            .iter()
5050            .map(|dependency| (*dependency).to_string())
5051            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
5052        let has_no_result_ownership =
5053            step.manifest.is_none() && matches!(step.result_manifests.as_deref(), Some([]));
5054        if execution_command != expected_command
5055            || step.labels != expected_labels
5056            || step.deps != expected_deps
5057            || !has_no_result_ownership
5058            || step.timeout != crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_WALL_SECONDS
5059            || step.cpu_timeout != *cpu_timeout
5060            || step.hint.est_duration_s != *est_duration_s
5061            || step.hint.rss_baseline_bytes
5062                != Some(crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_RSS_BASELINE_BYTES)
5063            || step.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes
5064                != Some(crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_HARD_MEM_MAX_BYTES)
5065            || step.hint.classification != dagrun::model::StepClass::CpuBound
5066            || step.hint.preferred_inner_jobs
5067                != Some(crate::validation_dag_static::RUST_SCRIPT_PRODUCER_INNER_JOBS)
5068            || step.jobs_flag.as_deref() != Some("")
5069            || step.jobs_env.as_deref() != Some("CARGO_BUILD_JOBS")
5070            || step.fail_fast_family.as_deref() != Some(*tag)
5071        {
5072            return Err(format!(
5073                "{tag} changed its exact rust-script producer identity or resource contract: {step:?}"
5074            ));
5075        }
5076    }
5077    Ok(())
5078}

5080fn assert_dagrun_preparation_placement(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {

5107        "setup.manifest_plan",
5108        "quick-super-setup.manifest_plan",

5111        "quick-super-setup.manifest_plan_in_pinned_root",
5112    ] {

5123/// Manifest buckets whose `test-harness run` selector omits `--allow-empty`.
5124///
5125/// A node for one of these buckets that selects no cells fails with "filters
5126/// selected no cells" instead of passing having executed nothing. c-programs
5127/// joined when the backend-parity-c bucket was folded into it
5128/// (<https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301>): the fold moved 279
5129/// selected cells (276 portable, 3 privileged) onto its nodes, and a bucket
5130/// that large must not be able to report green on an empty selection. The
5131/// generator, the manifest DAG audit in `test-harness validate`, and the
5132/// validation driver's raw-publisher check all read this one list.
5133pub const FAIL_CLOSED_MANIFEST_BUCKETS: &[&str] = &["c-programs", "compat"];
5134
5135/// The selector flags a manifest node for `category` passes after
5136/// `--lane <lane> --category <category>`.
5137/// Manifest buckets that contain diagnostic cells. Their nodes run the
5138/// harness with `--diagnostic-results` and declare dagrun structured-result
5139/// schema 4, so a diagnostic cell's failure is reported without failing the
5140/// node; every other bucket writes and declares schema 2, and the harness
5141/// refuses to run a diagnostic cell without the flag. Empty until a bucket
5142/// with diagnostic cells exists.
5143pub const DIAGNOSTIC_MANIFEST_BUCKETS: &[&str] = &["compat"];
5144
5145/// The harness selection a manifest bucket node `tag` passes after
5146/// `test-harness run`: its lane, its category, the `--label` of the run type
5147/// it selects ([`manifest_run_type`]) and the category's
5148/// [`manifest_selector_flags`]. The generator and validate.rs's raw-census
5149/// check both read it.
5150pub fn manifest_bucket_selection(tag: &str, manifest: &DagManifest) -> String {
5151    let label = manifest_run_type(tag)
5152        .map(|label| format!(" --label {label}"))
5153        .unwrap_or_default();
5154    format!(
5155        "--lane {} --category {}{label} {}",
5156        manifest.lane,
5157        manifest.category,
5158        manifest_selector_flags(&manifest.category)
5159    )
5160}
5161
5162pub fn manifest_selector_flags(category: &str) -> &'static str {
5163    match (
5164        FAIL_CLOSED_MANIFEST_BUCKETS.contains(&category),
5165        DIAGNOSTIC_MANIFEST_BUCKETS.contains(&category),
5166    ) {
5167        (true, true) => "--ci-only --prebuilt --diagnostic-results",
5168        (true, false) => "--ci-only --prebuilt",
5169        (false, true) => "--ci-only --allow-empty --prebuilt --diagnostic-results",
5170        (false, false) => "--ci-only --allow-empty --prebuilt",
5171    }
5172}
5173
5174/// Every node of a [`FAIL_CLOSED_MANIFEST_BUCKETS`] bucket runs its exact
5175/// selector without `--allow-empty`, and every such bucket still has a node.
5176fn assert_fail_closed_manifest_selectors(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
5177    let mut covered = BTreeSet::new();
5178    for step in &cfg.steps {
5179        let Some(manifest) = step.manifest.as_ref() else {
5180            continue;
5181        };
5182        if !FAIL_CLOSED_MANIFEST_BUCKETS.contains(&manifest.category.as_str()) {
5183            continue;
5184        }
5185        let selector = format!(
5186            "target/debug/test-harness run {}",
5187            manifest_bucket_selection(&step.tag(), manifest)
5188        );
5189        if step.cmd.contains("--allow-empty") || step.cmd.matches(selector.as_str()).count() != 1 {
5190            return Err(format!(
5191                "{} must fail closed on an empty selection: it must run `{selector}` exactly once and never pass --allow-empty",
5192                step.tag()
5193            ));
5194        }
5195        covered.insert(manifest.category.as_str());
5196    }
5197    if let Some(bucket) = FAIL_CLOSED_MANIFEST_BUCKETS
5198        .iter()
5199        .find(|bucket| !covered.contains(**bucket))
5200    {
5201        return Err(format!("fail-closed manifest bucket {bucket} has no node"));
5202    }
5203    Ok(())
5204}

5245/// Every tool self-test runs as one leaf node in each profile that runs the
5246/// ordinary or quick/super manifest gate, after that gate, with its exact
5247/// command. Nothing may depend on these nodes: they test repository tooling,
5248/// and a product node waiting on them would put them back on its critical path.
5249fn assert_tool_self_test_nodes(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
5250    let mut expected = BTreeSet::new();
5251    for tool in TOOL_SELF_TESTS {
5252        let command = format!(
5253            "export PATH=\"$PWD/ci/rust-script-bin:$PATH\"; export HERMIT_RUST_SCRIPT_ARTIFACT_ROOT=\"$PWD/target/ci/rust-scripts\"; export HERMIT_PREBUILT_RUST_SCRIPTS_REQUIRED=1; target/debug/test-harness selftest {}",
5254            tool.name
5255        );
5256        for (tag, labels, gate) in [
5257            (
5258                format!("{TOOL_SELF_TEST_GROUP_PREFIX}{}", tool.name),
5259                &["full", HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL, "portable"][..],
5260                "gate.manifest",
5261            ),
5262            (
5263                quick_super_variant(&format!("{TOOL_SELF_TEST_GROUP_PREFIX}{}", tool.name)),
5264                &["quick", "super"][..],
5265                "quick-super-gate.manifest",
5266            ),
5267        ] {
5268            let step = cfg
5269                .steps
5270                .iter()
5271                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
5272                .ok_or_else(|| format!("committed DAG lost tool self-test node {tag}"))?;
5273            if step.cmd != command
5274                || step.labels != labels
5275                || step.deps != {
5276                    let mut deps = [gate, "pre.reverie_pin"];
5277                    deps.sort_unstable();
5278                    deps
5279                }
5280                || step.timeout <= 0
5281                || step.cpu_timeout <= 0
5282            {
5283                return Err(format!(
5284                    "{tag} must run exactly `test-harness selftest {}` after {gate} in {labels:?} with positive caps: {step:?}",
5285                    tool.name
5286                ));
5287            }
5288            expected.insert(tag);
5289        }
5290    }
5291    let actual = cfg
5292        .steps
5293        .iter()
5294        .filter(|step| {
5295            step.group == TOOL_SELF_TEST_GROUP
5296                || step.group == quick_super_variant(TOOL_SELF_TEST_GROUP)
5297        })
5298        .map(Step::tag)
5299        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
5300    if actual != expected {
5301        return Err(format!(
5302            "tool self-test nodes {actual:?} differ from TOOL_SELF_TESTS {expected:?}"
5303        ));
5304    }
5305    if let Some((step, dependency)) = cfg.steps.iter().find_map(|step| {
5306        step.deps
5307            .iter()
5308            .find(|dependency| expected.contains(*dependency))
5309            .map(|dependency| (step.tag(), dependency))
5310    }) {
5311        return Err(format!(
5312            "{step} depends on tool self-test {dependency}; self-tests must stay off every product node's critical path"
5313        ));
5314    }
5315    Ok(())
5316}

5318fn critical_path_wall_seconds(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<i64, String> {
5319    let by_tag = cfg
5320        .steps
5321        .iter()
5322        .map(|step| (step.tag(), step))
5323        .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
5324    let mut longest = BTreeMap::<String, i64>::new();
5325    while longest.len() < by_tag.len() {
5326        let mut advanced = false;
5327        for (tag, step) in &by_tag {
5328            if longest.contains_key(tag) {
5329                continue;
5330            }
5331            if step
5332                .deps
5333                .iter()
5334                .any(|dependency| !by_tag.contains_key(dependency))
5335            {
5336                return Err(format!(
5337                    "{tag} names a dependency outside its selected graph"
5338                ));
5339            }
5340            if step
5341                .deps
5342                .iter()
5343                .any(|dependency| !longest.contains_key(dependency))
5344            {
5345                continue;
5346            }
5347            let predecessor = step
5348                .deps
5349                .iter()
5350                .filter_map(|dependency| longest.get(dependency))
5351                .copied()
5352                .max()
5353                .unwrap_or(0);
5354            longest.insert(tag.clone(), predecessor + step.timeout);
5355            advanced = true;
5356        }
5357        if !advanced {
5358            return Err("selected graph contains a dependency cycle".into());
5359        }
5360    }
5361    longest
5362        .values()
5363        .copied()
5364        .max()
5365        .ok_or_else(|| "selected graph is empty".to_string())
5366}
5367
5368/// Every committed node declares a wall timeout, a CPU budget (its own or the
5369/// config default) and a memory cap. A node without them would run unboxed
5370/// while scripts/validate.rs printed "cgroup boxing ACTIVE": a green that
5371/// verified less than it claimed. Checked here, where the committed graph is
5372/// made, rather than again at the start of every validation run.
5373fn assert_declared_caps(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
5374    let undeclared: Vec<String> = cfg
5375        .steps
5376        .iter()
5377        .filter(|step| {
5378            let memory =
5379                step.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes.is_some() || step.hint.rss_baseline_bytes.is_some();
5380            let cpu = step.cpu_timeout > 0 || cfg.default_step_cpu_timeout > 0;
5381            let wall = step.timeout > 0;
5382            !(memory && cpu && wall)
5383        })
5384        .map(Step::tag)
5385        .collect();
5386    if undeclared.is_empty() {
5387        Ok(())
5388    } else {
5389        Err(format!(
5390            "{} node(s) lack declared resource caps (timeout, cpu_timeout and a memory hint) \
5391             and would run unboxed: {}",
5392            undeclared.len(),
5393            undeclared.join(", ")
5394        ))
5395    }
5396}

5398fn assert_m1_allocator_gate(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
5399    let find = |tag: &str| {
5400        cfg.steps
5401            .iter()
5402            .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
5403            .ok_or_else(|| format!("required M1 node missing: {tag}"))
5404    };
5405    let producer = find("build.liteinst_allocator_fixtures_in_pinned_root")?;
5406    let consumer = find("test.liteinst_allocator")?;
5407    for step in [producer, consumer] {
5408        if step.labels != ["full", "portable"]
5409            || !step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ")
5410        {
5411            return Err(format!(
5412                "{} lost required local pinned placement",
5413                step.tag()
5414            ));
5415        }
5416    }
5417    if !producer
5418        .cmd
5419        .contains("./ci/build-liteinst-allocator-fixtures.rs")
5420        || producer
5421            .deps
5422            .iter()
5423            .any(|tag| tag == "build.workspace_in_pinned_root")
5424    {
5425        return Err("M1 diagnostic producer lost its independent explicit leaf closure".into());
5426    }
5427    for required in [
5428        "build.e2e_artifact_in_pinned_root",
5429        "build.liteinst_allocator_fixtures_in_pinned_root",
5430        "pre.reverie_pin",
5431    ] {
5432        if !consumer.deps.iter().any(|tag| tag == required) {
5433            return Err(format!("M1 consumer lost prerequisite {required}"));
5434        }
5435    }
5436    if consumer.env.contains_key("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED") {
5437        return Err("M1 consumer declares a retired Nextest count pin".into());
5438    }
5439    if consumer.integration_test_binaries.as_deref() != Some(&["liteinst_allocator".to_owned()][..])
5440    {
5441        return Err("M1 consumer lost its allocator target population".into());
5442    }
5443    crate::nextest_build_selections::assert_command_selection(consumer)?;
5444    let command = crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(consumer)?;
5445    for required in [
5446        "HERMIT_M1_ALLOCATOR_FIXTURE_BUNDLE",
5447        "--print-standalone",
5448        "--test liteinst_allocator -j 1",
5449    ] {
5450        if !command.contains(required) {
5451            return Err(format!("M1 consumer lost {required}"));
5452        }
5453    }
5454    Ok(())
5455}

5457fn assert_m2_stack_gate(cfg: &DagConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
5458    let find = |tag: &str| {
5459        cfg.steps
5460            .iter()
5461            .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
5462            .ok_or_else(|| format!("required M2 node missing: {tag}"))
5463    };
5464    let producer = find("build.liteinst_allocator_fixtures_in_pinned_root")?;
5465    let consumer = find("test.liteinst_stacks")?;
5466    for step in [producer, consumer] {
5467        if step.labels != ["full", "portable"]
5468            || !step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ")
5469        {
5470            return Err(format!(
5471                "{} lost required local pinned placement",
5472                step.tag()
5473            ));
5474        }
5475    }
5476    if !producer
5477        .cmd
5478        .contains("./ci/build-liteinst-allocator-fixtures.rs")
5479        || producer
5480            .deps
5481            .iter()
5482            .any(|tag| tag == "build.workspace_in_pinned_root")
5483    {
5484        return Err("M2 diagnostic producer lost its independent explicit leaf closure".into());
5485    }
5486    for required in [
5487        "build.e2e_artifact_in_pinned_root",
5488        "build.liteinst_allocator_fixtures_in_pinned_root",
5489        "pre.reverie_pin",
5490    ] {
5491        if !consumer.deps.iter().any(|tag| tag == required) {
5492            return Err(format!("M2 consumer lost prerequisite {required}"));
5493        }
5494    }
5495    if consumer.env.contains_key("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED") {
5496        return Err("stack consumer declares a retired Nextest count pin".into());
5497    }
5498    if consumer.integration_test_binaries.as_deref() != Some(&["liteinst_stacks".to_owned()][..]) {
5499        return Err("stack consumer lost its stacks target population".into());
5500    }
5501    crate::nextest_build_selections::assert_command_selection(consumer)?;
5502    let command = crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(consumer)?;
5503    for required in [
5504        "HERMIT_M2_STACK_FIXTURE_BUNDLE",
5505        "HERMIT_COLD_STACK_FIXTURE_BUNDLE",
5506        "--print-stack-standalone",
5507        "--test liteinst_stacks",
5508    ] {
5509        if !command.contains(required) {
5510            return Err(format!("M2 consumer lost {required}"));
5511        }
5512    }
5513    // At most five tests at a time, all of them reserved: the width rides
5514    // NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS from preferred_inner_jobs, so the step's CPU quota
5515    // follows it, and the command names no width of its own. liteinst
5516    // approved up to five (2026-10-17); it was one test at a time before.
5517    let width = consumer.hint.preferred_inner_jobs;
5518    if !matches!(width, Some(1..=5))
5519        || consumer.jobs_env.as_deref() != Some("NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS")
5520        || consumer.jobs_flag.as_deref() != Some("")
5521        || command.contains("--test liteinst_stacks -j")
5522        || command.contains("--test-threads")
5523    {
5524        return Err(format!(
5525            "M2 consumer must run at most five tests at a time, reserved through NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS (preferred_inner_jobs {width:?}, jobs_env {:?}, jobs_flag {:?})",
5526            consumer.jobs_env, consumer.jobs_flag
5527        ));
5528    }
5529    Ok(())
5530}
5531
5532fn assert_invariants(cfg: &DagConfig, cells: &Populations) -> Result<(), String> {
5533    // Backend parity is a scored comparison, not a gate
5534    // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301): the parity post-pass
5535    // measures it from retained logs, and no plan asks the harness for a
5536    // ptrace reference run. The harness refuses the flag, and the retained-plan
5537    // reader refuses a plan that passed it.
5538    if let Some(step) = cfg
5539        .steps
5540        .iter()
5541        .find(|step| step.cmd.contains("--parity-reference"))
5542    {
5543        return Err(format!(
5544            "{} passes --parity-reference; backend parity no longer decides a validation outcome (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301)",
5545            step.tag()
5546        ));
5547    }
5548    assert_m1_allocator_gate(cfg)?;
5549    assert_m2_stack_gate(cfg)?;
5550    assert_declared_caps(cfg)?;
5551    crate::step_limits::assert_cpu_bounded_step_limits(cfg)?;
5552    assert_structured_result_producers(cfg)?;
5553    crate::nextest_build_selections::assert_preparation_dependencies(cfg)?;
5554    crate::nextest_build_selections::assert_producers_build_the_unified_selection(cfg)?;
5555    assert_dagrun_preparation_placement(cfg)?;
5556    assert_manifest_gate_width_contract(cfg)?;
5557    assert_tool_self_test_nodes(cfg)?;
5558    assert_fail_closed_manifest_selectors(cfg)?;
5559    assert_rust_script_producer_contract(cfg)?;
5560    assert_pinned_workspace_split(cfg)?;
5561    assert_hosted_script_unit_tests(cfg)?;
5562    assert_buck_e2e_selection(cfg, cells)?;
5563    // 1606 until test.dbt_parity and test.dbt_parity_on_host were retired
5564    // (slice S13 of https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301); 1605
5565    // since check.canonical_adapter_accept was added; +3 for the privileged

6062        // prepare gates its snapshot). A profile whose every frozen path
6063        // to the prepare node runs through the publisher, and which no
6064        // prepared-selection consumer pulls back in with a direct prepare
6065        // dependency, therefore no longer closes over the prepare node.
6066        let mut source_selected = source_selected;
6067        if source_selected.contains(PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG)
6068            && source_selected.contains(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)
6069            && !source_direct.contains(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)
6070            && !crate::dag_source_ownership::source_profile_avoiding(
6071                profile.label,
6072                true,
6073                PINNED_E2E_ARTIFACT_TAG,
6074            )?
6075            .contains(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)
6076            && !selected.steps.iter().any(|step| {
6077                step.env
6078                    .contains_key(crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV)
6079                    && step
6080                        .deps
6081                        .iter()
6082                        .any(|dependency| dependency == PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG)
6083            })

6085            source_selected.remove(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG);

6088            return Err(format!(

6093        let expected_results = cells.for_label(profile.label);
6094        let owners = ResultOwnerIndex::new(&selected.steps);

6101            .into_iter()
6102            .map(result_identity)

6105            .steps
