8682    #[test]
8683    fn hosted_nextest_selections_keep_local_cases_and_failure_limits() {
8684        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
8685        let mut checked = BTreeSet::new();
8686        for hosted in committed.steps.iter().filter(|step| {
8687            step.group == "test"
8688                && step.job.ends_with(HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX)
8689                && step.cmd.contains("run-nextest-counted.sh")
8690        }) {
8691            let local_tag = hosted
8692                .tag()
8693                .strip_suffix(HOSTED_VARIANT_SUFFIX)
8694                .unwrap()
8695                .to_owned();
8696            checked.insert(local_tag.clone());
8697            let local = committed
8698                .steps
8699                .iter()
8700                .find(|step| step.tag() == local_tag)
8701                .unwrap();
8702            let payload = |step: &Step| -> String {
8703                if step.cmd.starts_with("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh ") {
8704                    let argv = shell_words::split(&step.cmd).unwrap();
8705                    let boundary = argv.iter().position(|arg| arg == "--").unwrap();
8706                    assert_eq!(argv[boundary + 3], PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD);
8707                    argv[boundary + 5].clone()
8708                } else {
8709                    step.cmd.clone()
8710                }
8711            };
8712            let local_payload = payload(local);
8713            // The local Hermit integration node runs in shards. Each runs the
8714            // hosted twin's command with the authored filter narrowed to its
8715            // own binaries; together they select every binary once. Each
8716            // counted node (shards and twin alike) is census-guarded on its
8717            // own listed IDs; no pinned total relates them any more.
8718            assert!(
8719                !hosted.env.contains_key("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED")
8720                    && !local.env.contains_key("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED"),
8721                "{} declares a retired Nextest count pin",
8722                hosted.tag()
8723            );
8724            let local_payload = if local_tag == HERMIT_INTEGRATION_TAG {
8725                let mut unsharded = BTreeSet::new();
8726                let mut selected = Vec::new();
8727                for shard_tag in hermit_integration_shard_tags() {
8728                    let shard = committed
8729                        .steps
8730                        .iter()
8731                        .find(|step| step.tag() == shard_tag)
8732                        .unwrap();
8733                    let shard_payload = payload(shard);
8734                    let (head, rest) = shard_payload.split_once(" -E '(").unwrap();
8735                    let (binaries, tail) = rest.split_once(") & (").unwrap();
8736                    let authored = tail.strip_suffix(")'").unwrap();
8737                    selected.extend(binaries.split(" | ").map(|term| {
8738                        term.strip_prefix("binary(=")
8739                            .and_then(|term| term.strip_suffix(')'))
8740                            .unwrap()
8741                            .to_owned()
8742                    }));
8743                    unsharded.insert(format!("{head} -E '{authored}'"));
8744                    assert_eq!(
8745                        shard.timeout, local.timeout,
8746                        "{shard_tag} changed its timeout"
8747                    );
8748                    assert_eq!(
8749                        shard.env.get(crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV),
8750                        local.env.get(crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV),
8751                        "{shard_tag} changed its prepared selection"
8752                    );
8753                    assert!(
8754                        !shard.env.contains_key("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED"),
8755                        "{shard_tag} declares a retired Nextest count pin"
8756                    );
8757                }
8758                assert_eq!(
8759                    Some(&selected),
8760                    local.integration_test_binaries.as_ref(),
8761                    "the Hermit integration shards must select every binary once, in order"
8762                );
8763                assert_eq!(
8764                    unsharded.len(),
8765                    1,
8766                    "the shards differ outside their binaries"
8767                );
8768                unsharded.pop_first().unwrap()
8769            } else {
8770                local_payload
8771            };
8772            let expected_host_payload = if local_tag == "test.regular_crates" {
8773                const PINNED: &str = "--calibration-launch-proof /run/hermit-nextest-launch.json";
8774                assert_eq!(local_payload.matches(PINNED).count(), 1);
8775                assert_eq!(hosted.cmd.matches("--calibration-host").count(), 1);
8776                assert!(local.deps.iter().any(|dep| dep == "build.rust_scripts"));
8777                // The hosted twin also excludes exactly the PMU-timer replay
8778                // cases, which the local selection must keep running.
8779                assert!(!local_payload.contains(" -E "));
8780                const SPLIT_FIXTURE: &str = "trace_replay_split_just_spin";
8781                assert!(
8782                    !HOSTED_PORTABLE_PMU_TIMER_REPLAY_TESTS.contains(&SPLIT_FIXTURE),
8783                    "the split fixture's comparisons must still run without a PMU"
8784                );
8785                assert!(!hosted.cmd.contains(SPLIT_FIXTURE));
8786                assert!(!local_payload.contains(SPLIT_FIXTURE));
8787                assert!(HOSTED_PORTABLE_PMU_TIMER_REPLAY_TESTS.iter().all(|name| {
8788                    !name.starts_with("split_trace::tests::")
8789                        && *name != "split_trace_coverage_failure_is_recorded_after_skid_retry"
8790                }));
8791                assert_eq!(
8792                    local_payload.matches(REGULAR_CRATES_SELECTION_END).count(),
8793                    1
8794                );
8795                local_payload
8796                    .replace(PINNED, "--calibration-host")
8797                    .replacen(
8798                        REGULAR_CRATES_SELECTION_END,
8799                        &format!(
8800                            "{REGULAR_CRATES_SELECTION_END}{}",
8801                            hosted_exclusion_filterset(HOSTED_PORTABLE_PMU_TIMER_REPLAY_TESTS)
8802                        ),
8803                        1,
8804                    )
8805            } else if local_tag == "test.cli" {
8806                // The hosted twin excludes exactly the CPUID-faulting cases,
8807                // by exact name, which the local selection must keep running:
8808                // no local filter names one, and no local substring --skip
8809                // matches one.
8810                let local_argv = shell_words::split(&local_payload).unwrap();
8811                assert!(!local_argv.iter().any(|arg| arg == "-E"));
8812                for name in HOSTED_PORTABLE_CPUID_FAULTING_CLI_TESTS {
8813                    assert!(
8814                        !local_payload.contains(name),
8815                        "test.cli must keep running {name}"
8816                    );
8817                    for pattern in local_argv
8818                        .windows(2)
8819                        .filter(|pair| pair[0] == "--skip")
8820                        .map(|pair| &pair[1])
8821                    {
8822                        assert!(
8823                            !name.contains(pattern.as_str()),
8824                            "test.cli's --skip {pattern} skips {name}"
8825                        );
8826                    }
8827                }
8828                assert_eq!(local_payload.matches(" -- ").count(), 1);
8829                local_payload.replacen(
8830                    " -- ",
8831                    &format!(
8832                        "{} -- ",
8833                        hosted_exclusion_filterset(HOSTED_PORTABLE_CPUID_FAULTING_CLI_TESTS)
8834                    ),
8835                    1,
8836                )
8837            } else if local_tag == "test.hermit_unit" {
8838                // The hosted twin excludes exactly the forced-gate harness
8839                // rows, by exact name, which the local selection must keep
8840                // running: no local filter names one, and no local substring
8841                // --skip matches one.
8842                let local_argv = shell_words::split(&local_payload).unwrap();
8843                assert!(!local_argv.iter().any(|arg| arg == "-E"));
8844                for name in HOSTED_PORTABLE_CPUID_FAULTING_HERMIT_UNIT_TESTS {
8845                    assert!(
8846                        !local_payload.contains(name),
8847                        "test.hermit_unit must keep running {name}"
8848                    );
8849                    for pattern in local_argv
8850                        .windows(2)
8851                        .filter(|pair| pair[0] == "--skip")
8852                        .map(|pair| &pair[1])
8853                    {
8854                        assert!(
8855                            !name.contains(pattern.as_str()),
8856                            "test.hermit_unit's --skip {pattern} skips {name}"
8857                        );
8858                    }
8859                }
8860                assert_eq!(local_payload.matches(HERMIT_UNIT_ARGUMENTS).count(), 1);
8861                local_payload.replacen(
8862                    HERMIT_UNIT_ARGUMENTS,
8863                    &format!(
8864                        "{}{HERMIT_UNIT_ARGUMENTS}",
8865                        hosted_exclusion_filterset(
8866                            HOSTED_PORTABLE_CPUID_FAULTING_HERMIT_UNIT_TESTS
8867                        )
8868                    ),
8869                    1,
8870                )
8871            } else if local_tag == "test.rr_suite_contract" {
8872                // The hosted twin excludes exactly the PMU-timer rr cases,
8873                // which the local selection must keep running.
8874                assert!(!local_payload.contains(" -E "));
8875                for name in HOSTED_PORTABLE_PMU_TIMER_RR_TESTS {
8876                    assert!(
8877                        !local_payload.contains(name),
8878                        "test.rr_suite_contract must keep running {name}"
8879                    );
8880                }
8881                assert_eq!(local_payload.matches(RR_SUITE_SELECTION).count(), 1);
8882                local_payload.replacen(
8883                    RR_SUITE_SELECTION,
8884                    &format!(
8885                        "--test rr_suite{} -j 1",
8886                        hosted_exclusion_filterset(HOSTED_PORTABLE_PMU_TIMER_RR_TESTS)
8887                    ),
8888                    1,
8889                )
8890            } else {
8891                local_payload
8892            };
8893            assert_eq!(
8894                hosted.cmd,
8895                expected_host_payload,
8896                "{} changed its test selection",
8897                hosted.tag()
8898            );
8899            assert_eq!(
8900                hosted.timeout,
8901                local.timeout,
8902                "{} changed its timeout",
8903                hosted.tag()
8904            );
8905            assert_eq!(
8906                hosted.cpu_timeout,
8907                local.cpu_timeout,
8908                "{} changed its CPU timeout",
8909                hosted.tag()
8910            );
8911            assert_eq!(
8912                hosted.env.get(crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV),
8913                local.env.get(crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV),
8914                "{} changed {}",
8915                hosted.tag(),
8916                crate::nextest_binaries::SELECTION_ENV
8917            );
8918            // The hosted-only exclusions above are exact test(=NAME) terms:
8919            // each names at most one listed test, and the payload equality
8920            // just asserted leaves nothing else excluded. How many tests
8921            // that leaves is the census's business (listed IDs vs the last
8922            // landed population), not a pinned total here.
8923        }
8924        assert_eq!(
8925            checked,
8926            BTreeSet::from(
8927                [
8928                    "test.app_strict_verify",
8929                    "test.arbitrary_binaries",
8930                    "test.cli",
8931                    "test.command_strict_verify",
8932                    "test.detcore_misc",
8933                    "test.detcore_parallel",
8934                    "test.detcore_time",
8935                    "test.detcore_unit",
8936                    "test.hermit_integration",
8937                    "test.hermit_modes",
8938                    "test.hermit_unit",
8939                    "test.ignored_syscall_regressions",
8940                    "test.regular_crates",
8941                    "test.rr_suite_contract",
8942                ]
8943                .map(str::to_owned)
8944            ),
8945            // test.sabre_examples moved to the patching owner with the split.
8946            "every hosted Nextest selection must be compared to its local selection"
8947        );
8948        let local = committed
8949            .steps
8950            .iter()
8951            .find(|step| step.tag() == "e2e.manifest_c_programs")
8952            .unwrap();
8953        let hosted = committed
8954            .steps
8955            .iter()
8956            .find(|step| step.tag() == "e2e.manifest_c_programs_on_host")
8957            .unwrap();
8958        // 900 s covers the 104 folded backend-parity-c tests (slice S6 of
8959        // https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301); the two buckets
8960        // measured 128.62 s and 75.76 s of wall time in one run. 1080 since
8961        // 2026-11-02: 61 runs under concurrent validations peaked at 707 s
8962        // (step_limits.rs). 1450 since the cell wall derivation
8963        // (max(declared, min(8x CPU, 600))): two attempts of the largest
8964        // resolved cell wall at CPU 1.25x/wall 1.5x plus grace need 1412 s
8965        // (require_manifest_selection_headroom).
8966        assert_eq!(local.timeout, 1450);
8967        assert_eq!(hosted.timeout, local.timeout);
8968    }

8970    #[test]
8971    fn buck_e2e_extension_dropped_check_refuses_a_same_count_swap() {
8972        let exact: BTreeSet<String> = BUCK_E2E_EXTENSION_DROPPED
8973            .iter()
8974            .map(|tag| (*tag).to_string())
8975            .collect();
8976        check_buck_e2e_extension_dropped(&exact).unwrap();
8977        // Same count, one tag swapped for another extension tag: the
8978        // selection-derived check this replaces could not see this.
8979        let mut swapped = exact.clone();
8980        swapped.remove("e2e.manifest_rr");
8981        swapped.insert("build.reverie_buck".to_string());

8983        let error = check_buck_e2e_extension_dropped(&swapped).unwrap_err();

8986        let mut subset = exact.clone();
8987        subset.remove("e2e.manifest_gvisor");
8988        assert!(check_buck_e2e_extension_dropped(&subset).is_err());
8989    }

8991    // s1 is s0 plus the applications category: the same plan with every s0
8992    // node renamed to s1, plus the applications import twin. Its nodes are
8993    // labelled and named for s1, and a subset file is read only under its own
8994    // name.
8995    #[test]
8996    fn buck_s1_selection_is_s0_plus_the_applications_twin() {
8997        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
8998        let s0 =
8999            BuckSubset::from_json("s0", include_str!("../../buck-e2e/subsets/s0.json")).unwrap();
9000        let s1 =
9001            BuckSubset::from_json("s1", include_str!("../../buck-e2e/subsets/s1.json")).unwrap();
9002        assert_eq!((&s1.lanes, &s1.backends), (&s0.lanes, &s0.backends));
9003        let mut categories = s0.categories.clone();
9004        categories.push("applications".into());
9005        categories.sort();
9006        let mut s1_categories = s1.categories.clone();
9007        s1_categories.sort();
9008        assert_eq!(s1_categories, categories);
9009        let plan: serde_json::Value =
9010            serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../../expected-e2e-plan.json")).unwrap();
9011        let backends = plan["cells"]
9012            .as_array()
9013            .unwrap()
9014            .iter()
9015            .map(|cell| cell["backend"].as_str().unwrap().to_string())
9016            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
9017        let selected_s0 = buck_subset_selection(&committed, &s0, &backends).unwrap();
9018        let selected_s1 = buck_subset_selection(&committed, &s1, &backends).unwrap();
9019        let renamed = selected_s0
9020            .steps
9021            .iter()
9022            .map(|step| step.tag().replace("_s0", "_s1"))
9023            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
9024        let tags = selected_s1
9025            .steps
9026            .iter()
9027            .map(Step::tag)
9028            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
9029        assert!(renamed.is_subset(&tags), "{renamed:?} vs {tags:?}");
9030        assert_eq!(
9031            tags.difference(&renamed).cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
9032            vec!["e2e.manifest_applications_buck_s1".to_string()]
9033        );
9034        for step in &selected_s1.steps {
9035            assert_eq!(step.labels, vec!["buck-s1".to_string()], "{}", step.tag());
9036            assert!(!step.tag().contains("s0"), "{}", step.tag());
9037            assert!(
9038                !step.description.contains("--buck-s0"),
9039                "{}: {}",
9040                step.tag(),
9041                step.description
9042            );
9043        }
9044        let records = selected_s1
9045            .steps
9046            .iter()
9047            .find(|step| step.tag() == "pre.buck_s1_records")
9048            .unwrap();
9049        assert!(
9050            records.cmd.contains("pre.buck_s1_records: "),
9051            "{}",
9052            records.cmd
9053        );
9054        // A subset file is read only under its own name, and only a known
9055        // subset is read at all.
9056        assert!(
9057            BuckSubset::from_json("s1", include_str!("../../buck-e2e/subsets/s0.json")).is_err()
9058        );
9059        assert!(
9060            BuckSubset::from_json("s9", include_str!("../../buck-e2e/subsets/s0.json")).is_err()
9061        );
9062    }

9064    // dagrun appends a step's inner-parallelism arguments to the END of its
9065    // command (dagrun::model::command_with_inner_jobs), so a recorded command
9066    // must keep its program last. Every s0 node is rendered as dagrun renders it
9067    // with 8 inner jobs, and every twin's rendered command runs against a stub
9068    // harness: the stub must see the appended arguments, the node must exit with
9069    // the stub's status, and the twin's record must hold that status.
9070    #[test]
9071    fn buck_s0_rendered_commands_keep_inner_jobs_on_the_program_and_record_its_status() {
9072        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
9073        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
9074        let subset =
9075            BuckSubset::from_json("s0", include_str!("../../buck-e2e/subsets/s0.json")).unwrap();
9076        let plan: serde_json::Value =
9077            serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../../expected-e2e-plan.json")).unwrap();
9078        let backends = plan["cells"]
9079            .as_array()
9080            .unwrap()
9081            .iter()
9082            .map(|cell| cell["backend"].as_str().unwrap().to_string())
9083            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
9084        let selected = buck_subset_selection(&committed, &subset, &backends).unwrap();
9085        for step in &selected.steps {
9086            let rendered =
9087                dagrun::model::command_with_inner_jobs(step, &selected.default_jobs_flag, Some(8));
9088            assert!(
9089                rendered.starts_with(step.cmd.as_str()),
9090                "{}: dagrun no longer appends: {rendered}",
9091                step.tag()
9092            );
9093            // Nothing may end a command before the arguments dagrun appends.
9094            assert!(
9095                !step.cmd.trim_end().ends_with("exit $rc"),
9096                "{}: {}",
9097                step.tag(),
9098                step.cmd
9099            );
9100        }
9101        let twins = selected
9102            .steps
9103            .iter()
9104            .filter(|step| step.job.ends_with("_buck_s0"))
9105            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
9106        // The case the seat found: the c-programs twin declares --jobs 8, and
9107        // dagrun renders it with that count, unforced.
9108        let c_programs = twins
9109            .iter()
9110            .find(|step| step.tag() == "e2e.manifest_c_programs_buck_s0")
9111            .unwrap();
9112        assert_eq!(c_programs.jobs_flag.as_deref(), Some("--jobs"));
9113        assert_eq!(c_programs.hint.preferred_inner_jobs, Some(8));
9114        let real = dagrun::model::command_with_inner_jobs(
9115            c_programs,
9116            &selected.default_jobs_flag,
9117            c_programs.hint.preferred_inner_jobs,
9118        );
9119        assert!(real.ends_with(" --jobs 8"), "{real}");
9120
9121        let fixture = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("buck-s0-rendered-{}", std::process::id()));
9122        let bin = fixture.join("ci/buck-e2e/staged/bin");
9123        std::fs::create_dir_all(&bin).unwrap();
9124        std::fs::write(
9125            fixture.join("ci/buck-e2e/staged/SOURCE_SHA"),
9126            format!("{}\n", "0".repeat(40)),
9127        )
9128        .unwrap();
9129        let harness = bin.join("test-harness");
9130        std::fs::write(
9131            &harness,
9132            "#!/bin/bash\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$@\" > \"$STUB_ARGV\"\n[ -z \"${STUB_SLEEP:-}\" ] || sleep \"$STUB_SLEEP\"\nexit \"$STUB_EXIT\"\n",
9133        )
9134        .unwrap();
9135        std::fs::set_permissions(&harness, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
9136        let state = fixture.join("run-buck-s0-1-2");
9137        std::fs::create_dir_all(&state).unwrap();
9138        let argv = fixture.join("argv");
9139        for twin in &twins {
9140            let tag = twin.tag();
9141            let rendered =
9142                dagrun::model::command_with_inner_jobs(twin, &selected.default_jobs_flag, Some(8));
9143            let appended = shell_words::split(&rendered[twin.cmd.len()..]).unwrap();
9144            assert!(
9145                !appended.is_empty(),
9146                "{tag}: nothing appended to {rendered}"
9147            );
9148            let record = state.join(format!("twin-status/{tag}.rc"));
9149            for status in [0, 3] {
9150                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&argv);
9151                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&record);
9152                let output = Command::new("bash")
9153                    .arg("-c")
9154                    .arg(&rendered)
9155                    .env("VALIDATE_RUN_STATE", &state)
9156                    .env("E2E_RESULT_ROOT", fixture.join("results"))
9157                    .env("STUB_ARGV", &argv)
9158                    .env("STUB_EXIT", status.to_string())
9159                    .current_dir(&fixture)
9160                    .output()
9161                    .expect("run bash");
9162                assert_eq!(
9163                    output.status.code(),
9164                    Some(status),
9165                    "{tag}: {}",
9166                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
9167                );
9168                assert_eq!(
9169                    std::fs::read_to_string(&record).unwrap(),
9170                    format!("{status}\n"),
9171                    "{tag}"
9172                );
9173                let seen = std::fs::read_to_string(&argv).unwrap();
9174                let seen = seen.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>();
9175                let tail = appended.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
9176                assert!(
9177                    seen.ends_with(&tail),
9178                    "{tag}: the harness saw {seen:?}, which does not end in {tail:?}"
9179                );
9180            }
9181            // Killed by dagrun: SIGTERM to the node's process group at a wall
9182            // or CPU breach or a cancellation, and SIGINT and SIGHUP alike.
9183            // The record holds the signal's status, never the 0 of the
9184            // command's earlier `export`.
9185            let results = fixture.join("results");
9186            for (signal, status) in [
9187                (libc::SIGTERM, 143),
9188                (libc::SIGINT, 130),
9189                (libc::SIGHUP, 129),
9190            ] {
9191                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&record);
9192                let code = signal_group_once_started(
9193                    &rendered,
9194                    &[
9195                        ("VALIDATE_RUN_STATE", state.as_os_str()),
9196                        ("E2E_RESULT_ROOT", results.as_os_str()),
9197                        ("STUB_ARGV", argv.as_os_str()),
9198                        ("STUB_EXIT", std::ffi::OsStr::new("0")),
9199                        ("STUB_SLEEP", std::ffi::OsStr::new("60")),
9200                    ],
9201                    &fixture,
9202                    &argv,
9203                    signal,
9204                );
9205                assert_eq!(code, Some(status), "{tag}: signal {signal}");
9206                assert_eq!(
9207                    std::fs::read_to_string(&record).unwrap(),
9208                    format!("{status}\n"),
9209                    "{tag}: signal {signal}"
9210                );
9211            }
9212        }
9213        // The last node's wait refuses a killed twin's record: no verdict.
9214        let c_tag = c_programs.tag();
9215        let killed = signal_group_once_started(
9216            &real,
9217            &[
9218                ("VALIDATE_RUN_STATE", state.as_os_str()),
9219                ("E2E_RESULT_ROOT", fixture.join("results").as_os_str()),
9220                ("STUB_ARGV", argv.as_os_str()),
9221                ("STUB_EXIT", std::ffi::OsStr::new("0")),
9222                ("STUB_SLEEP", std::ffi::OsStr::new("60")),
9223            ],
9224            &fixture,
9225            &argv,
9226            libc::SIGTERM,
9227        );
9228        assert_eq!(killed, Some(143));
9229        let gate = Command::new("bash")
9230            .arg("-c")
9231            .arg(buck_no_cargo_wait_then_check(
9232                "gate.no_cargo_t",
9233                std::slice::from_ref(&c_tag),
9234                0,
9235            ))
9236            .env("VALIDATE_RUN_STATE", &state)
9237            .current_dir(&fixture)
9238            .output()
9239            .expect("run bash");
9240        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&gate.stderr);
9241        assert_eq!(gate.status.code(), Some(1), "{stderr}");
9242        assert!(
9243            stderr.contains(&format!(
9244                "the import twin {c_tag} was killed by a signal (exit 143"
9245            )) && stderr.contains("no verdict"),
9246            "{stderr}"
9247        );
9248        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&fixture).expect("remove the rendered-command fixture");
9249        // A command that would drop or falsify its record is refused: any trap
9250        // of its own, the signal traps included, or an exec.
9251        for cmd in [
9252            "trap 'x' EXIT; y",
9253            "trap 'exit 0' TERM; y",
9254            "trap '' INT; y",
9255            "y; trap - HUP",
9256            "a; exec b",
9257        ] {
9258            assert!(refuse_record_breakers("t", cmd).is_err(), "{cmd}");
9259        }
9260        for cmd in [
9261            "a; \\exec b",
9262            "a; \"exec\" b",
9263            "eval 'exec b'",
9264            "x=exec; $x b",
9265            "source ./lib.sh; y",
9266        ] {
9267            assert!(refuse_record_breakers("t", cmd).is_err(), "{cmd}");
9268        }
9269        assert!(refuse_record_breakers("t", "harness run --exec-mode x").is_ok());
9270        // A trap planted in a committed twin's command is refused when the
9271        // selection is built, before the run could lose or falsify a record.
9272        let mut planted = committed.clone();
9273        let source = planted
9274            .steps
9275            .iter_mut()
9276            .find(|step| step.tag() == "e2e.manifest_c_programs_buck")
9277            .expect("the committed c-programs import twin");
9278        source.cmd = format!("trap '' TERM; {}", source.cmd);
9279        let refused = buck_subset_selection(&planted, &subset, &backends).unwrap_err();
9280        assert!(
9281            refused.contains("e2e.manifest_c_programs_buck_s0's command runs `trap`"),
9282            "{refused}"
9283        );
9284    }

9286    #[test]
9287    fn buck_recorder_sets_its_signal_traps_before_its_exit_trap_so_no_signal_records_zero() {
9288        let state = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
9289            "buck-recorder-order-{}-{:?}",
9290            std::process::id(),
9291            std::thread::current().id()
9292        ));
9293        let dir = state
9294            .to_str()
9295            .expect("a UTF-8 temporary directory")
9296            .to_string();
9297        let record = state.join("t.rc");
9298        let recorded = recording_status("true", &dir, "t");
9299        let exit_trap_end = recorded.find("' EXIT; ").expect("an EXIT trap") + "' EXIT; ".len();
9300        // A signal at each point of the prologue, delivered deterministically:
9301        // the shell sends it to itself, and handles it before its next command.
9302        // It leaves no record or the signal's status, never the 0 of the
9303        // last completed command.
9304        let mut boundaries = vec![0];
9305        for marker in [" TERM; ", " INT; ", " HUP; "] {
9306            boundaries.push(recorded.find(marker).unwrap() + marker.len());
9307        }
9308        boundaries.push(exit_trap_end);
9309        for (signal, status) in [("TERM", 143), ("INT", 130), ("HUP", 129)] {
9310            for (at, &boundary) in boundaries.iter().enumerate() {
9311                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&record);
9312                let spliced = format!(
9313                    "{}kill -s {signal} $$; {}",
9314                    &recorded[..boundary],
9315                    &recorded[boundary..]
9316                );
9317                let output = bash_with_default_signals(&spliced)
9318                    .output()
9319                    .expect("run bash");
9320                assert_ne!(output.status.code(), Some(0), "{signal} at {at}: {spliced}");
9321                match std::fs::read_to_string(&record) {
9322                    Ok(text) => assert_eq!(text, format!("{status}\n"), "{signal} at {at}"),
9323                    Err(error) => {
9324                        assert_eq!(error.kind(), std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound);
9325                        // Once the EXIT trap is set, a signal must be recorded.
9326                        assert!(
9327                            boundary < exit_trap_end,
9328                            "{signal} after the EXIT trap left no record"
9329                        );
9330                    }
9331                }
9332            }
9333        }
9334        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&state);
9335        // The order itself: every signal trap, then the EXIT trap, then the
9336        // command, last.
9337        assert!(
9338            recorded.starts_with(
9339                "trap 'exit 143' TERM; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 129' HUP; trap 'rc=$?;"
9340            ),
9341            "{recorded}"
9342        );
9343        assert_eq!(&recorded[exit_trap_end..], "true");
9344    }

9675            + validate_node[start..]

9677                .expect("await_preflight ends")

9680        let fixture = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("buck-s0-records-{}", std::process::id()));
9681        let plant = |dir: &std::path::Path| {
9682            std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.join("preflight")).unwrap();

9688        };
9689        let wait = |dir: &std::path::Path| {
9690            std::process::Command::new("bash")
9691                .arg("-c")

9693                .env(BUCK_S0_AWAIT_PREFLIGHT_ENV, BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT.join(" "))

9718            cleared.status.code(),
9719            Some(0),
9720            "{}",

9732            String::from_utf8_lossy(&waited.stderr).contains("wrote no exit status"),

9735        );

9739        plant(&state);

9741        let killed = signal_group_once_started(

9750            &fixture,
9751            &started,

9754        assert_eq!(killed, Some(143));
9755        assert_eq!(
9756            std::fs::read_to_string(state.join(format!("preflight/{}.rc", BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT[0])))
9757                .unwrap(),

9763            String::from_utf8_lossy(&refused.stderr).contains(&format!(
9764                "the preflight node {} failed (exit 143)",

9768            String::from_utf8_lossy(&refused.stderr)

9773        assert!(!export.join("preflight").exists());

9778        plant(&fixture.join(relative));

9780        for (value, why) in [
9781            ("", "is unset or empty"),
9782            ("/", "is not named like a run state"),
9783            (relative, "is not an absolute path"),
9784            (unnamed.to_str().unwrap(), "is not named like a run state"),
9785            (missing.to_str().unwrap(), "is not an existing directory"),
9786        ] {
9787            let refused = clear(value);
9788            assert_eq!(refused.status.code(), Some(2), "{value:?}");
9789            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&refused.stderr);
9790            assert!(
9791                stderr.contains(why) && stderr.contains("nothing was deleted"),

9793            );
9794        }
9795        for dir in [unnamed, fixture.join(relative)] {
9796            for tag in BUCK_S0_PREFLIGHT {
9797                assert!(
9798                    dir.join(format!("preflight/{tag}.rc")).exists(),
9799                    "a refusal deleted {}",
9800                    dir.display()
9801                );
9802            }
9803            assert!(
9804                dir.join("twin-status/e2e.a.rc").exists(),
9805                "a refusal deleted {}'s twin-status",
9806                dir.display()
9807            );
9808        }
9809        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&fixture).expect("remove the records fixture");
9810        // A subset naming a backend the plan lacks is refused, never shrunk.
9811        let mut typo = subset.clone();
9812        typo.backends.push("ptrace2".into());
9813        assert!(buck_subset_selection(&committed, &typo, &backends).is_err());
9814        // The cargo check sees cargo however it is spelled in a command.
9815        assert!(runs_cargo("export X=1; cargo build --locked"));
9816        assert!(runs_cargo("target/debug/test-harness run"));
9817        assert!(runs_cargo("x && ./scripts/check-no-v3.rs --all"));
9818        assert!(runs_cargo("rust-script scripts/x"));
9819        assert!(!runs_cargo(
9820            "CARGO_TARGET_DIR=x ./ci/run-reverie-pin-check.sh"
9821        ));
9822        // A command naming the shim, its directory or its log runs no cargo;
9823        // cargo named anywhere else still does.
9824        assert!(!runs_cargo(&format!(
9825            "{BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_PATH}cat \"$PWD/{BUCK_S0_CARGO_REFUSED_LOG}\""
9826        )));
9827        assert!(runs_cargo(&format!("{BUCK_S0_NO_CARGO_PATH}cargo build")));
9828        assert!(runs_cargo("CARGO=\"$PWD/other/cargo\" make"));
9829        // Every node keeps the committed rust-script PATH prefix, which runs nothing.
9830        assert!(!runs_cargo(
9831            "export PATH=\"$PWD/ci/rust-script-bin:$PATH\"; export HERMIT_RUST_SCRIPT_ARTIFACT_ROOT=\"$PWD/target/ci/rust-scripts\"; ./ci/verify-submodules.sh"
9832        ));
9833    }

9836    fn buck_e2e_selection_refuses_a_planted_same_count_extension_swap() {
9837        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
9838        let cells = expected_cells(&crate::git_environment::checkout_root()).unwrap();
9839        assert_buck_e2e_selection(&committed, &cells).unwrap();

9841        // it is not replaced) and drop a different extension tag,
9842        // build.reverie_buck, instead (a fake twin makes it replaced).
9843        // The dropped extension count is unchanged at two; the pinned
9844        // named set must refuse, naming the expected set.
9845        let mut planted = committed.clone();
9846        let mut fake_twin = planted
9847            .steps
9848            .iter()
9849            .find(|step| step.tag() == "e2e.manifest_rr_buck")
9850            .unwrap()
9851            .clone();
9852        planted
9853            .steps
9854            .retain(|step| step.tag() != "e2e.manifest_rr_buck");
9855        // A kept cargo bucket must not still need the replaced
9856        // producers, or the selection derivation itself refuses first.
9857        let rr = planted
9858            .steps
9859            .iter_mut()
9860            .find(|step| step.tag() == "e2e.manifest_rr")
9861            .unwrap();
9862        rr.deps.retain(|dep| {
9863            dep != "build.manifest_guests_in_pinned_root"
9864                && dep != "setup.manifest_plan_in_pinned_root"
9865        });
9866        fake_twin.group = "build".into();
9867        fake_twin.job = "reverie_buck_buck".into();
9868        planted.steps.push(fake_twin);
9869        let error = assert_buck_e2e_selection(&planted, &cells).unwrap_err();
9870        assert!(
9871            error.contains("expected exactly {\"e2e.manifest_gvisor\", \"e2e.manifest_rr\"}"),
9872            "{error}"
9873        );

9877    fn committed_buck_e2e_selection_replaces_22_nodes_with_18() {

9879        let cells = expected_cells(&crate::git_environment::checkout_root()).unwrap();
9880        assert_buck_e2e_selection(&committed, &cells).unwrap();
9881        // The name predates e2e.buck_stage: 19 full-buck-e2e nodes since
9882        // the stage left e2e.buck_cells, 18 before.
9883        // 90 full nodes (89 before build.workspace_compile_in_pinned_root
9884        // split the Cargo half out of build.workspace_in_pinned_root, 88
9885        // before test.record_replay joined full, 89 before
9886        // test.liteinst_strict was retired with the LiteInst host hybrid,
9887        // https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3520; 87 before
9888        // test.detcore_time joined full, 88 before
9889        // privileged-test.pmu_detcore_time_cases did) - 22 replaced + 19
9890        // full-buck-e2e nodes (18, and 86 in all, before e2e.buck_stage).
9891        // 88 since test.pmu_integration_cases joined full (91 full
9892        // nodes). 90 since build.liteinst_allocator_fixtures and
9893        // test.liteinst_allocator joined full (93 full nodes).
9894        // 91 with the additive required M2 stack node (94 full nodes).
9895        // The inherited-terminal target stays required beside the Buck cells.
9896        // 94 since the local test.hermit_integration runs as three shards,
9897        // and 95 with privileged-cpuid.cpu_profile_v3 (98 full nodes;
9898        // https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4243), and 96 since
9899        // test.pmu_integration_cases runs as two shards (99 full nodes),
9900        // and 99 with the three backend isolation matrix nodes (102 full
9901        // nodes), and 101 with the two syscall conformance nodes (104), and
9902        // 99 again since that check runs in Reverie's own validate and CI
9903        // (102 full nodes), and 100 with build.liteinst_runtime_in_pinned_root
9904        // (103 full nodes), and 103 since e2e.manifest_compat moved into the
9905        // pinned root on compatprep.fixtures_in_pinned_root (106 full nodes),
9906        // and 101 since the host fixtures route through build.host_hermit_link
9907        // and the retired base producers stay retired (104 full nodes), and
9908        // 102 with privileged-test.deadline_slice_cap_kvm (105 full nodes).
9909        // build.reverie_buck (M2) is a post-split extension node, not a
9910        // frozen core tag, so it is filtered from `expected` by is_core and
9911        // must not appear in the Buck selection population either.
9912        // The Buck profile composes the full profile with Cargo owners replaced,
9913        // rather than selecting the Buck label alone.
9914        let original_full =
9915            crate::dag_source_ownership::source_profile("full", false, true).unwrap();
9916        let original_buck =
9917            crate::dag_source_ownership::source_profile(FULL_BUCK_E2E_LABEL, false, true).unwrap();
9918        let replaced = buck_replaced_tags(&committed).unwrap();
9919        let original = original_full
9920            .difference(&replaced)
9921            .cloned()
9922            .chain(original_buck)
9923            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
9924        assert_eq!(original.len(), 102);
9925        let mut expected = original
9926            .into_iter()
9927            .filter(|tag| crate::dag_source_ownership::is_core(tag))
9928            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
9929        // Post-split extension nodes join the selection through the
9930        // extension registry, not the frozen source lineage: their Buck
9931        // twins (e2e.manifest_rr_buck, e2e.manifest_gvisor_buck) and
9932        // full-profile members that are not replaced
9933        // (check.gvisor_vendoring).
9934        let core_full = crate::dag_source_ownership::source_profile("full", true, true).unwrap();
9935        expected.extend(
9936            crate::dag_source_ownership::extension_tags()
9937                .into_iter()
9938                .filter(|tag| {
9939                    tag.ends_with("_buck") || (core_full.contains(tag) && !replaced.contains(tag))
9940                }),
9941        );
9942        let actual = buck_e2e_selection(&committed)
9943            .unwrap()
9944            .steps
9945            .iter()
9946            .map(Step::tag)
9947            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
9948        assert_eq!(actual, expected);
9949
9950        fn twin(cfg: &mut DagConfig) -> &mut Step {
9951            cfg.steps
9952                .iter_mut()
9953                .find(|step| step.tag() == "e2e.manifest_c_programs_buck")
9954                .unwrap()
9955        }
9956        let mut wrapped = committed.clone();
9957        let cmd = twin(&mut wrapped).cmd.clone();
9958        twin(&mut wrapped).cmd = format!("./ci/hermetic/run-in-pinned-root.sh -- {cmd}");
9959        let error = assert_buck_e2e_selection(&wrapped, &cells).unwrap_err();
9960        assert!(error.contains("not a host-side import"), "{error}");
9961
9962        let mut unlabelled = committed.clone();
9963        twin(&mut unlabelled).labels.clear();
9964        let error = assert_buck_e2e_selection(&unlabelled, &cells).unwrap_err();
9965        assert!(error.contains("Buck E2E"), "{error}");
9966    }

9968    /// ci-hub's whole-run budget for a validation
9969    /// (`hermit_run_timeout_seconds` in dev-hermit
9970    /// ci-hub/validate/start_unit.py, for its 4800 s lock child deadline).
9971    /// It does not depend on the selection: a quick, envelope-only or
9972    /// qemu-l2-only run gets the same 4200 s as a full one.
9973    const CI_HUB_RUN_BUDGET_S: i64 = 4200;
9974    /// Preparation every committed selection must survive: scripts/validate.rs
9975    /// anchors the run epoch before locks, freshness checks, plan construction
9976    /// and the cgroup re-exec, and hands dagrun only what is left, while a
9977    /// committed selection's node budgets are never clamped to it. Measured
9978    /// preparation on one development host: 65 s and 134 s typically, 734 s at
9979    /// worst (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3896).
9980    // 800 since quick.e2e_verify's wall bound rose to 3400 for the cell
9981    // retry window (two attempts of the largest resolved cell wall at
9982    // CPU 1.25x/wall 1.5x plus grace, 3380 s): the reserve must leave
9983    // that node inside the 4200 s budget, and 800 still covers the
9984    // measured worst preparation (734 s, issue 3896).
9985    const PREPARATION_RESERVE_S: i64 = 800;
9986
9987    #[test]
9988    fn every_committed_node_declares_its_caps_and_an_uncapped_one_is_refused() {
9989        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
9990        assert_declared_caps(&committed).unwrap();
9991        for (what, edit) in [
9992            (
9993                "wall",
9994                &(|step: &mut Step| step.timeout = 0) as &dyn Fn(&mut Step),
9995            ),
9996            ("memory", &|step: &mut Step| {
9997                step.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes = None;
9998                step.hint.rss_baseline_bytes = None;
9999            }),
10000        ] {
10001            let mut broken = committed.clone();
10002            edit(&mut broken.steps[0]);
10003            let error = assert_declared_caps(&broken).unwrap_err();
10004            assert!(
10005                error.contains(&broken.steps[0].tag()) && error.contains("would run unboxed"),
10006                "{what}: {error}"
10007            );
10008        }
10009        let mut no_cpu = committed.clone();
10010        no_cpu.default_step_cpu_timeout = 0;
10011        no_cpu.steps[0].cpu_timeout = 0;
10012        assert!(assert_declared_caps(&no_cpu).is_err());
10013    }

10015    #[test]
10016    fn committed_selections_survive_a_slow_preparation() {
10017        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
10018        let labels: BTreeSet<&str> = committed
10019            .steps
10020            .iter()
10021            .flat_map(|step| step.labels.iter().map(String::as_str))
10022            .collect();
10023        let mut selections = vec![(
10024            "full with the Buck runner".to_string(),
10025            buck_e2e_selection(&committed).unwrap(),
10026        )];
10027        for label in &labels {
10028            selections.push((
10029                format!("label {label}"),
10030                select_steps_by_labels(&committed, &[label.to_string()]).unwrap(),
10031            ));
10032        }
10033        // The three focused profiles that carried a 3600 s build node
10034        // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3906) must stay covered.
10035        for label in ["full", "quick", "envelope-only", "qemu-l2-only"] {
10036            assert!(
10037                labels.contains(label),
10038                "the committed DAG lost label {label}"
10039            );
10040        }
10041        for (name, selection) in &selections {
10042            // The refusal of https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3896:
10043            // 734 s of preparation left 3466 s, and dagrun refused every node
10044            // because e2e.buck_cells declared 3600 s.
10045            let after_734 = dagrun::scheduler::steps_violating_run_timeout(
10046                selection,
10047                CI_HUB_RUN_BUDGET_S - 734,
10048            );
10049            assert!(
10050                after_734.is_empty(),
10051                "{name}: after 734 s of preparation dagrun refuses {after_734:?}"
10052            );
10053            let after_reserve = dagrun::scheduler::steps_violating_run_timeout(
10054                selection,
10055                CI_HUB_RUN_BUDGET_S - PREPARATION_RESERVE_S,
10056            );
10057            assert!(
10058                after_reserve.is_empty(),
10059                "{name}: these committed nodes leave less than {PREPARATION_RESERVE_S} s of the \
10060                 {CI_HUB_RUN_BUDGET_S} s run budget for preparation, so a slow preparation \
10061                 makes dagrun refuse the whole run: {after_reserve:?}"
10062            );
10063        }
10064    }

10344    #[test]
10345    fn tool_self_test_guard_refuses_each_planted_drift() {
10346        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
10347        assert_tool_self_test_nodes(&committed).unwrap();
10348        let step_mut = |cfg: &mut DagConfig, tag: &str| -> usize {
10349            cfg.steps.iter().position(|step| step.tag() == tag).unwrap()
10350        };
10351        let refused = |mutate: &dyn Fn(&mut DagConfig), expected: &[&str]| {
10352            let mut planted = committed.clone();
10353            mutate(&mut planted);
10354            let error = assert_tool_self_test_nodes(&planted).unwrap_err();
10355            for fragment in expected {
10356                assert!(
10357                    error.contains(fragment),
10358                    "{fragment:?} missing from {error}"
10359                );
10360            }
10361        };
10362        // A product node that waits on a self-test puts it back on the
10363        // critical path, which is the defect this layout removed.
10364        refused(
10365            &|cfg| {
10366                let index = step_mut(cfg, "build.workspace_in_pinned_root");
10367                cfg.steps[index].deps.push("selftest.scorecard".into());
10368            },
10369            &[
10370                "build.workspace_in_pinned_root depends on tool self-test selftest.scorecard",
10371                "critical path",
10372            ],
10373        );
10374        refused(
10375            &|cfg| {
10376                let index = step_mut(cfg, "selftest.pressure_test");
10377                cfg.steps.remove(index);
10378            },
10379            &["lost tool self-test node selftest.pressure_test"],
10380        );
10381        refused(
10382            &|cfg| {
10383                let index = step_mut(cfg, "selftest.validate_rs");
10384                cfg.steps[index].labels.retain(|label| label != "portable");
10385            },
10386            &["selftest.validate_rs must run exactly"],
10387        );
10388        refused(
10389            &|cfg| {
10390                let index = step_mut(cfg, "quick-super-selftest.core_build");
10391                cfg.steps[index].cmd = "true".into();
10392            },
10393            &["quick-super-selftest.core_build must run exactly"],
10394        );
10395        refused(
10396            &|cfg| {
10397                let index = step_mut(cfg, "selftest.scorecard");
10398                cfg.steps[index].cpu_timeout = 0;
10399            },
10400            &["selftest.scorecard must run exactly", "positive caps"],
10401        );
10402        refused(
10403            &|cfg| {
10404                let index = step_mut(cfg, "selftest.manifest_cli");
10405                let mut extra = cfg.steps[index].clone();
10406                extra.job = "bogus".into();
10407                cfg.steps.push(extra);
10408            },
10409            &["selftest.bogus", "differ from TOOL_SELF_TESTS"],

10413    #[test]
10414    fn manifest_gate_carries_a_one_core_admission_over_inherited_build_width() {
10415        use dagrun::model::command_with_inner_jobs;
10416        use dagrun::model::env_with_inner_jobs;
10417
10418        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
10419        assert_manifest_gate_width_contract(&committed).unwrap();
10420        for tag in [
10421            "gate.manifest",
10422            "quick-super-gate.manifest",
10423            "gate.manifest_on_host",
10424        ] {
10425            let step = committed
10426                .steps
10427                .iter()
10428                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
10429                .unwrap();
10430            assert_eq!(
10431                env_with_inner_jobs(step, "", Some(2)),
10432                Some(("CARGO_BUILD_JOBS".into(), "2".into())),
10433                "{tag} must expose both admitted workers on an unconstrained host"
10434            );
10435            assert_eq!(
10436                env_with_inner_jobs(step, "", Some(1)),
10437                Some(("CARGO_BUILD_JOBS".into(), "1".into())),
10438                "{tag} must replace an inherited CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 when admitted to one core"
10439            );
10440            assert_eq!(
10441                command_with_inner_jobs(step, "-j", Some(2)),
10442                step.cmd,
10443                "{tag} must suppress dagrun's default -j argument and preserve the exact test-harness command"
10444            );
10445            assert_eq!(
10446                command_with_inner_jobs(step, "-j", Some(1)),
10447                step.cmd,
10448                "{tag} must preserve the exact test-harness command at a reduced admission"
10449            );
10450
10451            let mut unbound = step.clone();
10452            unbound.jobs_env = None;
10453            let inherited = ("CARGO_BUILD_JOBS".to_string(), "4".to_string());
10454            let opponent = env_with_inner_jobs(&unbound, "", Some(1)).unwrap_or(inherited);
10455            assert_eq!(
10456                opponent,
10457                ("CARGO_BUILD_JOBS".into(), "4".into()),
10458                "the opponent must preserve the RUN1902 oversubscription mechanism"
10459            );
10460            let mut broken = committed.clone();
10461            broken
10462                .steps
10463                .iter_mut()
10464                .find(|candidate| candidate.tag() == tag)
10465                .unwrap()
10466                .jobs_env = None;
10467            assert!(
10468                assert_manifest_gate_width_contract(&broken)
10469                    .unwrap_err()
10470                    .contains(tag)
10471            );
10472
10473            // The local gates carry MANIFEST_GATE_CPU_SECONDS; the
10474            // hosted-privileged variant keeps 600. Swapping either value fails.
10475            let mut recapped = committed.clone();
10476            recapped
10477                .steps
10478                .iter_mut()
10479                .find(|candidate| candidate.tag() == tag)
10480                .unwrap()
10481                .cpu_timeout = if tag == "gate.manifest_on_host" {
10482                crate::validation_dag_static::MANIFEST_GATE_CPU_SECONDS
10483            } else {
10484                600
10485            };
10486            assert!(
10487                assert_manifest_gate_width_contract(&recapped)
10488                    .unwrap_err()
10489                    .contains(tag)
10490            );
10491        }
10492    }

10573    #[test]
10574    fn structured_result_registry_is_exact_and_bijective() {
10575        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
10576        assert_structured_result_producers(&committed).unwrap();
10577
10578        for kind in StructuredResultProducerKind::ALL {
10579            let tag = kind.tags()[0];
10580            let mut missing = committed.clone();
10581            missing
10582                .steps
10583                .iter_mut()
10584                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
10585                .unwrap()
10586                .result_manifests
10587                .as_mut()
10588                .unwrap()
10589                .retain(|manifest| !matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)));
10590            let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&missing).unwrap_err();
10591            assert!(error.contains(tag) && error.contains("omits"), "{error}");
10592
10593            let mut changed_writer = committed.clone();
10594            let step = changed_writer
10595                .steps
10596                .iter_mut()
10597                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
10598                .unwrap();
10599            step.cmd = step
10600                .cmd
10601                .replace(kind.command_marker(), "removed-structured-result-writer");
10602            let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&changed_writer).unwrap_err();
10603            assert!(
10604                error.contains(tag) && error.contains("no longer invokes"),
10605                "{error}"
10606            );
10607        }
10608
10609        // A test node that writes no structured results is refused at plan
10610        // time: validate's coverage would list it absent in every run, and no
10611        // passing validation would be VALIDATED (2026-10-15 to 2026-10-17).
10612        for group in ["test", "privileged-test", "lane:test"] {
10613            let mut uncounted = committed.clone();
10614            let mut step = uncounted
10615                .steps
10616                .iter()
10617                .find(|step| step.tag() == "test.regular_crates")
10618                .unwrap()
10619                .clone();
10620            step.group = group.into();
10621            step.job = "uncounted_checker".into();
10622            step.cmd = "./tests/some-checker.rs".into();
10623            step.env.remove("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED");
10624            step.result_manifests = None;
10625            uncounted.steps.push(step);
10626            let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&uncounted).unwrap_err();
10627            assert!(
10628                error.contains(&format!("{group}.uncounted_checker"))
10629                    && error.contains("is a test node"),
10630                "{error}"
10631            );
10632        }
10633
10634        let template = committed
10635            .steps
10636            .iter()
10637            .find(|step| step.tag() == "test.regular_crates")
10638            .unwrap()
10639            .result_manifests
10640            .as_ref()
10641            .unwrap()
10642            .iter()
10643            .find(|manifest| matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)))
10644            .unwrap()
10645            .clone();
10646
10647        let mut extra = committed.clone();
10648        let extra_step = extra
10649            .steps
10650            .iter_mut()
10651            .find(|step| step.tag() == "quick.run_smoke")
10652            .unwrap();
10653        let mut extra_manifest = template.clone();
10654        let ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(declaration) = &mut extra_manifest else {
10655            unreachable!()
10656        };
10657        declaration.owner = extra_step.tag();
10658        extra_step
10659            .result_manifests
10660            .as_mut()
10661            .unwrap()
10662            .push(extra_manifest);
10663        let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&extra).unwrap_err();
10664        assert!(
10665            error.contains("quick.run_smoke") && error.contains("declares"),
10666            "{error}"
10667        );
10668
10669        let mut duplicate = committed.clone();
10670        duplicate
10671            .steps
10672            .iter_mut()
10673            .find(|step| step.tag() == "test.regular_crates")
10674            .unwrap()
10675            .result_manifests
10676            .as_mut()
10677            .unwrap()
10678            .push(template.clone());
10679        let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&duplicate).unwrap_err();
10680        assert!(error.contains("more than once"), "{error}");
10681
10682        let mut wrong_owner = committed.clone();
10683        let ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(declaration) = wrong_owner
10684            .steps
10685            .iter_mut()
10686            .find(|step| step.tag() == "test.regular_crates")
10687            .unwrap()
10688            .result_manifests
10689            .as_mut()
10690            .unwrap()
10691            .iter_mut()
10692            .find(|manifest| matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)))
10693            .unwrap()
10694        else {
10695            unreachable!()
10696        };
10697        declaration.owner = "other.step".into();
10698        let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&wrong_owner).unwrap_err();
10699        assert!(error.contains("owner 'other.step'"), "{error}");
10700    }

10726        let error = dag_from_json(&wrong_path).unwrap_err().to_string();

10731    fn structured_result_counts_and_ownership_survive_generation_transforms() {
10732        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
10733        // No counted step carries a pinned total any more: declaring the
10734        // retired variable, on a counted node or any other, is refused by
10735        // name. (The unmutated committed DAG passing is asserted by every
10736        // caller of this function, e.g. the generation checks above.)
10737        for (tag, value) in [("test.cli", "999"), ("quick.run_smoke", "1")] {

10740                .steps

10745                .insert("NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED".into(), value.into());
10746            let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&changed).unwrap_err();
10747            assert!(error.contains(tag) && error.contains("retired"), "{error}");
10748        }
10749
10750        let mut inline_count = committed.clone();
10751        inline_count
10752            .steps
10753            .iter_mut()
10754            .find(|step| step.tag() == "test.cli")
10755            .unwrap()
10756            .cmd
10757            .insert_str(0, "NEXTEST_EXPECTED_EXECUTED=71 ");
10758        let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&inline_count).unwrap_err();
10759        assert!(
10760            error.contains("test.cli") && error.contains("command text"),
10761            "{error}"
10762        );
10763
10764        let mut duplicate_writer = committed.clone();
10765        duplicate_writer
10766            .steps
10767            .iter_mut()
10768            .find(|step| step.tag() == "test.regular_crates")
10769            .unwrap()
10770            .cmd
10771            .push_str("; ./ci/run-nextest-counted.sh -p duplicate");
10772        let error = assert_structured_result_producers(&duplicate_writer).unwrap_err();
10773        assert!(
10774            error.contains("test.regular_crates") && error.contains("2 times"),
10775            "{error}"
10776        );
10777        let mut normalized = committed
10778            .steps
10779            .iter()
10780            .find(|step| step.tag() == "test.regular_crates")
10781            .unwrap()
10782            .clone();
10783        let before_normalize = normalized
10784            .result_manifests
10785            .as_deref()
10786            .unwrap_or_default()
10787            .iter()
10788            .filter(|manifest| matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)))
10789            .cloned()
10790            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
10791        normalize_step(&mut normalized, Path::new("/repo"), Path::new("/run-state")).unwrap();
10792        let after_normalize = normalized
10793            .result_manifests
10794            .as_deref()
10795            .unwrap_or_default()
10796            .to_vec();
10797        assert_eq!(before_normalize, after_normalize);
10798        assert!(normalized.effective_result_manifests().is_empty());
10799
10800        let cells = expected_cells(&crate::git_environment::checkout_root()).unwrap();
10801        let mut reattached = committed.clone();
10802        let before = reattached
10803            .steps
10804            .iter()
10805            .map(|step| (step.tag(), step.result_manifests.clone()))
10806            .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
10807        attach_result_ownership(&mut reattached, &cells);
10808        for step in &reattached.steps {
10809            let before_structured = before[&step.tag()]
10810                .as_deref()
10811                .unwrap_or_default()
10812                .iter()
10813                .filter(|manifest| matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)))
10814                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
10815            let after_structured = step
10816                .result_manifests
10817                .as_deref()
10818                .unwrap_or_default()
10819                .iter()
10820                .filter(|manifest| matches!(manifest, ResultManifest::StructuredTestResults(_)))
10821                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
10822            assert_eq!(before_structured, after_structured, "{}", step.tag());
10823        }
10824        assert_structured_result_producers(&reattached).unwrap();
10825    }

10827    #[test]
10828    fn host_manifest_plan_build_does_not_wait_for_the_rust_script_tools() {
10829        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
10830        let full = select_steps_by_labels(&committed, &["full".to_string()]).unwrap();
10831        let deps = |tag: &str| {
10832            full.steps
10833                .iter()
10834                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
10835                .unwrap()
10836                .deps
10837                .clone()
10838        };
10839        // The Cargo build starts beside build.rust_scripts, directly and
10840        // transitively, and keeps the rust-script environment, so a script
10841        // added to it fails at once instead of running unprepared.
10842        assert_eq!(deps("setup.manifest_plan"), ["pre.reverie_pin"]);
10843        assert_eq!(deps("pre.reverie_pin"), ["pre.submodules"]);
10844        let setup = full
10845            .steps
10846            .iter()
10847            .find(|step| step.tag() == "setup.manifest_plan")
10848            .unwrap();
10849        assert!(
10850            setup
10851                .cmd
10852                .contains("export HERMIT_PREBUILT_RUST_SCRIPTS_REQUIRED=1;")
10853        );
10854        // gate.manifest, which runs the binaries and the rust-script tools,
10855        // waits for both, and every product node waits for gate.manifest.
10856        assert_eq!(
10857            deps("gate.manifest"),
10858            ["build.rust_scripts", "setup.manifest_plan"]
10859        );
10860    }

10896    #[test]
10897    fn pinned_workspace_compile_does_not_wait_for_the_rust_script_tools() {
10898        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
10899        let find = |cfg: &DagConfig, tag: &str| {
10900            cfg.steps
10901                .iter()
10902                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
10903                .unwrap()
10904                .clone()
10905        };
10906        let full = select_steps_by_labels(&committed, &["full".to_string()]).unwrap();
10907        let compile = find(&full, PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG);
10908        let prepare = find(&full, PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG);
10909        assert_eq!(compile.job, PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_JOB);
10910        // The chain-B edge is gone from the Cargo half, directly and
10911        // transitively, and the preparation half carries it and the compile
10912        // edge.
10913        assert!(
10914            !compile
10915                .deps
10916                .iter()
10917                .any(|dep| dep == PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG)
10918        );
10919        assert_eq!(compile.deps, ["pre.reverie_pin", "setup.pinned_root_fetch"]);
10920        for required in [PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG, PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG] {
10921            assert!(prepare.deps.iter().any(|dep| dep == required), "{required}");
10922        }
10923        assert_pinned_workspace_split(&committed).unwrap();
10924
10925        // The two payloads concatenate to exactly the unsplit producer's
10926        // payload, under one wrapper argv (env names, --out, --cargo-home and
10927        // the pinned-root guard).
10928        let canonical = crate::validation_dag_static::config();
10929        let producer = find(&canonical, "build.workspace");
10930        let joined = pinned_workspace_producer_payload(&committed).unwrap();
10931        assert_eq!(joined, producer.cmd);
10932        let compile_payload = crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(&compile).unwrap();
10933        let prepare_payload = crate::nextest_build_selections::execution_command(&prepare).unwrap();
10934        assert!(prepare_payload.ends_with(&format!(
10935            "./ci/nextest-binaries.rs prepare full --build-mode \"${{HERMIT_VALIDATE_BUILD_MODE:-cargo}}\" && target/validate/stage-detcore-liteinst --source-copy target{EARLY_ARTIFACT_GATE_SUFFIX}"
10936        )));
10937        assert!(!compile_payload.contains("nextest-binaries.rs"));
10938        assert!(compile_payload.ends_with(HERMIT_BIN_SIGNAL_SUFFIX));
10939        let (split_compile, split_prepare) = split_workspace_payload(&producer.cmd).unwrap();
10940        assert_eq!(
10941            (
10942                workspace_compile_payload_with_signal(&split_compile),
10943                workspace_prepare_payload_with_gate(&split_prepare)
10944            ),
10945            (compile_payload.clone(), prepare_payload.clone())
10946        );
10947        assert_eq!(
10948            join_workspace_payloads(&compile_payload, &prepare_payload).unwrap(),
10949            producer.cmd
10950        );
10951        // Only the compile half forwards the artifact-ready channel; every
10952        // other wrapper argument must stay identical between the halves.
10953        let wrapper = |step: &Step| {
10954            let mut argv = shell_words::split(&step.cmd).unwrap();
10955            argv.pop();
10956            let mut normalized = Vec::with_capacity(argv.len());
10957            let mut index = 0;
10958            while index < argv.len() {
10959                if argv[index] == "--env"
10960                    && matches!(
10961                        argv.get(index + 1).map(String::as_str),
10962                        Some("DAGRUN_ARTIFACT_READY_DIR" | "DAGRUN_OUTER_RUN")
10963                    )
10964                {
10965                    index += 2;
10966                } else {
10967                    normalized.push(std::mem::take(&mut argv[index]));
10968                    index += 1;
10969                }
10970            }
10971            normalized
10972        };
10973        for name in ["DAGRUN_ARTIFACT_READY_DIR", "DAGRUN_OUTER_RUN"] {
10974            assert!(compile.cmd.contains(&format!("--env {name}")), "{name}");
10975            assert!(!prepare.cmd.contains(name), "{name}");
10976        }
10977        assert_eq!(wrapper(&compile), wrapper(&prepare));
10978        for needle in [
10979            "--out",
10980            "ignored/hermetic/split",
10981            "--cargo-home",
10982            "ignored/hermetic/split/cargo",
10983            PINNED_ROOT_COMMAND_GUARD,
10984        ] {
10985            assert!(
10986                wrapper(&compile).iter().any(|arg| arg == needle),
10987                "{needle}"
10988            );
10989        }
10990
10991        // The cut refuses a payload without the boundary and one with two.
10992        let missing = producer.cmd.replacen(
10993            WORKSPACE_PREPARATION_BOUNDARY,
10994            " ; ./ci/nextest-binaries.rs prepare ",
10995            1,
10996        );
10997        assert!(
10998            split_workspace_payload(&missing)
10999                .unwrap_err()
11000                .contains("exact Nextest preparation boundary")
11001        );
11002        let duplicated = format!("{} && ./ci/nextest-binaries.rs prepare full", producer.cmd);
11003        assert!(
11004            split_workspace_payload(&duplicated)
11005                .unwrap_err()
11006                .contains("exact Nextest preparation boundary")
11007        );
11008        // The twin splitter, which receives the unwrapped payload, refuses too.
11009        let mut twin = find(&committed, PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG);
11010        twin.cmd = duplicated;
11011        assert!(split_pinned_workspace_twin(twin.clone()).is_err());
11012        twin.cmd = missing;
11013        assert!(split_pinned_workspace_twin(twin).is_err());
11014
11015        // The graph assertion refuses each way of undoing the split's contract.
11016        let mutated = |tag: &str, edit: &dyn Fn(&mut Step)| {
11017            let mut changed = committed.clone();
11018            edit(
11019                changed
11020                    .steps
11021                    .iter_mut()
11022                    .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
11023                    .unwrap(),
11024            );
11025            assert_pinned_workspace_split(&changed).unwrap_err()
11026        };
11027        let waits = mutated(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG, &|step| {
11028            step.deps.push(PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG.into())
11029        });
11030        assert!(waits.contains("waits for"), "{waits}");
11031        // Through an intermediate pinned-root producer that itself waits for
11032        // the rust-script tools.
11033        let waits_transitively = mutated(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG, &|step| {
11034            step.deps.push("setup.manifest_plan_in_pinned_root".into())
11035        });
11036        assert!(
11037            waits_transitively.contains("waits for"),
11038            "{waits_transitively}"
11039        );
11040        let unordered = mutated(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG, &|step| {
11041            step.deps.retain(|dep| dep != PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG)
11042        });
11043        assert!(unordered.contains("must depend directly"), "{unordered}");
11044        let unscripted = mutated(PINNED_WORKSPACE_PREPARE_TAG, &|step| {
11045            step.deps.retain(|dep| dep != PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG)
11046        });
11047        assert!(unscripted.contains("must depend directly"), "{unscripted}");
11048        let bypass = mutated("build.e2e_artifact_in_pinned_root", &|step| {
11049            step.deps.push(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG.into())
11050        });
11051        assert!(bypass.contains("no consumer runs before"), "{bypass}");
11052        let rerooted = mutated(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG, &|step| {
11053            step.cmd = step.cmd.replacen(
11054                "ignored/hermetic/split/cargo",
11055                "ignored/hermetic/other/cargo",
11056                1,
11057            )
11058        });
11059        assert!(
11060            rerooted.contains("different pinned-root wrappers"),
11061            "{rerooted}"
11062        );
11063        let relabeled = mutated(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG, &|step| {
11064            step.labels.pop();
11065        });
11066        assert!(relabeled.contains("labels"), "{relabeled}");
11067        // The Cargo half keeps build.workspace's authored wall and the hosted
11068        // twin keeps the hosted wall; neither may take the other's, and the
11069        // hosted twin's CPU bound stays the Cargo half's.
11070        let compile_wall = mutated(PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG, &|step| {
11071            step.timeout = crate::validation_dag_static::HOSTED_WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS
11072        });
11073        assert!(
11074            compile_wall.contains("lost the workspace build's budget"),
11075            "{compile_wall}"
11076        );
11077        let hosted_wall = mutated("build.workspace_on_host", &|step| {
11078            step.timeout = crate::validation_dag_static::WORKSPACE_WALL_SECONDS
11079        });
11080        assert!(
11081            hosted_wall.contains("not the hosted 3300s"),
11082            "{hosted_wall}"
11083        );
11084        let hosted_cpu = mutated("build.workspace_on_host", &|step| step.cpu_timeout += 1);
11085        assert!(
11086            hosted_cpu.contains("lost the workspace build's budget"),
11087            "{hosted_cpu}"
11088        );
11089        // The assertion is wired into the generator's invariant set.
11090        let mut changed = committed.clone();
11091        changed
11092            .steps
11093            .iter_mut()
11094            .find(|step| step.tag() == PINNED_WORKSPACE_COMPILE_TAG)
11095            .unwrap()
11096            .deps
11097            .push(PINNED_RUST_SCRIPTS_TAG.into());
11098        let cells = expected_cells(&crate::git_environment::checkout_root()).unwrap();
11099        let error = assert_invariants(&changed, &cells).unwrap_err();
11100        assert!(error.contains("waits for"), "{error}");
11101    }
