11103    #[test]
11104    fn hosted_script_unit_tests_twin_changes_only_its_identity_and_wall() {
11105        let committed = dag_from_json(include_str!("../../dag/validate.json")).unwrap();
11106        assert_hosted_script_unit_tests(&committed).unwrap();
11107        let find = |cfg: &DagConfig, tag: &str| {
11108            cfg.steps
11109                .iter()
11110                .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
11111                .unwrap()
11112                .clone()
11113        };
11114        let local = find(&committed, SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG);
11115        let hosted = find(&committed, HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG);
11116        assert_eq!(local.timeout, 1500);
11117        assert_eq!(hosted.timeout, 1500);
11118        assert_eq!(hosted.cpu_timeout, local.cpu_timeout);
11119        assert_eq!(hosted.cmd, local.cmd);
11120        assert_eq!(hosted.deps, local.deps);
11121
11122        // Each lane selects exactly one of the two nodes.
11123        let tags = |labels: &[&str]| {
11124            select_steps_by_labels(
11125                &committed,
11126                &labels
11127                    .iter()
11128                    .map(|label| label.to_string())
11129                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
11130            )
11131            .unwrap()
11132            .steps
11133            .iter()
11134            .map(Step::tag)
11135            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
11136        };
11137        for (labels, selected, absent) in [
11138            (
11139                &[HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL][..],
11140                HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG,
11141                SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG,
11142            ),
11143            (
11144                &["full"][..],
11145                SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG,
11146                HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG,
11147            ),
11148            (
11149                &["portable"][..],
11150                SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG,
11151                HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG,
11152            ),
11153        ] {
11154            let chosen = tags(labels);
11155            assert!(chosen.contains(selected), "{labels:?}");
11156            assert!(!chosen.contains(absent), "{labels:?}");
11157        }
11158
11159        // The pass rebuilds the committed twin from the authored node.
11160        let mut authored = committed.clone();
11161        authored
11162            .steps
11163            .retain(|step| step.tag() != HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG);
11164        let original = authored
11165            .steps
11166            .iter_mut()
11167            .find(|step| step.tag() == SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)
11168            .unwrap();
11169        original.labels.push(HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL.into());
11170        original.labels.sort();
11171        let mut rebuilt = authored.clone();
11172        materialize_hosted_script_unit_tests(&mut rebuilt).unwrap();
11173        let one = |step: &Step| {
11174            dag_to_json(&DagConfig {
11175                steps: vec![step.clone()],
11176                ..Default::default()
11177            })
11178        };
11179        assert_eq!(
11180            one(&find(&rebuilt, HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)),
11181            one(&hosted)
11182        );
11183        assert_eq!(one(&find(&rebuilt, SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)), one(&local));
11184        // It refuses a node that no longer runs in the hosted lane or no
11185        // longer carries the authored wall.
11186        let error = materialize_hosted_script_unit_tests(&mut committed.clone()).unwrap_err();
11187        assert!(error.contains("lost its hosted-portable label"), "{error}");
11188        let mut rewalled = authored.clone();
11189        rewalled
11190            .steps
11191            .iter_mut()
11192            .find(|step| step.tag() == SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)
11193            .unwrap()
11194            .timeout = 900;
11195        let error = materialize_hosted_script_unit_tests(&mut rewalled).unwrap_err();
11196        assert!(error.contains("not its authored 1500s"), "{error}");
11197
11198        // The assertion refuses each way of undoing the twin's contract.
11199        let mutated = |tag: &str, edit: &dyn Fn(&mut Step)| {
11200            let mut changed = committed.clone();
11201            edit(
11202                changed
11203                    .steps
11204                    .iter_mut()
11205                    .find(|step| step.tag() == tag)
11206                    .unwrap(),
11207            );
11208            assert_hosted_script_unit_tests(&changed).unwrap_err()
11209        };
11210        let hosted_wall = mutated(HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG, &|step| step.timeout = 900);
11211        assert!(
11212            hosted_wall.contains("not the hosted 1500s"),
11213            "{hosted_wall}"
11214        );
11215        let local_wall = mutated(SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG, &|step| step.timeout = 900);
11216        assert!(
11217            local_wall.contains("not its authored 1500s"),
11218            "{local_wall}"
11219        );
11220        for (what, edit) in [
11221            (
11222                "command",
11223                &(|step: &mut Step| step.cmd.push_str(" --skip-fixture")) as &dyn Fn(&mut Step),
11224            ),
11225            ("CPU bound", &|step: &mut Step| step.cpu_timeout += 1),
11226            ("dependencies", &|step: &mut Step| {
11227                step.deps.pop();
11228            }),
11229            ("memory hint", &|step: &mut Step| {
11230                step.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes = step.hint.hard_mem_max_bytes.map(|bytes| bytes + 1)
11231            }),
11232            ("environment", &|step: &mut Step| {
11233                step.env
11234                    .insert("HERMIT_SCRIPT_TEST_JOBS".into(), "1".into());
11235            }),
11236            ("authored description", &|step: &mut Step| {
11237                step.description.insert(0, 'x')
11238            }),
11239        ] {
11240            let error = mutated(HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG, edit);
11241            assert!(
11242                error.contains("in more than its hosted identity"),
11243                "{what}: {error}"
11244            );
11245        }
11246        let relabeled_local = mutated(SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG, &|step| {
11247            step.labels.push(HOSTED_PORTABLE_LABEL.into())
11248        });
11249        assert!(
11250            relabeled_local.contains("keeps the hosted-portable label"),
11251            "{relabeled_local}"
11252        );
11253        let relabeled_hosted = mutated(HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG, &|step| {
11254            step.labels.push("full".into())
11255        });
11256        assert!(
11257            relabeled_hosted.contains("has labels"),
11258            "{relabeled_hosted}"
11259        );
11260        let family = mutated(HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG, &|step| {
11261            step.fail_fast_family = Some(SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG.into())
11262        });
11263        assert!(family.contains("fail-fast family"), "{family}");
11264        let undescribed = mutated(HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG, &|step| {
11265            step.description = step
11266                .description
11267                .replace(" HOSTED WALL BOUND 2026-10-06:", " HOSTED WALL 2026-10-06:")
11268        });
11269        assert!(
11270            undescribed.contains("lost its hosted wall description"),
11271            "{undescribed}"
11272        );
11273        let mut duplicated = committed.clone();
11274        duplicated.steps.push(hosted.clone());
11275        let error = assert_hosted_script_unit_tests(&duplicated).unwrap_err();
11276        assert!(error.contains("appears more than once"), "{error}");
11277        let mut missing = committed.clone();
11278        missing
11279            .steps
11280            .retain(|step| step.tag() != HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG);
11281        let error = assert_hosted_script_unit_tests(&missing).unwrap_err();
11282        assert!(error.contains("is absent"), "{error}");
11283
11284        // The assertion is wired into the generator's invariant set.
11285        let mut changed = committed.clone();
11286        changed
11287            .steps
11288            .iter_mut()
11289            .find(|step| step.tag() == HOSTED_SCRIPT_UNIT_TESTS_TAG)
11290            .unwrap()
11291            .timeout = 900;
11292        let cells = expected_cells(&crate::git_environment::checkout_root()).unwrap();
11293        let error = assert_invariants(&changed, &cells).unwrap_err();
11294        assert!(error.contains("not the hosted 1500s"), "{error}");
11295    }
